title: Account Director
descriptionHtml:
We are the UK's leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men's & Women's Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper's Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don't just create content – we shape culture.

Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that's brought us here. We believe in each other's potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people's lives.

We're proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history.

Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James's, London, SW1Y 4AJ, where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions.

Salary - £55,000 - £65,000 + 40% Commision - Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate's skills, knowledge and relevant expertise.

The Role...

As an Account Director, you will be responsible for growing and managing a portfolio of key client and agency relationships across Hearst UK, combining strong commercial thinking with a deep understanding of our brands, audiences and advertising solutions.

You will own your accounts from strategy through to delivery, developing trusted relationships with senior agency and client stakeholders and identifying opportunities to grow revenue across Hearst’s full portfolio. Working across print, digital, social, data, programmatic, content partnerships and events, you will bring together the right Hearst solutions to meet client objectives and create long-term commercial value.

This is a highly relationship-led and commercially focused role. You will work closely with the wider sales, creative strategy, marketing and operations teams to develop compelling responses to briefs, turn insight into opportunities and ensure clients receive a consistently high level of service. You will also act as a senior representative for Hearst across the industry, helping to strengthen our reputation and relationships across your agency and client network.

Main Duties…

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key client and agency accounts, developing strategic plans that deliver against revenue targets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across client, planning, investment, digital and buying teams, ensuring Hearst is front-of-mind.
  • Identify and convert new business and growth opportunities across Hearst’s full commercial portfolio, from existing spenders through to new prospects.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business, objectives, category and media strategy, using insight to shape relevant commercial opportunities.
  • Partner with sales, creative strategy, content, marketing, digital and operations teams to develop integrated, high-quality responses to briefs.
  • Act as a trusted consultant to clients and agencies, confidently presenting Hearst’s capabilities, products, audience insight and market opportunities.
  • Lead commercial conversations and negotiations, ensuring proposals are strategically strong, commercially viable and delivered to a high standard.
  • Oversee the development of client presentations, proposals, case studies and market insight, ensuring a consistent and compelling Hearst story.
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities and ensure account activity, forecasting and revenue information are accurate and up to date.
  • Represent Hearst at industry events, meetings and client entertainment, building the external profile and network of the business.
  • Share client, agency and industry insight internally, helping the wider team identify trends, opportunities and changing market needs.
  • Act as an ambassador for Hearst UK, its brands and values, delivering best-in-class service and strengthening long-term partnerships.

What We Are Looking For…

  • Proven experience in a senior commercial, agency sales, media or client partnership role, with a strong track record of growing revenue and accounts.
  • Strong understanding of the media and advertising landscape, with experience across both digital and traditional channels.
  • A proven ability to develop strategic account plans and turn client insight into tangible commercial opportunities.
  • An exceptional relationship builder with established agency and/or client contacts and the confidence to build relationships at senior level.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with a clear focus on revenue, results and long-term account growth.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and disciplines, bringing together creative, commercial and operational expertise to deliver the right solution for clients.
  • Highly organised and commercially driven, able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of client service.
  • A proactive, curious and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to spot opportunities, challenge thinking and connect the dots across the Hearst portfolio.
  • A strong team player who contributes to a positive, collaborative and high-performance culture.

Benefits… 

(Your benefits at Hearst UK are more than just extras—they are tools to help you thrive in every part of life.)

Hearst Exclusives - Only for You! 

  • Get adventurous with Good Housekeeping Taste and Beauty Testing Panels - yes, you could be trying the next big thing in beauty, food & drink. 
  • Snag luxe beauty steals at our legendary office sample sales - score big on top brands without breaking the bank!  

Inclusion, Health & Wellbeing: Feel Your Best 

  • Stay healthy with Specsavers eye care, a company-funded Health Cash Plan, and access to mental health support. 
  • Get active and stress-free with discounted gym memberships and the Cycle to Work scheme. 
  • Embrace flexibility with a Location Flex and Holiday Exchange to take time when you need it. 
  • Take time to give back with a Charity Day and access wellbeing resources whenever you need them. 
  • Join one of our Hearst ERG Groups. 

Financial Wellness - Boost Your Budget 

  • Plan ahead with a generous Workplace Pension, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Season Ticket Loan for easier commuting. 
  • Make smarter money moves using Salary Finance tools, Financial Wellbeing sessions, and Home Tech benefits to spread costs. 
  • Treat yourself with major discounts across London plus everyday savings via the HAPI at Hearst app 

Hearst UK is deeply committed to using our influential brands to reflect the world we want to live in – one that respects, protects, represents and uplifts the voices and opinions of all people. As a business, we recognise the significant benefits of creativity, collaboration and innovation that comes with diverse teams. Not only is diversifying the voices in our organization the right thing to do, but it also helps us to make powerful and exciting content that can be enjoyed by many more people. This is why we’re working to build a sense of true belonging within our business and foster a culture in which everyone feels heard.

title: Account Executive - Deutschlandweit
descriptionHtml:
Ärzt:innen digitalisieren, Praxis für Praxis: Dein Gebiet, Dein Business

Du machst Neukundengeschäft, weil Dir der Abschluss Spaß macht, nicht das Verwalten von Bestandskund:innen? Du willst nicht ins Büro, sondern raus zu Kund:innen? Dann ist das hier Deine Rolle.

Wir suchen Account Executives im Außendienst für unsere Standorte in ganz Deutschland:Dein Wohnort, Dein Gebiet.

Das ist der Job, ganz konkret

  • 100 % Neukundenakquise. Du gewinnst Arztpraxen, die heute noch nicht mit Doctolib arbeiten. Keine Bestandskundenbetreuung, keine Renewals, keine Upsell-Quote auf fremden Accounts.

  • Echter Field Sales: Die Hälfte Deiner Woche bist Du unterwegs. Du sitzt bei Ärzt:innen im Sprechzimmer, nicht in Videocalls. Rund 40 Kundentermine pro Monat in Deinem Gebiet. Die andere Hälfte Deiner Woche arbeitest Du von daheim oder aus Deinem regionalen Office: Vorbereitung, Telefonakquise, Pipeline-Pflege.

  • Dein Gebiet, Deine Verantwortung. Du bekommst ein festes Vertriebsgebiet rund um Deinen Wohnort und steuerst es wie ein eigenes Business: Routenplanung, Priorisierung, Pipeline, Umsatz (MRR) und Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Ziele, die erreichbar sind: 8 bis 10 Abschlüsse pro Monat entsprechen 100 % Zielerreichung. Bei rund 40 Terminen heißt das: etwa jeder vierte Termin endet mit einer Unterschrift. Unser Produkt löst ein echtes Problem, das merkst Du im Gespräch.

  • Voller Sales-Cycle in Deiner Hand. Von der Kaltakquise über den Termin bis zum Abschluss. Kein Handover mitten im Prozess.

  • Du verkaufst KI, die Ärzt:innen wirklich Zeit zurückgibt: KI-Telefonassistent, KI-Dokumentation, KI-Abrechnungsassistent, digitales Patient:innen-Checkin. Kein Nice-to-have, sondern Entlastung in einem überlasteten System.

Was Du verdienst

On-Target Earnings: 70.000 bis 80.000 €

  • Fixgehalt: 50.000 bis 58.000 €

  • Bonus bei 100 % Ziel: 22.000 €

  1. Rund 70 % Deines Zielgehalts sind Fixum. Im Außendienst ist ein 50/50-Split üblich, bei uns steht der größere Teil sicher.

  2. Ungedeckeltes Bonusmodell mit 1,5x bis 2x Overperformance-Kicker. Übererfüllung wird überproportional bezahlt, nicht abgeschnitten. Nach oben ist die Spanne offen.

  3. Provisionsauszahlung auch an Krankheitstagen.

  4. Geschützte Ramp-up-Phase von 3 Monaten, damit Du nicht ab Tag 1 auf voller Quote stehst.

Warum jetzt

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt ist gerade an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt, und wir sind mittendrin: 110.000+ Gesundheitsfachkräfte in Deutschland vertrauen uns, 25 Millionen+ Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform. Der Markt, der noch vor uns liegt, ist größer als alles, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. Genau deshalb bauen wir unsere Field-Sales-Teams jetzt aus.

Das brauchst Du wirklich (Must-haves)

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Neukundenvertrieb. Du hast selbst akquiriert und selbst abgeschlossen.

  • Du willst raus zum Kunden. Persönlicher Vertrieb vor Ort ist für Dich kein Kompromiss, sondern der Grund, warum Du diesen Job machst.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher. Alle Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

Führerschein Klasse B. Brauchst Du täglich.

Nicht unbedingt nötig: Healthcare-Erfahrung, SaaS-Erfahrung, perfektes Englisch, Studium. Wir bringen Dir Produkt und Markt bei, Vertrieb bringst Du mit.

Was Dich bei uns weiterbringt

  • Doctolib Sales Academy und Buddy-Programm für Deinen Start, plus laufende Trainings zu KI und Produkt

  • Klare Karrierepfade: Sales Expert, Mentor:in, Regional Manager:in, dazu laterale Wechsel innerhalb Doctolib

  • President's Club mit exklusiven Events und Mentoring, jährlicher Learning Summit in Berlin

Deine weiteren Benefits

  • Firmenwagen: Ein modernes Fahrzeug, auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1 %-Regelung. Tankkarte inklusive.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 40 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss und Premium-Krankenzusatzversicherung über die Allianz (u. a. Zahnreinigung, Seh- und Augenhilfen)

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

  • DoctoGrowth, unser langfristiges Beteiligungsprogramm für Mitarbeitende

  • Parent Care Programm: 1 Monat extra Elternzeit, 4 flexible Rückkehrtage, 5 zusätzliche Kind-krank-Tage pro Kind und Jahr

  • Mental-Health- und Coaching-Sessions über moka.care, plus monatliche Homeoffice-Pauschale

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte hier.

Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise I Paris
descriptionHtml:
About us

Procurement is overdue for a reset. For years, procurement and accounting teams have been stuck on legacy platforms that are now trying to bolt AI onto decades-old architecture. The rest of the enterprise tech stack is speeding companies up, and procurement is still slowing them down.

Pivot is the AI-native intake-to-pay platform built to change that. It’s the procurement platform people across the business actually use, so adoption sticks, cycle times drop, and finance sees spend before it’s committed, not after. And because Pivot touches every team in a purchase, accounting teams can finally fully automate their boring tasks.

The adventure started mid-2023 with three founders, former C-levels from fintech unicorns (Qonto, Swile, and Nuxeo).

We’ve built a team of 70 operating across 25+ countries. Backed by $70M from tier-1 investors and trusted by DoorDash, Lemonade, Wolt and Flix, we’ve just moved into the enterprise, and we’re only getting started.


We're looking for smart, execution-driven people who care about building something exceptional.

Your role

As an Account Executive - Enterprise, you will own the full sales cycle for our most strategic accounts on the French and Belgium market. You will target large, complex organisations with multiple stakeholders, navigate sophisticated procurement and legal processes, and close high-value, long-term deals that define Pivot's enterprise footprint in EMEA.

You will join our Sales team, which currently includes a VP of Revenue, Account Executives, a Pre-Sales Engineer, and a BDR team. You will report directly to VP of Revenue.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from first contact through close, managing procurement, legal, IT, and C-suite stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan targeting strategic enterprise accounts across your defined region, in close coordination with the BDR team. Willing to open doors by your own methods too.

  • Build and deliver compelling business cases, executive-level presentations, and tailored demos that articulate Pivot's value at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure commercial agreements, and ensure favourable terms for both Pivot and clients, building win-win partnerships designed to last.

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts, surfacing upsell and cross-sell potential to grow revenue and deepen relationships.

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline: own your forecast with accuracy on a monthly and quarterly basis, and manage CRM hygiene in HubSpot.

  • Collaborate internally:

    • Work closely with the BDR team, providing direction, feedback, and mentorship to maximise the quality and volume of enterprise pipeline.

    • Partner with Pre-Sales to manage technical evaluations, RFPs, and InfoSec requirements during complex sales cycles.

    • Coordinate with the Operations team to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term client satisfaction post-close.

Your sales mindset

  • You are a master of enterprise sales cycles: multi-threaded stakeholder management and driving consensus across large, complex organisations come naturally to you.

  • You are a strategic thinker who approaches your territory like a business: mapping white space, prioritising high-potential accounts, and building plans to convert them methodically over time.

  • You are confident and credible at C-suite level, able to engage procurement directors and CFOs.

  • You are resilient and persistent: long sales cycles don't discourage you. You manage momentum, keep deals alive, and know how to re-engage accounts that have gone quiet.

  • You are naturally curious and want to actively solve customer problems.

  • You are commercially sharp, able to understand complex pricing structures and articulate ROI and TCO in a way that resonates with financially-driven buyers.

  • You are a collaborative leader who uplifts those around you: sharing knowledge with BDRs, working closely with pre-sales, and contributing to a culture of high performance.

  • You like solving problems and making complex things look simple.

  • You always want to keep learning and you are comfortable with confronting ideas.

  • You enjoy the cadence and want to bring the best of yourself within an early-staged startup.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals.

  • Demonstrated success selling to enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees), managing multi-stakeholder buying processes and complex procurement cycles.

  • Experience handling deals with ACV of £100k+ and sales cycles of 6–12+ months.

  • Native-level French, and Fluent-level English; additional languages (German, Spanish) are a strong plus.

  • Highly organised, data-driven, and comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

  • Based in Paris; comfortable with occasional travel across EMEA.

What you will get

  • A competitive salary package plus equity (BSPCE)

  • RTT

  • Meal vouchers Swile

  • 1 days of remote work per week

  • An office at Morning Bourse in Paris

  • The richness of a multicultural and international team (more than 15 nationalities).

  • A unique chance to grow with a fast-scaling innovator

title: Account Executive - Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Account Executive - Enterprise

London

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations.

You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. This means navigating multiple stakeholders, building internal champions, and creating alignment across legal, technical, and commercial teams.

You’ll work closely with Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership, but you own the deal strategy and the outcome.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of high-value, enterprise opportunities

  • Build and execute deal strategies across complex buying groups

  • Navigate stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement

  • Develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts

  • Lead longer sales cycles (6–12+ months) with clear structure and momentum

  • Partner closely with GTM Legal Engineers on solution design

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility

What we’re looking for

  • Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals

  • Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts

  • Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions

  • Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics

  • Structured, strategic approach to deal management

  • High ownership and accountability for outcomes

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office or out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Marcus Evans, founded in 1983, is a global business intelligence and event marketing company with 49 offices in 20+ countries.

Marcus Evans Summits is the flagship solution offered by the company. Through in-person Summits, we curate matches between buyers and sellers via guaranteed, pre-qualified, mutually agreed one-to-one meetings. We work with world leaders in a variety of industries, including healthcare, legal, pharmaceutical, investments, energy, and packaging. Our client base is comprised of C-level executives from 98% of existing fortune 1000 companies.

We are searching for an Account Executive to develop new accounts and manage client relationships. A successful candidate will develop into Senior Account Executive and then Sales Manager after achieving initial milestones. We recognize excellence and are fully committed to developing impactful future leaders.

This is an in-person role located in our London office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generating and prospecting new leads to create book of business.

  • Contacting, qualifying, and engaging prospects through email, LinkedIn, and cold calling.

  • Negotiating and closing contracts with C-level decision makers by learning about their growth goals and converting that intelligence into business opportunities.

  • Keeping an organized record of sales activity and pipeline.

  • Nurturing new and existing client relationships.

  • Traveling to destination cities nationwide to tend to clients.

  • Acting on behalf of the company and our clients in the delivery of our exceptional products and services.

Qualifications

  • Sales experience: 2 years of proven B2B or B2C sales experience, preferably with a high-priced product.

  • Experience in creating and launching strategic marketing email campaigns is preferred. Experience in cold calling C-level executives.

  • Exceptional listening and questioning skills: Successful candidates understand emotional intelligence and tactical empathy.

  • Strong hunter mentality through disciplined KPIs plus farmer ability to nurture and develop relationships. Both are crucial to success in this role.

  • Pipeline management ability: Research, time management, and organizational skills.

  • Leadership: We promote 100% from within and actively develop top performers into successful leaders.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Basic Salary: GBP 40,000 per annum (comprising GBP 30,000 base + GBP 10,000 year one onboarding commission guarantee) and participation in an uncapped commission scheme.

  • You will earn 7%-13% commission on monthly targets with deal price points after your induction period of between EUR35k and EUR80k for entry relationships growing to EUR150k-EUR250k repeat relationships.

  • At an early stage you will be targeted to earn £2500 - £6600per month in commissions plus base. So OTE is £57k+ in year one, and Senior Account Executive Year Two: OTE £69k - £132k+.

  • Monthly career reviews against financial goals and KPI metrics. Progression into management after year 2 based on performance.

  • Exclusive Manager-in-Training program for selected global candidates after year 2.

  • Continuous training and mentorship. Access to global LMS platform and sales mastery program. Extensive sales tape library to review top performers’ work product. Call shadowing, whisper and live coaching, and group and individual tape training every week.

  • Business travel to 5-star resorts in locations like Beverly Hills, Miami, Boston, and Las Vegas.

  • Employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave plus bank/public holidays, increasing to 25 days after one year of service.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

title: Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | Field Sales NRW, Düsseldorf
descriptionHtml:
Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort Düsseldorf: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in NRW unterwegs – Düsseldorf, Köln, das Ruhrgebiet. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 Düsseldorf/NRW: Homeoffice plus Kundentermine in deiner Region, monatliche Teamtage in Berlin.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Firms-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

title: AI Applied Engineering – Platform Engineer Manager
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.

Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.

  • Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.

  • Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

  • Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

  • Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

  • Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.

  • Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.

  • Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.

  2. Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.

  3. Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.

  4. Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.

  5. Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.

  6. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.

  • Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.

  • Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.

  • FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.

  • Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

  • Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.

As a research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.

Qualifications

  • Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience
  • Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: language, speech, robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.
  • Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued
  • Must be comfortable writing PyTorch or JAX code
  • Deep learning research experience is valuable, but not necessary

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. title: AI Solutions Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity.

As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference.

This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define!

What You'll Do

Discover and design

  • Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration

  • Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard

  • On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently

  • Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor

Build with AI, not instead of it

  • You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team

  • The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually

  • Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here

  • Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships

  • Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics

Deploy and prove value

  • Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in

  • Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting

  • Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team

  • Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves

  • Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer

  • Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations

  • Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer

  • You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed.

  • 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back

  • Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. You can point to a time you went well beyond what a client expected

  • A track record of doing something exceptionally well, whether that's work, academia, sport, or anything else you've put your mind to

  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture - how data models, primary keys, and integration sequencing interact across a dozen enterprise systems. You don't need to write the integration code, but you need to know why it breaks and be able to reason with the people who do, and you'll need to become an Omnea product expert

  • You build real relationships with people at any level, from a junior procurement analyst to a CFO, and know how to handle pushback and stakeholder politics, not just build rapport

  • Comfortable running rooms of stakeholders across a genuinely cross-functional tool - on a single project you'll interface with the CPO, Legal, Finance, AP, InfoSec, and Compliance, plus each of their technical resources, often all with competing priorities on the same decision

  • Comfortable moving between the detail and the big picture: configuring a workflow in the morning, presenting a project plan to an exec in the afternoon

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

  • Work closely with the design team to define the best design that would ease the integration and test

  • Running the assembly, integration, and testing operations on the capsule, with a tight-knit team

  • Clearly communicating and documenting integration and test results

  • Defining lessons learnt and making continuous improvement


What we would love to see from you:

In the role of AIT Propulsion engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Willingness to contribute to build and support a new team

  • Hands-on approach

Skills and Behaviors

  • Good organizing and prioritization of tasks

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Commitment, Innovation, Trust, Quality, and Teamwork


Our mission

At The Exploration Company, we are democratizing space exploration i.e., by making it affordable, available, and open. Our high-impact team is driven by competence, impact, and efficiency. We are doers, team players, and problem solvers. Our culture is driven by technology, learning by doing, and passion for what we do.

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

title: Associate Principal (European Competition practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

CRA's European Competition Practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation of effects and damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit http://ecp.crai.com.

Associate Principals have the unique opportunity to learn from, and work alongside, some of the most respected scholars, specialists, and industry experts in the world.  We tailor our analyses to the facts of each case, employing tools such as merger simulation, upward pricing pressure analysis, econometrics, bargaining theory, or game theory as needed. Whether before a court or a regulatory agency, CRA consultants set a high standard for the clear communication of sophisticated economic analysis in complex cases. You will have access to internal training programs focused on creative problem solving, communications, and leading and managing colleagues, teams and cases.  In addition, our firm offers extracurricular activities where you can take additional leadership roles in recruiting, training, and volunteer activities in the local community.

A typical Associate Principal would:

  • Work closely with leading academics and consulting with attorneys and other clients in industry and government on a wide variety of finance, strategy and economics issues;
  • Conduct research in a supportive, team-oriented environment;
  • Act as a primary point of contact for clients and assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables including expert reports summarizing our opinions, conclusions, and recommendations and third party financial, market and industry data;
  • Independently conceptualize and identify issues, design complex economic and financial models to analyze economic and financial data;
  • Oversee analysis in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, SAS, R or Python);
  • Manage the research process, and supervising, training and mentoring junior analysts;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions;
  • Work with those testifying in judicial proceedings to provide economic analyses of mergers and other competition matters before the major competition authorities of the world;
  • Assist with recruiting and training of new colleagues.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong achievement in a graduate degree program (Masters or PhD) with focused study in economics or a related discipline;
  • Extensive and relevant experience (6-9 years), economics/antitrust consulting experience preferred;
  • Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills;
  • Experience managing and developing teams of junior colleagues;
  • Executive client presence and interaction skills.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current contact information;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in London and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or academic paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

title: Backend / Data Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Backend / Data Platform Engineer

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. title: Sales Manager Cyber Security (m/w/d) – Aufbau Neukundengeschäft
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Cyber Security entscheidet heute über die Zukunftsfähigkeit von Unternehmen. Als Sales Manager (m/w/d) für unsere Cyber-Security-Beratung erschließt du neue Kundenbeziehungen, vertiefst bestehende Partnerschaften und identifizierst konkrete Geschäftschancen für unsere Beratungsleistungen.

Deine Stärke ist es, Menschen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Vertrauen aufzubauen und gemeinsam mit unseren Solution Managern passgenaue Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln. Dein Ziel: echten Bedarf frühzeitig erkennen, qualifizierte Opportunities aufbauen und realistische Budgets verhandeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst aktiv neue Kundenbeziehungen im Offline-Vertrieb und baust unser Netzwerk systematisch aus.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Zielkunden und Ansprechpartner in den von uns definierten Märkten.
  • Du knüpfst neue Kontakte, organisierst Erstgespräche und führst überzeugende Ice-Breaker-Pitches durch.
  • Du qualifizierst potenzielle Leads hinsichtlich Bedarf, konkreten Herausforderungen, Entscheidungsstrukturen, Zeitplanung und Budget.
  • Du lieferst vorqualifizierte Business Opportunities an unser Management und unsere Solution Manager.
  • Du begleitest Kontakte kontinuierlich vom ersten Austausch bis zur konkreten Opportunity und stellst ein konsequentes Follow-up sicher.
  • Du nimmst an relevanten Fachveranstaltungen, Branchen-Events und Networking-Formaten teil.
  • Du analysierst Events im Vorfeld, identifizierst für uns relevante Kontakte und sprichst diese gezielt an.
  • Du entwickelst unseren bestehenden Sales-Prozess weiter und machst Vertriebsaktivitäten messbarer und effizienter.
  • Du arbeitest als Sparringspartner eng mit Marketing, Management und Solution Managern zusammen.
  • Du gibst Markt- und Kundenfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebs- und Beratungsangebots zurück.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung neuer Kunden und im Aufbau belastbarer Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Ein eigenes, für unser Geschäft relevantes Netzwerk sowie die Fähigkeit, dieses kontinuierlich auszubauen.
  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Ansprache und Vorqualifizierung potenzieller Kunden.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für den Markt des Security Consulting und die Abgrenzung zum Vertrieb von Security-Produkten.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Bedarf, Needs und Budgets potenzieller Kunden strukturiert zu erfassen und realistisch einzuschätzen.
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Freude an persönlichen Kundenterminen, Networking und Events.
  • Ausgeprägte soziale Kompetenz und ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner.
  • Die Fähigkeit, dich auf Menschen, Rollen, Branchen und Gesprächssituationen flexibel einzustellen.
  • Ein modernes, digitales und unternehmerisches Mindset.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du musst nicht zu jedem Kunden bereits die fertige Lösung präsentieren. Deine Aufgabe ist es, Interesse zu wecken, relevante Gespräche zu eröffnen und echte Herausforderungen zu erkennen.

Wir suchen deshalb eine Persönlichkeit, die:

  • Einen überzeugenden Ice-Breaker-Pitch beherrscht
  • Nicht versucht, vorschnell eine dedizierte Solution zu verkaufen
  • Aufmerksam zuhört und die richtigen Fragen stellt
  • Vertrauen aufbaut, ohne aufdringlich zu wirken
  • Auch komplexe Cyber-Security-Themen verständlich vermitteln kann
  • Kontakte nicht nur sammelt, sondern nachhaltig entwickelt

Unser Vergütungsmodell

Wir bieten dir ein transparentes und leistungsorientiertes Vergütungsmodell:

  • 60.000 bis 70.000 € fixes Jahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation.
  • Ein variabler Vergütungsanteil von rund 40 % auf Basis klar definierter Vertriebsziele.
  • Bei Überperformance ist eine Gesamtzielerreichung von bis zu 150 % möglich.
  • Ein Firmenwagen wird gestellt.
  • Die Provision wird quartalsweise ausgezahlt.
  • Im ersten Quartal gleichen wir den noch nicht vorhandenen Provisionsanteil durch eine Aufstockung des Fixgehalts aus.

Warum du zu uns kommen solltest

  • Du baust einen wichtigen Vertriebsbereich in einem zukunftskritischen Markt aktiv mit auf.
  • Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum bei Kundenansprache, Netzwerkaufbau und Prozessentwicklung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Solution Managern, Marketing und Management zusammen.
  • Du verkaufst keine beliebigen Produkte, sondern hilfst Unternehmen, ihre Cyber Security strategisch und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Deine Kontakte, Ideen und Erfolge werden sichtbar und wertgeschätzt.
  • Du profitierst von einem attraktiven Fixgehalt, einer leistungsorientierten Provision und einem Firmenwagen.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Du erkennst dich in dieser Rolle wieder und möchtest Cyber-Security-Consulting gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und einigen Sätzen zu deinen bisherigen Erfolgen im B2B-Vertrieb, deinem relevanten Netzwerk und deiner Motivation für den Bereich Cyber Security.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Compensation & Equity

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Europe: €58.1K – €83K OTE

descriptionHtml:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

VOS MISSIONS

title: CDI - Manager AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Au contact des dirigeants et des responsables métiers, vous définissez des dispositifs de montée en compétences, de construction d’agents et d’accompagnement au changement. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions : vous en garantissez la qualité, l’impact et la rentabilité, faites grandir vos équipes et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables.

Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre ambition : faire de l’IA un levier de transformation du travail, avec un impact concret, mesurable et durable sur les équipes et leur performance.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Conduire le cadrage avec L&D, RH, sponsors et métiers: définir populations cibles, priorités, objectifs observables et parcours différenciés.Concevoir une stratégie de démultiplication combinant sessions, contenus digitaux, coaching, champions et transfert aux équipes internes.Piloter un portefeuille de cas d'usage opérationnels: valeur, faisabilité, risque, capacité de build et séquencement des sprints.Organiser les ateliers de discovery et faire arbitrer les points de dépendance, d'accès ou de gouvernance par les interlocuteurs habilités.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Piloter budget, planning, staffing, qualité pédagogique et satisfaction ; réaliser les arbitrages nécessaires et faire grandir les équipes.Superviser les assets pédagogiques, animer les sessions à forte visibilité et garantir l'alignement entre exercices, capacités des plateformes et besoins métier.Superviser les solutions low-code/no-code, les standards, les jeux de tests, la documentation et les quality gates adaptés au périmètre technique et aux standards de la practice.Concevoir avec les Analytics Engineers l’architecture de reporting d’un programme, définir les standards de visualisation et de KPIs, coacher les équipes en data storytelling, superviser leurs dashboards et en piloter l’adoption.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Coordonner la mise en usage, la formation des utilisateurs et le handover client: relais managériaux, communautés, rituels et office hours.Piloter les boucles de feedback, les indicateurs de valeur et, si désigné, le plan de change sur une mission ciblée.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Définir des indicateurs de compétences, d'autonomie et d'usage; restituer les résultats aux sponsors et ajuster la démarche.Contribuer aux avant-ventes, estimations, chiffrages et propositions, en identifiant les extensions pertinentes chez les clients.Qualifier la nécessité d’un co-delivery avec Solutions Engineering ou la DSI, sans empiéter sur leurs autorités techniques.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision

5 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.Une expérience confirmée de pilotage de missions complexes et de management d’équipes, avec une responsabilité sur la qualité des livrables, les délais, les budgets et la satisfaction client.Une solide maîtrise des usages de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir, challenger et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et à guider les équipes dans leur construction.Une expérience dans la conception et le pilotage de dispositifs de montée en compétences et de programmes d’adoption de l’IA, ainsi que dans la transformation des processus, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.Une aisance dans la relation avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau, la capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes, faire grandir les consultants et contribuer au développement commercial.Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA).

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering).Piloter ce qui compte

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

Une trajectoire qui accélère 

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager
  3. Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un AI Builder Director
  4. Un role play AI Adoption Manager (45 / 60’) AI Builder Director ou un AI Builder Partner
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.
