title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.

Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.

  • Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.

  • Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

  • Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

  • Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

  • Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.

  • Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.

  • Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.

  2. Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.

  3. Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.

  4. Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.

  5. Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.

  6. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.

  • Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.

  • Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.

  • FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.

  • Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

  • Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Chief Deployment Officer / Head of Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Chief Deployment Officer / Head of Deployment

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: Co-founder and COO

Application Deadline: 04/01/2027

___________________________________________________________________________

Cosine at a glance

Cosine is a UK AI company building frontier AI models and products that enable enterprises to deploy, customise and operate powerful AI systems in their own environments.

Our work spans bespoke AI model development and post-training, sovereign AI infrastructure, and the deployment of AI into complex, highly secure enterprise environments.

We're entering an exciting phase of growth, working with major enterprises, governments and defence organisations on increasingly ambitious technical projects.

We're looking for an exceptional leader to take ownership of how we deliver.

___________________________________________________________________________

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Chief Deployment Officer / Head of Deployment to build and lead Cosine's customer deployment organisation from the ground up.

You'll own the successful delivery of everything we build for customers, from large-scale model post-training programmes using Sparklr, to fully operational Cosine Cluster installations, GPU infrastructure deployments and bespoke AI projects.

We'll level this role to the person: Chief Deployment Officer for someone who has built delivery organisations at scale, Head of Deployment for an outstanding leader earlier in that journey.

In either case, this is not a conventional project management position.

We want someone who can take a complex customer requirement, work out how to deliver it, assemble the right people and resources, and take complete ownership of the outcome.

You'll report directly to the Founders, work closely with our engineering, ML and commercial teams, and have the opportunity to build an entirely new function within Cosine.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you’ll own

1. End-to-end customer deployment

  • Take ultimate accountability for the successful execution of all Cosine customer projects, from initial technical scoping to production deployment and handover.

  • Lead delivery across Sparklr model post-training projects, Cosine Cluster deployments, GPU infrastructure installations and bespoke AI engagements.

  • Personally unblock difficult technical and operational challenges, bringing in specialist expertise where needed.

  • Ensure projects deliver exceptional customer outcomes, on time and within budget.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior technical stakeholders at our customers.

2. Build the deployment organisation

  • Design, recruit and lead Cosine's deployment function, including forward-deployed engineers, infrastructure specialists and technical project leaders.

  • Establish the processes, tools and operating model needed to deliver multiple complex projects simultaneously.

  • Turn one-off deployments into repeatable, scalable offerings without sacrificing technical quality or agility.

  • Build an exceptionally high-performing team, combining startup speed with enterprise-grade reliability.

3. Technical leadership

  • Work with our ML and engineering teams to turn new technology into deployable products, and feed what you learn in the field back into the roadmap.

  • Make sound technical judgements across model deployment, compute infrastructure, systems integration and enterprise security.

  • Understand customer environments, identify technical risks and make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, cost and performance.

  • Act as a senior technical authority and trusted partner to customers' CTOs and engineering leaders.

4. Commercial and operational ownership

  • Partner with our commercial team to scope projects, assess feasibility and structure compelling, deliverable customer commitments.

  • Own project economics, including budgets, resource allocation and delivery margins.

  • Ensure successful projects translate into strong customer relationships, repeat business and opportunities for expansion.

  • Help shape Cosine's broader commercial and technical strategy as part of the executive leadership team.

___________________________________________________________________________

Who we're looking for

We're much more interested in what you've achieved than the titles you've held.

You might be a former technical founder, CTO, VP Engineering, senior infrastructure leader or someone who has built a sophisticated technical delivery organisation from scratch.

You'll bring:

  • Founder-level ownership. You've built something substantial, thrive in ambiguity and instinctively take responsibility for outcomes. You don't need a playbook or a large team to get things done.

  • Deep technical credibility. You understand complex software systems, AI/ML infrastructure and enterprise technology well enough to make difficult technical decisions and hold your own with our engineers and researchers.

  • Outstanding execution. You have a track record of taking ambitious, technically challenging projects from concept into production, overcoming obstacles and delivering results.

  • Commercial instincts. You understand customer relationships, project economics and how to make technical delivery commercially sustainable.

  • Leadership ability. You can attract brilliant people, build high-performing teams and establish high standards without unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Exceptional adaptability. You're as comfortable discussing architecture with a CTO as solving an urgent operational problem, negotiating with a supplier or getting personally involved in a deployment.

Experience with AI infrastructure, model deployment, GPU clusters, enterprise software or highly secure customer environments would be particularly valuable.

Above all, we're looking for a builder: someone who'd rather write the playbook than follow one.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why join Cosine

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious AI company at a formative stage and take ownership of an entirely new, business-critical function.

  • Build something from scratch. Shape the organisation, hire your own team and define how we deliver as Cosine scales.

  • Genuine executive ownership. Report directly to co-founder and COO, with substantial autonomy and influence over company strategy.

  • Work at the frontier of AI. Help build the UK's sovereign AI capability, on projects most AI companies can't access.

  • Exceptional customers and problems. Work with major organisations on technically demanding projects with real-world impact.

  • Meaningful equity. Participate directly in the value you help create, with substantial upside as the company grows.

___________________________________________________________________________

 

Compensation

An equity-weighted package: a competitive base salary plus a meaningful ownership stake, with real upside as Cosine grows.

We're looking for someone who thinks and acts like an owner, and we intend to reward them accordingly.

___________________________________________________________________________


Cosine is an equal opportunity employer.


We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

Experience

title: Compliance Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Compliance Officer, you will be the dedicated owner of third-party due diligence and the broader integrity compliance agenda at Harmattan AI. You will protect our ability to operate and win contracts with demanding customers and partners as we scale across Europe, the US, the Middle East and Africa. You will build this function from the ground up, with real ownership and direct access to management.

Responsibilities

  • Own the third-party due diligence process end to end, covering partners, intermediaries, suppliers, prospects and investors.

  • Screen incoming requests, assess the risk and issue clear go / no-go / go-with-safeguards recommendations.

  • Define the risk-tiering methodology, screening tools and approval workflow that every due diligence file runs through.

  • Build and maintain the group compliance risk map and a multi-year compliance roadmap.

  • Draft, update and roll out group policies on anti-corruption, gifts and hospitality, conflicts of interest and whistleblowing.

  • Design and deliver compliance training and awareness for employees and managers.

  • Partner with Sales, Procurement and Legal on live files and contract clauses, escalating sensitive cases to management.

  • Support the trade compliance function on end-use checks, and prepare evidence for audits, customer questionnaires and investor due diligence.

  • Monitor anti-corruption and sanctions developments and turn them into practical guidance for the business.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in third-party due diligence, compliance or corporate investigations, ideally involving high-risk jurisdictions.

  • Background in compliance, law or ethics, or in economic intelligence, risk advisory or corporate investigations.

  • Strong research and investigation skills: OSINT, corporate registries, UBO identification, sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, network mapping.

  • Ability to write clear, decision-oriented due diligence reports.

  • Working knowledge of Sapin II, FCPA, the UK Bribery Act and EU, UN, OFAC and UK sanctions regimes.

  • Degree in law, political science or business, or a specialized master's in economic intelligence, geopolitics or risk; demonstrated rigor matters more than field of study.

  • Curious, methodical and comfortable with ambiguity, with the pragmatism to turn findings into a clear risk position.

  • Ability to challenge commercial opportunities while preserving the relationship with business teams.

  • Motivated to move from advising clients to owning decisions and building a function in-house.

  • Fluency in English and French.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Content Strategist / UGC Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Full-time · Fully remote · €35K-€50K + bonuses + equity

We don't run campaigns. We build distribution engines.

What is Vyral Labs?

Vyral Labs is a Canvas UGC agency. Every month our creators post hundreds of native short-form videos from brand-new accounts on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook, and every single one is an experiment. Most videos flop, a few go viral, and the winners pay for everything.

We run campaigns for consumer apps and brands like Ecosia, Faircado and Status, across Europe, the US and LatAm. We also run our own app studio, so the playbooks you build get pointed at our own apps too.

As a Content Strategist / UGC Engineer you sit between strategist, creator manager and account lead: you decide what gets posted, coach the creators who post it, and own the results with the client.

This is a full-time role. We work hard and move fast, and we expect the same from you. In return, you'll be rewarded: your pay, bonuses, equity and responsibility grow with your results.

Apply with the button on this page.

What you'll do

• Run client campaigns end to end, each with a roster of creators across one or more markets

• Write the hooks and scripts creators post every week

• Test at volume: hooks, formats, pacing, text styles and CTAs. Find what works and double down in days

• Read performance every day, cut what isn't working and scale what is

• Coach creators with clear, specific feedback, using real videos and examples from top performers

• Decide who stays on the roster, who needs a push and who's out

• Source and onboard new creators when the roster needs fresh talent

Who you are

• Chronically online. You know TikTok and Reels culture without having to look it up

• High agency. You own outcomes, not tasks

• A systems thinker who turns creative chaos into repeatable processes

• You write like the internet: native hooks, scripts and feedback, not marketing speak

• Comfortable posting your own content and reading the numbers in real time

• Organised enough to run many creators, tests and clients at once

• Business-minded. You care what a viral video does for the client, not just the view count

• Genuinely hungry. A flop is data, not failure

• No industry experience needed. Bonus if you've done UGC, creator management, social or growth marketing, or speak more than one language

What you'll gain

• €35K-€50K base salary, depending on experience

• Real ownership from week one, running campaigns for brands people actually use

• Exposure to our app studio: see how distribution turns apps into businesses

• A clear path to Senior UGC Engineer, with your pay, equity and bonuses growing as you do

• A young, ambitious team that works hard and keeps it fun

Team benefits

• Remote-first: work from anywhere

• Quarterly team trips: we just got back from the South of France

• Unlimited PTO (we roughly take around 23 days a year)

How to apply

Hit Apply (about 10 minutes). Then: intro call with our co-founder, a case study (plan a UGC campaign for a real app, plus a virality test), a final interview with the team, and a paid trial before going full-time.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for motivation and how fast you learn, not for a perfect CV.

descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Salary - £48,000 (per annum)

Deine Aufgaben

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Digital - French
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You enjoy working at high velocity: 
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology 
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Customer Success Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

  • Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

  • Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

  • A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

  • Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

  • Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

  • Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

title: Customer success manager
descriptionHtml:
Customer success manager

Hybrid with two days a week in our London or Bath office

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

You'll be the go-to escalation point for the firms that run their investment platforms on Seccl, reporting to our Customer success lead. It's a rare chance to be the person customers call when it matters most, and to shape how they experience our technology.

You'll own the operational relationship with your assigned customer firms, from making sure they're set up to succeed through to leading communications on the most complex issues until they're resolved. You'll also be the bridge between our customers and our product, operations and engineering teams, making sure the experience feels joined up and the right fixes get prioritised.

What makes this role unusually interesting is how much it touches. You'll dig into support tickets, issues and performance data to spot risk early, help firms get more from our tools through training and workshops, and help bring our customer success framework to life. Your work will feed directly into how we improve both the product and the way we work.

What you'll own

  • Owning the operational relationship with your assigned firms, so they are informed, enabled and set up to succeed with Seccl

  • Leading the most complex customer issues from first contact through to resolution, including bug management and clear communication

  • Spotting risk early by reading customer health, sentiment and recurring issues, and driving the actions that close them out

  • Improving how firms use our UI, tools and processes through training, workshops and self-service

  • Turning customer data and support themes into insights that shape product and process improvements

  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally, aligning teams to solve problems and lift customer satisfaction

  • Delivering our customer success framework, from regular firm meetings to championing customers across Seccl

This role's for you if...

  • You have experience managing complex customer relationships or escalations, ideally in fintech or financial services with exposure to investment platforms or adviser firms

  • You can lead calm, open and challenging conversations with customers and colleagues, even when things are going wrong

  • You are comfortable working through complex issues with incomplete information, bringing in the right experts as you go

  • You can turn raw data into clear insights and recommendations that people act on

  • You understand core operational processes and can explain them clearly to different types of firm and stakeholder

  • Desirable: you've run training sessions or workshops for customers or internal teams

This role isn't for you if...

  • You'd prefer a predictable week. Escalations arrive when they arrive, and you'll often be juggling several firms and fixes at once, so staying composed under pressure matters.

  • You like to stay in your own lane. Most of this job is influencing people you don't manage, across product, operations and engineering.

  • You'd rather close tickets than fix causes. We want you digging into why problems happen, not just resolving them one at a time.

  • You shy away from difficult conversations. You'll be expected to challenge customers and colleagues, and to say what needs to be said.

What's in it for you

  • We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 A salary between £45,000 and £60,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You'll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews, or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

Following an initial chat with our talent team, you can expect the process to look like:

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager

  • Second stage – one-hour technical interview or case study

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We'll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone's welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every box. We'd love to hear from you.

Compensation: £45K – £60K

title: Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll shape how SME customers in DACH realise lasting value from Airwallex by building clear, scalable customer journeys from handover and onboarding through activation, adoption, retention and expansion readiness.

  • Build clear, scalable customer journeys across handover, onboarding, first value, adoption, retention, reactivation and expansion readiness.

  • Create segmented, cohort-based and trigger-led lifecycle programmes using customer context and product signals.

  • Develop customer education and enablement experiences, including onboarding materials, webinars, enablement sessions, campaign content, FAQs and self-service resources.

  • Establish repeatable playbooks, journey standards, handover requirements, engagement triggers and internal workflows that create a consistent customer experience.

  • Use customer insight, product signals and operational data to identify friction, define success measures and continuously improve lifecycle programmes.

  • Partner with Account Management, Sales, Product, Risk, FinOps, Support, Operations and RevOps to improve customer outcomes and contribute to the operating model, dashboards, tooling requirements and ways of working for a growing DACH Customer Success function.

You'll work from our Berlin office three days a week.


What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Lifecycle Management, Customer Enablement, Customer Operations, Onboarding, Learning & Development or a comparable customer-facing or operational role.

  • Experience designing and improving customer journeys, lifecycle programmes, enablement initiatives, operational processes or playbooks.

  • Ability to turn customer insight and data into clear priorities, practical improvements and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong written communication and content skills, with the ability to make complex products or processes straightforward for different audiences.

  • Strong analytical and operational skills, including experience defining success measures and using CRM, analytics or campaign tools to monitor results.

  • Ability to work across functions, clarify ownership and drive programmes from idea through implementation and iteration.

  • Confidence engaging with customers and internal stakeholders, including in workshops, onboarding or enablement sessions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

  • A structured, pragmatic approach and the ability to balance detail with progress in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, payments, SaaS, financial services or another technical product environment.

  • Experience with lifecycle marketing or customer engagement platforms, customer education, scaled success programmes or digital adoption.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Looker, Zendesk, Google Workspace, SQL or similar CRM, analytics and support tools.

  • Experience working with KYC/KYB, risk, compliance, payment operations or other regulated financial workflows.

  • Experience in a high-growth environment where processes, ownership and operating models are still being built.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

At 3E, we're seeking a Customer Success Manager who can transform customer relationships into lasting partnerships and help clients fully leverage our evolving portfolio of solutions.

This role offers the chance to make a meaningful impact by engaging with customers, providing product education, and offering consultative problem-solving. You'll partner closely with two Account Managers, becoming a trusted advisor to their customers as you guide them through complex solutions, highlight valuable features, and support them in achieving their business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping the customer experience, from building their confidence in our products to identifying opportunities for greater adoption, and proactively addressing challenges that could impact retention. Throughout this process, you'll collaborate with teams across Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product to connect customers with the expertise and resources they need.

If you're passionate about helping customers explore new possibilities, building relationships, simplifying complex technology, and taking ownership to maximize the value of their technology, this is your opportunity to make a tangible difference through your work. We want to hear from you!

What You'll Do

  • Build relationships that last. Develop trusted partnerships with customer stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and help them realize ongoing value from 3E solutions.

  • Turn product knowledge into customer success. Guide customers through product capabilities, deliver training, and help them confidently adopt new features and workflows that support their goals.

  • Drive meaningful engagement and adoption. Create and execute customer success plans, lead proactive outreach, and identify opportunities to increase product usage and engagement.

  • Partner to support retention and growth. Collaborate closely with two Account Managers to strengthen customer relationships, identify opportunities to expand value, and contribute to renewal success.

  • Get ahead of customer challenges. Monitor engagement, product usage, and customer feedback to recognize potential risks early, set clear expectations, and coordinate solutions before issues escalate.

  • Connect customers with the right expertise. Work across Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product to address customer needs, coordinate resources, and ensure timely follow-through.

  • Be a voice for the customer. Share insights, feedback, and emerging needs with internal teams to help improve products, processes, and the overall customer experience.

  • Grow your expertise across our solutions. Build knowledge of 3E's product portfolio, including Protect and Insight, and help customers discover capabilities that make their work easier and more effective.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You're someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers succeed. You know how to build trust, communicate clearly, and translate product capabilities into practical value. You're comfortable taking initiative, collaborating across teams, and navigating situations where the answer isn't always straightforward.

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client services, software training, or a related customer-facing role in a SaaS, technology, information services, or a similar environment.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage confidently and empathetically with different customer stakeholders.

  • Experience helping customers learn software, adopt new capabilities, and achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex information in an approachable, practical way.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate customer meetings, manage competing priorities, and follow through on commitments.

  • Confidence navigating challenging conversations, setting realistic expectations, and collaborating constructively with internal partners.

  • Curiosity and adaptability, with an interest in learning multiple products and finding solutions in an evolving environment.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn new systems and tools.

  • Ability to travel 10-20% of the time to customer locations or 3E events as needed.

Even better if you bring:

  • Experience supporting customer renewals, retention, or expansion in a recurring-revenue business.

  • Fluent in French or German.

  • Familiarity with customer success measures such as net revenue retention (NRR), product adoption, and customer engagement.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, or similar CRM and customer engagement platforms.

  • Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical, or other complex B2B software solutions.

  • Experience supporting mid-market or enterprise customers across different locations.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and an interest in exploring how emerging technology can improve customer experiences and workflows.

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
descriptionHtml:

We're looking to add a full-time, passionate Cybersecurity Engineer to our London office to help protect our company's people, data, and infrastructure from the wilds of the internet. title: Data Platform Engineer – Data Operations (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.

YOUR MISSION

Data is the fuel of STARK’s AI stack - you build the engine that makes it usable. You own the software backbone of our data platform: the metadata systems, ETL pipelines, data contracts, catalogs, databases, and internal tools that let engineers find, understand, validate, and reuse terabytes of multi-sensor field data in minutes, not days. You treat data context as a product: structured, searchable, version-aware, documented, and traceable from raw recording to processed asset, annotation delivery, dataset, and downstream ML workflow. Success in this role requires seamless cross-functional collaboration—acting as the central hub between the teams collecting data in the field, our external annotation vendors, and the ML engineers training the models. Your job is to design the automated workflows and data tooling that unify these groups, transforming raw operational data into reliable, high-quality systems at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build the Data Backbone: Design, write, and maintain robust Python software and ETL pipelines that ingest, process, and merge complex field recordings (flight data, rosbags, video) and external deliveries into our GCP cloud storage.
  • Create Data Tooling: Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.
  • Database & Metadata Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.
  • Data Operations & Labeling Workflows: Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.
  • Internal Tooling & APIs: Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Generalist Problem Solving: Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong Software Engineering in Python: You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.
  • Data Engineering & ETL: Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.
  • Database Mastery: Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.
  • Unix/Linux Environments: Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.
  • Pragmatic & Adaptable: You know how to balance a quick, scrappy fix with a long-term architectural solution, and you are highly comfortable with the changing priorities of a startup environment.
  • Communicator & Coordinator: You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with external vendors and non-technical stakeholders to drive data labeling and curation efforts.
  • Automation Mindset: You aren't allergic to jumping in to do support tasks, but you have the technical chops to automate them away so you never have to do them twice.

NICE TO HAVE

  • GenAI / Synthetic Data: Experience with synthetic data generation or GenAI-assisted workflows (auto-labeling, data augmentation, foundation-model-based curation).
  • Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, FiftyOne), computer vision annotation formats (e.g., COCO), or large-scale data curation workflows.
  • Advanced GCP: Experience with GCP services beyond basic storage (BigQuery, Cloud Run, IAM).
  • Robotics / Complex Data: Exposure to robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP, PX4 logs) or handling heavy, multi-modal data streams (video, lidar).

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Data Scientist & Researcher
descriptionHtml:
Your profile

Data Scientist & Researcher

Turba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA

AI infrastructure is no longer uniform. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it.

Two products. The Scheduler runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The Simulator answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? Both are only as good as the science underneath. You are that science.

What you will own

  • The scheduling brain. Policies that place and sequence workloads across heterogeneous GPUs, from sharp heuristics to optimization to reinforcement learning, whichever one actually wins on real data.
  • The Simulator's truth. Performance, cost and utilization models accurate enough that a data center bases a hardware purchase on them, and a running measure of how far they drift from what the Scheduler sees in production.
  • The signal in live cluster data. Where capacity is lost, why, and what to test next.
  • The research agenda. Decide which questions matter, kill the ones that don't, and take the survivors from hypothesis to something our engineers ship.
  • The standard of proof. Evaluation rigorous enough that the team and our clients trust a result without rerunning it.

Who you are

  • You have solved a hard scheduling, resource allocation or optimization problem, and you can show what changed because of it.
  • You build a model, then try to break it against reality. A result that has not survived real data does not count.
  • You pick the simplest method that works, and the sophisticated one when it earns its place.
  • You are fluent in Python and the modern ML stack, and at home in large, messy utilization and job data.
  • You can explain a hard result to an engineer, a product lead and a data center operator without losing the truth.

We do not screen on years or titles. We screen on the hardest thing you have worked on and how deeply you understood it.

A plus

  • Hands-on GPU or accelerator performance work, LLM training or inference workloads, or cluster schedulers such as Kubernetes or Slurm.
  • You have built simulators, digital twins or performance models of real systems.
  • Published or open-source work on scheduling, resource management or efficient AI.

Why this

This is infrastructure software that changes how AI compute gets used. What you prove here runs on real hardware in real data centers, with real money on the line, alongside the people building both products.

About us

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you’ll do

You'll own the operational backbone that connects what we sell to what we bill: turning executed contracts and agent usage into accurate bookings and reports, and turning the data behind both into critical insights the business acts on. This role sits at the center of the company’s business model and works across Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, GTM Systems, and Agent Development.

  • Partner with Sales, Legal, Pricing, and Finance across the deal lifecycle to execute deals cleanly and drive scalability over time

  • Continuously identify repetitive processes across the order management lifecycle and collaborate across the Go-to-Market Operations team to automate and scale them

  • Ramp from running standard processes to owning complex and ambiguous scenarios

Even Better…

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

title: Delivery Lead
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead delivery across the projects in our Strategic pod, holding commercials to plan and surfacing risks early.

  • Lead and develop the people who report to you, so they progress.

  • Spot where a project can grow, and bring cross-sell and upsell opportunities to the account team.

  • Lead internal projects that change how the pod delivers, and feed them into our shared delivery framework.

  • Shape how AI is used in our delivery workflows, beyond your own work.

  • Work alongside the pod’s technical lead, so technical delivery can focus on technical problems.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Run several projects at once with commercial accountability.

  • Led people, through line management or equivalent, and be able to point to someone who progressed.

  • Changed how a team works and be able to show it was adopted.

  • Built or shaped AI-enabled workflows, and be able to explain what you learned.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to direct work from a distance, rather than stay close enough to the detail to make sound commercial and delivery calls.

  • You’re more comfortable following an established playbook than building one as the team and the product evolve.

  • You see leadership as managing tasks rather than developing people and holding them to a high standard.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

  • Manager Interview - 60 minutes

  • Skills presentation - 60 minutes

  • Values Interview - 60 minutes

  • Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.
