title: Deployment Strategist | UK
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

At supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution.

Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization.

That’s why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled.

Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you’ll feel at home at supermodular.ai.

Your role

supermodular.ai operates through three core roles: AI Strategy, Deployment Strategy and Forward Deployed Engineering.

As a Deployment Strategist, you are responsible for translating AI strategy into a live enterprise engagement. You own delivery inside the account, including stakeholder management, prioritization, execution and the initiatives we commit to next.

You work directly with enterprise leaders, engineers and operators to understand how their systems and workflows function today, identify where AI can create meaningful operational impact and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed inside the organization.

Each account is led by a two-person leadership pair consisting of an AI Strategist and a Deployment Strategist. Together, you run the account end-to-end. You work directly with the customer and own the relationship end-to-end.

You also work closely with two Forward Deployed Engineers, forming a four-person delivery unit responsible for execution inside the account.

This role suits someone who moves comfortably through ambiguity, leads complex enterprise engagements and connects AI capabilities to operational reality.

What you own

  • Delivery of committed outcomes, with AI systems running reliably in production

  • Day-to-day stakeholder trust and executive alignment

  • Technical solution design across deployed AI systems

  • Execution quality alongside Forward Deployed Engineers

  • Deployment and adaptation of supermodular’s internal playbooks and platforms

  • Identifying and shaping expansion opportunities within the account

  • Translating organizational problems into prioritized, executable AI initiatives

What you bring

  • You have 8+ years in complex software environments as an engineer, product manager or engineering manager, working across the full product development lifecycle from discovery to production.

  • You think strategically. You connect AI capabilities to what the organization is trying to achieve and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed.

  • You are curious and AI-first. You follow how models, agents and tooling evolve, and you understand where they create practical enterprise value and what it takes to run them reliably: evaluation, observability, safety.

  • You are a pragmatic, lean thinker. You have the technical depth to guide solution design, look for the simplest solution that works and make clear trade-offs.

  • You take the shortest route to impact. You find another way when the usual path is slow, work with what is available, and get results in front of the client early.

  • You work autonomously. You take ownership of the account, use sound operational judgment and carry decisions through to results.

  • You focus on business impact. You start from the outcome the organization needs and measure your work by the operational change it creates.

  • You are a systems thinker. You see how models, workflows, tooling, data and people connect across an enterprise landscape.

  • You are an excellent project manager. You set priorities, plan the work, keep commitments visible and deliver what the account has agreed to.

  • You negotiate well. You align stakeholders with different interests, agree scope and commitments, and keep the engagement focused on the outcomes that matter.

  • You are a strong storyteller. You frame a problem so executives want to act on it, make the business case for each initiative, and grow the account by showing what the next step is worth.

  • You lead through the team. You give Forward Deployed Engineers clear direction and room to build, make decisions together with your AI Strategist, and step in wherever the account needs you.

  • You have a bias to action. You turn discussions into next steps, keep work moving every day and follow through until it runs in production.

Recruiter Screen > Experience > Client Project > Offer

title: Drone System Reliability Technician and Pilot
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot, you will be at the front line of our quality, safety, and reliability efforts. Your primary mission is to ensure that our defense-grade products meet rigorous operational standards before they are cleared for active duty.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. By logging massive operating hours, you will actively hunt for rare, hard-to-replicate system bugs and edge-case anomalies. We are looking for operators who combine rigorous testing discipline with the hands-on piloting expertise required to accurately assess and validate nominal drone behavior in flight. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

 

Responsibilities

  • Intensive Flight Testing: Conduct high-volume flight testing of newly assembled interceptors to log hours, validate systems, and actively hunt for rare, intermittent flight anomalies.

  • Aviation Performance Assessment: Manually operate, stress-test, and critically evaluate the flight dynamics of various platforms (multirotors, fixed-wing, flying wings, and RC planes) to ensure they handle exactly as designed.

  • Field Deployment: Lead and execute demanding on-site flight missions, sometimes lasting several weeks, under diverse weather and environmental conditions.

  • Mission Safety & Logs: Rigorously follow test checklists, maintain safety protocols during high-throughput flight operations, and accurately report flight observations to the engineering, production and industrialisation teams.

Candidate Requirements

  • Good RC/UAV Piloting Skills: You have extensive hands-on experience piloting RC planes, flying wings, or multirotor UAVs. Manual piloting dexterity and a deep instinct for flight mechanics are the absolute priorities for this role.

  • Rigor & Endurance: Strong discipline to run repetitive, structured test cycles with consistent attention to detail and unwavering focus on safety.

  • Adaptable Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, lean startup environments where initiative, quick decision-making, and teamwork are valued over rigid hierarchy.

  • Field-Ready & Mobile: You possess a valid driver’s license (Permis B) and are ready to drive team vehicles, transport flight gear/drones. You are looking for a highly active, hands-on role where you will be out in the field on a daily basis, all year round.

  • Technical background: Any technical degree or professional experience in electronics, RC modeling, mechanics, or aeronautics is a great plus, but passionate self-taught pilots are highly encouraged to apply.

  • Basic Technical English: Capable of understanding technical guidelines and writing flight reports in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications & FPV: Official drone pilot certifications, instructor ratings, or solid FPV (First Person View) racing/freestyle experience.

  • Military or Field Background: Past experience in specialized military units or demanding field-oriented professions.

  • Basic data/technical literacy: a basic grasp of autopilot systems, telemetry or flight-log reading, to help bridge the field and R&D. This is what turns an operator into a genuine validator, and is worth probing even if not required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: E-Commerce Integration Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Rügamer & Steiner entwickelt E-Mail-Marketing für Online-Shops. Damit unser Team für einen neuen Kunden loslegen kann, müssen Shop und Klaviyo sauber zusammenspielen. Du übernimmst diese Anbindung, klärst technische Fragen direkt mit dem Kunden und seiner Shopagentur und prüfst, ob alles für den Start bereit ist.

Was du übernimmst

• Du bindest Kundenshops an Klaviyo an, richtest die Integration ein und prüfst, ob die benötigten Daten und Shop-Ereignisse ankommen.

• Du führst technische Onboarding-Termine. Du erklärst, welche Zugänge oder Änderungen nötig sind, und hältst die offenen Punkte bis zur Übergabe nach.

• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen. Das Team weiß von dir, was bereits funktioniert, was noch offen ist und wann es mit der Übergabe rechnen kann.

• Wenn sich ein technischer Schritt bei mehreren Kunden wiederholt, kannst du ein Skript, ein internes Tool oder ein Plugin bauen, das die Arbeit beim nächsten Onboarding vereinfacht.

So startest du

Du lernst unsere Klaviyo-Setups und die Onboarding-Checkliste an konkreten Kundenfällen kennen. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du technische Termine und eigene Anbindungen. Nach drei Monaten ist das Ziel, dass du ein Standard-Onboarding vom ersten technischen Kundentermin bis zur geprüften Übergabe selbstständig durchführst.

Was du mitbringst

• Du hast schon selbst eine Integration eingerichtet, einen technischen Fehler behoben oder ein funktionierendes Projekt mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit laufenden E-Commerce-Shops ist ein Plus.

• Du kannst mit KI-Agenten arbeiten und programmieren. Du zerlegst technische Aufgaben in Schritte, prüfst den erzeugten Code und testest, ob die Lösung funktioniert.

• Du kannst nachvollziehen, wie Daten zwischen Shop und angebundenen Systemen fließen. Du findest dich in APIs, Shop-Apps und technischen Einstellungen wie DNS zurecht.

• Du kannst erklären, wie du eine Änderung an einem laufenden Shop vorbereitest, prüfst und bei Bedarf zurücknimmst.

• Du kannst technische Probleme im Kundengespräch verständlich erklären und mit Kunden und Agenturen konkrete nächste Schritte vereinbaren.

• Erfahrung mit Shopware, Magento oder ähnlich komplexen Shop-Setups ist besonders interessant. Klaviyo-Erfahrung ist willkommen. Unsere Abläufe lernst du bei uns kennen.

Was dich erwartet

Du bekommst früh eigene Kundenfälle und entscheidest bei Standardanbindungen selbst, wie du sie umsetzt. Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Shopsystemen und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit beim Kunden verändert. Wenn du merkst, dass ein eigenes Tool einen wiederkehrenden Engpass löst, kannst du es bauen und in den nächsten Onboardings einsetzen.

• 50.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Entwicklung in der Rolle

Bewirb dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Beispiel für eine Shop-Integration, einen technischen Fehler, den du gelöst hast, oder ein Projekt, das du mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt hast. Welche Systeme oder Tools hast du genutzt, was hast du selbst übernommen und wie hast du das Ergebnis geprüft?

title: Editor, International
descriptionHtml:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

About the role:
 We’re seeking an International Editor to tell Substack’s story across international markets on our owned channels. Together with Substack’s country leads, you will help build a bank of compelling editorial resources for our publishers, and you’ll shape and scale our brand storytelling around the world. This means crafting the strategy for how we tackle editorial needs market by market. You’ll work with translators and local agencies, all while protecting a cohesive Substack brand voice, identity, and quality bar.

The ideal candidate is passionate about writing, visual storytelling, and Substack’s mission. They are committed to profiling creators and publishers across the ideological spectrum, quick to grasp complex product storytelling, and excited to help build processes and strategy from scratch. They have demonstrable experience commissioning work that has captured the zeitgeist and enriched culture, and have worked with a range of creatives across disciplines. Ideally, they have also built or expanded an editorial function at a previous organisation.

This role is based in London, and reports to the Editorial Lead, with a dotted line to the Head of International.

Responsibilities:

  • Create an international storytelling strategy. Build our storytelling surfaces that hero our international creators, drive awareness to new global audiences, and enable our international partnerships team to recruit and retain publishers.

  • Manage translators and agencies. Drive forward briefs, and oversee translators and agencies as needed to support our key international markets at scale.

  • Collaborate across functions. Partner with Editorial, Comms, Partnerships, and country leads to make sure international editorial work is joined up with the rest of Substack’s communications and brand strategy.

  • Protect brand voice and quality. Ensure a cohesive brand voice, identity, and quality bar across every market and every translated or localized piece of content, however many hands it passes through.

Requirements:

  • Editorial judgment. You have a keen editorial eye and can judge, quickly and confidently, what’s worth translating and localizing for an international audience.

  • Exceptional project management. You can run multiple editorial workstreams across several markets at once, keeping translators, agencies, and internal stakeholders on schedule.

  • A writer at heart. You are an excellent writer and communicator, with an eye for what makes a compelling narrative.

  • Social media strategy. You have a strong eye for social media strategy and know what works on LinkedIn and how to repurpose for Instagram.

  • Cross-functional relationship-builder. You’ll cultivate strong working relationships with Editorial, Comms, and heads of markets, and you’re comfortable prioritising competing requests from several stakeholders at once across time zones.

  • Builder’s mindset. You’re comfortable building something (a hub, a process, a workflow) from scratch, and iterating on it as international needs evolve.

  • Cultural fluency. You’re familiar with Substack as a creator or subscriber and excited to help champion our mission internationally.

  • International experience. You’ve worked across international markets before, ideally in media, publishing, or communications, and understand the nuance of adapting content and brand voice for different cultural contexts.

Substack’s compensation package includes a market-competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is £70,000 - £100,000. Multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, determine final offer amounts and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Salience Labs, you’ll be right at the centre of our photonics product development. This role spans low-level firmware, rapid prototyping, and systems integration, giving you the chance to influence everything from proof-of-concept devices to our commercial platforms. You’ll collaborate across hardware, photonics, and FPGA teams to ensure smooth, efficient embedded software development, right down to the register level and all the way up to application-facing tools.

This is a full-stack embedded role, where versatility and curiosity are just as important as technical depth. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working close to the metal, but can just as easily contribute to user-facing tools and test infrastructure. You’ll be part of a small, fast-paced team where autonomy is encouraged and impact is tangible.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, implement, and document embedded software across a variety of project scales

  • Work closely with hardware and FPGA teams to build robust embedded systems

  • Use off-the-shelf development kits for rapid prototyping and system testing

  • Select, tailor, and integrate open-source applications and embedded frameworks

  • Collaborate with the Systems Test team to support test automation and data capture

  • Develop internal tools and test benches for the photonics and hardware teams

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience developing embedded software in C or C++

  • Proven ability to own software modules from design to delivery

  • Comfortable using Python and modern tooling (Git, Confluence, Jira)

  • Strong problem-solver with clear analytical thinking and communication skills

  • Flexible team player, able to switch between solo work and close collaboration

Even better if you

  • Can read schematics or interpret RTL, particularly helpful for supporting hardware teams

  • Have experience developing for ARM-based embedded platforms

  • Know your way around I2C, SPI, PCIe, and embedded driver development

  • Understand networking concepts

  • Are comfortable becoming a domain expert in unfamiliar tools or technologies

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on building, testing, and iterating in real hardware environments. If you’re looking for a deeply technical role where you can have influence across the full product stack, and you like the sound of building the software brains of next-gen optical systems, then we’d love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
descriptionHtml:
RDQ427R369

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.
  • Make agentic development the default path: Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.
  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.
  • Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence: Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.
  • Treat backward compatibility as a product feature: Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.
  • Lead across the platform: Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.

What we look for:

  • 3+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.
  • A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.
  • A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.
  • Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.
  • Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.
  • Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.

Stand-out experience:

  • Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.
  • Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.
  • Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. This is a role for someone ready to own a full enterprise territory, build and develop it the way they see fit. You'll carry real deal complexity (multiple stakeholders, long cycles, competitive pressure) and have the latitude to shape how you run your patch, while partnering closely with the broader go-to-market team on positioning and strategy.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll drive new business and expansion within enterprise accounts, working deals from first conversation through signature. This role matters because enterprise revenue is how Camunda grows, and the person in this seat has direct influence over which accounts we win, how we're positioned against competitors, and how customers experience us from day one.

What You Will Do

  • Build and execute strategic account plans that go beyond the next quarter, anticipating where accounts are headed and positioning Camunda ahead of that need.

  • Represent the customer's perspective internally, helping the broader team understand what's actually driving enterprise buying decisions.

  • Proven enterprise sales experience closing six-figure-plus software or SaaS deals as the primary owner, not just a supporting player. You've run full sales cycles from discovery through contract execution.

  • Experience managing a territory or named account list with real account planning behind it, including leveraging partners and alliances. You think about where to invest your time before you're told to, and you can show how that planning changed outcomes.

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder deals, including economic buyers, technical evaluators, and champions who don't always want the same thing. You know how to build alignment rather than just picking a side.

  • Strong negotiation instincts. You can hold your ground on value while still finding a path to close that works for the customer.

  • A track record of using competitive intelligence productively. You know how to position against alternatives without leaning on fear, uncertainty, or doubt.

  • Fluency with modern sales tools and workflows, including using AI to work smarter across prospecting, deal prep, and account planning.

title: Event Coordinator - Osnabrück (Working Student/Freelancer Part-Time)
descriptionHtml:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? 

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

What is Candlelight?

Since July 2019, Fever Originals has produced a series of classical music concerts in a “candlelit setting” which takes place in the most intimate and undiscovered venues all over the world. Cities include: France (Paris, Toulouse, Lyon), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Valencia), Portugal (Lisbon and Porto), and the United States (Los Angeles, New York, and Chicago), and are in the process of expanding to your city! Candlelight has democratized classical music by sharing it with the general public and providing a unique experience for each of our audiences.

For this role we are looking for an onsite Event Coordinator for our Candlelight Concerts. This is a part-time position and our concerts are mainly on weekends. Transport costs will not be compensated and will be included as part of the hourly rate.

We are looking to hire a freelancer or a working student for this position.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Act as main point of contact onsite for Candlelight events and staff; communicate directly with Fever Originals manager
  • Full visibility into staff roster; set schedule; communicate with the staffing agency about any reschedules of events
  • Ensuring each staff member is trained in their duties whether it is validating tickets, accommodating guests to their seats, and guaranteeing all staff goes through a thorough safety measures training while representing the Fever brand
  • Manage inventory for venues
  • Manage any printing needs
  • Manage guest lists for all events
  • Manage the opening and closing remarks at events
  • Daily reporting to Fever Originals Project Managers about the status of each event; including both the pre and post event findings and feedback
  • Assist with evaluating and executing walk-throughs of potential venues
  • Opportunity to partake in an exciting and rapidly growing company and the possibility to manage Candlelight and other Fever Original Events in other areas
  • Represent both the Fever and Candlelight brand fully through professional communication and management; acting as the main customer service representative at every event

Required profile:

  • 2+ years of experience in event management and/or a relevant degree (preferred)
  • Native German and fluent English. Other languages are a plus
  • Interest and passion for live music and organizing event
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Experience leading an on-site team
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Good ability to work in a pressured environment
  • Knowledge of AV and PA systems (desirable)

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

title: Events & Kommunikationsmanager (m/w/d), Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben als Events & Kommunikationsmanager*in

Parto entwickelt die digitale Zahlungslösung für soziale Einrichtungen und Pflegeeinrichtungen. Wir digitalisieren Bargeld und Zahlungsprozesse in der Kinder und Jugendhilfe, der Eingliederungshilfe und der Altenhilfe und entlasten die Mitarbeitenden von Verwaltungsaufwand.

In dieser Rolle in Teilzeit mit ca. 20 bis 30 Wochenstunden in Hamburg sorgst du dafür, dass diese Mission sichtbar wird, auf Messen, bei eigenen Events, im Postfach unserer Kunden und in der Presse.

Dafür suchen wir eine echte Allrounderin oder einen echten Allrounder: Heute organisierst du einen Messestand, morgen schreibst du eine Pressemitteilung und übermorgen baust du mit Sales eine Emailkampagne. Genau diese Vielseitigkeit braucht ein schnell wachsendes Startup wie wir.

  • Du planst, organisierst und betreust unsere Messeauftritte und Veranstaltungen, vom Standaufbau über Teamplanung und Hotels bis zum Auftritt vor Ort.

  • Im engen Sparring mit unserem Sales Team setzt du Emailsequenzen und Kampagnen um, zum Beispiel Einladungen vor Messen, Follow ups danach und unseren Newsletter.

  • Du schreibst Pressemitteilungen, versendest sie an unsere Pressekontakte und betreust unsere LinkedIn Unternehmensseite.

  • Du koordinierst externe Dienstleister und Partner rund um unsere Events.

  • Du misst den Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen, zum Beispiel Termine und Leads pro Messe, Presseerwähnungen und die Ergebnisse deiner Emailsequenzen wie Öffnungsraten, Antworten und vereinbarte Termine, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

Das bringst Du mit

Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Eventmanagement, Marketing oder Kommunikation gesammelt, idealerweise im B2B Umfeld, und hast bereits Messen oder Fachveranstaltungen von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung verantwortet. Du schreibst sicher und gerne auf Deutsch, von der Einladung über die Emailsequenz bis zur Pressemitteilung, und hast Erfahrung mit Emailkampagnen und einem CRM, idealerweise Pipedrive. Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig, behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick und reist gern zu Messen in ganz Deutschland. Erfahrung in der Pressearbeit und ein Bezug zur Sozialwirtschaft oder Pflege sind ein großes Plus.

Deine Vorteile bei Parto

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deinen Alltag anpassen. Rund um große Messen arbeitest du mehr, in ruhigeren Monaten weniger.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Du bist regelmäßig in unserem Büro in Hamburg und arbeitest an den anderen Tagen gern auch aus dem Homeoffice.

  • Firmenlaptop und Firmenhandy

  • Reisekosten zu Messen und Events übernehmen wir selbstverständlich

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte, Gutscheine und Ermäßigungen

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern, bei denen das ganze Team zusammenkommt

Über uns

Bei Parto arbeiten 21 Menschen an einer Mission, die uns jeden Tag antreibt: echte Teilhabe für die Menschen in sozialen Einrichtungen und mehr Zeit für die, die sich um sie kümmern. Über 30 Träger (z. B. Diakonie, Caritas, AWO ...) aus der Kinder und Jugendhilfe, der Eingliederungshilfe und der Altenhilfe vertrauen bereits auf unsere Lösung. Etwa die Hälfte von uns sitzt in Hamburg, die andere Hälfte verteilt über ganz Europa, unterstützt von erfahrenen Venture Capital Investoren. Was uns verbindet, ist ein offenes, dynamisches Miteinander, kurze Wege und die Freude daran, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Deine ersten Monate bei uns

Wir nehmen uns Zeit, dich gut ankommen zu lassen. In den ersten Wochen lernst du das Team, unsere Kunden und unser Produkt kennen und bekommst einen Einblick, wie Sales und Customer Success bei uns arbeiten. Schon bald planst du deine ersten eigenen Veranstaltungen und Kampagnen. Nach den ersten Monaten bist du die Person, die bei uns Events und Kommunikation in der Hand hat.

Trau dich

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung zu hundert Prozent? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns sind deine Motivation, deine Neugier und dein Talent wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. You’ll be the connective tissue between our BDR, Sales, AI Strategy, Product Marketing and Design teams, turning live experiences into qualified pipeline.

You’ll be Ema’s first field marketer in the region, working alongside our US Field Marketing Manager. Our Marketing Lead sets the global event strategy and budget. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it.

We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Event Planning

  • Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead.

  • Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam.

  • Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent.

Event Execution & Operations

  • Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe.

  • Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture.

  • Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI.

Pipeline & Sales Alignment

  • Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market.

  • Coordinate pre-event outreach, booth and event activations, and post-event follow-up to drive lead conversion.

  • Make sure every event lead reaches Sales quickly and cleanly. No leads die on the vine.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with AI Strategists, Product Marketing and Design so demos, collateral and messaging are event-ready, on-brand and right for the local audience.

  • Support broader demand-generation campaigns as needed, including regional activations and partner co-marketing events.

  • Work across time zones with US-based marketing and leadership, with some early-evening calls.

Measurement & Optimisation

  • Track and report on event performance by market (leads generated, pipeline influenced, cost per lead, attendance, deal acceleration) and share insights to improve the program.

  • Obsess over what’s working vs. what’s noise, and use data to make the case for where we invest next.

What You Bring

  • 5–7+ years of field marketing, event marketing or demand-gen experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology, with a track record of running events in the UK and at least one other European market. Startup experience is required. You’ve built programs, not just inherited them.

  • A working knowledge of the European event circuit and what each market expects, from London tech weeks to Paris and DACH industry shows.

  • Exceptional project management skills. You can juggle 5+ events in different countries and stages at once without dropping a ball. You live in spreadsheets, timelines and run-of-show docs.

  • A roll-up-your-sleeves operator. You’re the person zip-tying cables to a booth at 6 AM, getting a pallet of swag through customs, and sending the recap email before the Eurostar pulls in.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You partner naturally with Sales, BDRs, Product Marketing and executives, including colleagues eight hours behind you, without needing to be managed into it.

  • Experience with HubSpot and marketing automation platforms to track attribution and ROI, and a practical grasp of GDPR as it applies to event data.

  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to speed up day-to-day work, from drafting event briefs to analysing post-event data. We’re an AI company and we expect you to work like one.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving environments. Priorities shift, budgets change, events get added last minute, and you handle it. This is a fast growing Series B company. If you need a playbook handed to you, this isn’t the role.

  • High agency and an ownership mindset. As our first field marketer in Europe, you’ll see gaps and fill them without waiting to be asked.

Location & Travel

  • Based in/near London, working hybrid from our London office.

  • Travel up to 40% across the UK and Europe, with occasional trips to the US.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

title: Finance Systems Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Finance Systems Intern, you will help run and improve the quote-to-cash systems behind Parloa’s enterprise contracts. You will learn how signed agreements (annual commits, usage-based pricing, ramps and one-time fees) become accurate subscriptions and invoices across SAP Subscription Billing, NetSuite and Salesforce. This is a full-time, 6-month internship in Berlin, starting as soon as possible, with a dedicated mentor and real project work from your first weeks.

This is your opportunity to get hands-on with a modern quote-to-cash stack at a fast-growing AI company and take your own automation project from idea to delivery.

Areas of ownership:

  • Billing Operations: Set up and amend customer subscriptions from signed contracts and run pre-billing checks on billing runs and invoices, with team review before anything goes live. Investigate rating, pricing and master-data errors so customers are billed correctly.

  • Systems Configuration and Reporting: Maintain SAP Subscription Billing master data such as products, rate plans, pricing elements, and billing profiles, configuring and testing changes before they reach production. Build NetSuite saved searches, reports, and data imports, and support month-end close and reconciliations.

  • Cross-System Data Integrity: Keep products, billable metrics, and customer data consistent across Salesforce, SAP, and NetSuite. Build reports that flag mismatches before they turn into billing issues.

  • Issue Triage and Controls: Reproduce and document billing and finance-systems issues as clear, reproducible tickets for the team or our partners. Write and execute test cases for new features, and keep change logs and audit evidence current.

  • Process Automation: Write SOPs, process maps, and user guides for finance colleagues, then spot manual steps and automate them with scripts, integrations or AI tools. One of these becomes your own internship project, which you present at the end of your internship.

Who you are:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Information Systems, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field for the full duration of the internship, and available full-time for 6 months

  • First exposure to an ERP, billing or CRM system (such as SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora or Stripe Billing) through coursework, a university project, a previous internship or a working-student role

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the willingness to learn to read a JSON payload or an API error message; SQL or scripting experience (Python, Google Apps Script, n8n or Zapier) is a plus

  • A systems mindset and real interest in how a contract becomes an invoice and a journal entry: when something breaks, you keep tracing it until you find the root cause

  • Precise in how you work and handle financial data, with fluent written and spoken English and the confidence to ask questions and speak up with facts

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

 

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

title: Flight Simulation Software Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a new team member who is eager to make a real difference! As a Flight Simulation Software Engineer (Software Architect for Simulation Environments), you will be responsible for designing and building the simulation environments in which our autonomous air defense systems are developed, tested, and validated, connecting flight simulators with our software stack to enable realistic, repeatable testing long before systems take off.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Own the architecture of our simulation environments, building the software that connects flight simulators such as X-Plane and Flight Simulator with our autonomy and onboard software

  • Build and extend plugins, interfaces, and bridges that feed realistic flight behavior, sensor data, and mission scenarios into our systems

  • Enable software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing so GNC, embedded, and autonomy teams can validate new features quickly, safely, and repeatably

  • Raise engineering standards through design, code review, and close collaboration with GNC engineers. They bring the models and algorithms, you build the simulation software that brings them to life


Technical skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, plus 3+ years of professional software development (no GNC background required, this is a software-first role)

  • Hands-on experience building software for flight simulators such as X-Plane, Microsoft Flight Simulator, or Airbus flight simulation environments (e.g. plugins, SDKs, data interfaces)

  • Strong C++ skills for simulation and performance-critical software

  • Strong Python skills for tooling, scenario scripting, and test automation

  • Solid Linux experience, including development, debugging, and deployment on Linux-based systems

  • Experience designing modular, extensible software architectures for simulation or test environments

Soft Skills

  • Comfortable working in Scrum or similar agile teams

  • Strong software craftsmanship: testing, debugging, code review, and clear communication in English (German a plus)

  • Ownership mindset, you take responsibility for the simulation environment end to end and make sure it works reliably for every team

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2 (nodes, topics, services)

  • Familiarity with other simulation tools and frameworks (e.g. Gazebo, JSBSim, FlightGear, AirSim)

  • Experience with SITL/HIL setups, ideally with PX4, ArduPilot, or similar autopilot frameworks

  • Familiarity with MAVLink or similar vehicle/telemetry protocols

  • Experience simulating sensors such as cameras, IMUs, or radar

  • Automated simulation-based testing integrated into CI pipelines

  • Basic understanding of flight dynamics or GNC concepts (helpful, but not required)

  • Prior work in aerospace, robotics, autonomous systems, or defense

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site integration and test campaigns

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Forschungsprojektleiter:in Energiedaten & Gebäudetechnik (d/w/m)
descriptionHtml:
termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.

termios ist ein 2023 gegründetes Joint-Venture von mantro als Company Builder, dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen

Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.

Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.

Du startest dabei nicht bei null: Wir haben bereits zwei vom BMWE geförderte Forschungsprojekte und sind in weiteren Forschungsfeldern aktiv. Für dieses wachsende Portfolio suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt jemanden, der Forschung nicht nur organisiert, sondern selbst betreibt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Studiendesign und Feldversuche: Du übersetzt offene Fragen in prüfbare Hypothesen und ein belastbares Studiendesign mit Vergleichsgruppen, Baseline, Witterungsbereinigung und Messkonzept. Messkampagnen in realen Liegenschaften setzt du gemeinsam mit Field Service und Anlagentechnik um.

  • Datenanalyse: Du wertest Zeitreihen aus dem Gerätebestand und aus Messkampagnen selbst aus, quantifizierst Effekte und Unsicherheiten und trennst sauber zwischen Korrelation und Wirkung.

  • Ergebnisse: Du bereitest Erkenntnisse für Abschlussberichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzen und Kunden auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie in unsere Algorithmen und Produktentwicklung zurückfließen.

  • Projektleitung: Du steuerst mehrere parallel laufende Forschungs- und Pilotprojekte, von Arbeitspaketen und Meilensteinen über Budgets und Berichtspflichten bis zu Kooperationsverträgen, Datenschutz und Förderrichtlinien.

  • Förderung und Akquise: Du findest passende Förderprogramme auf Landes-, Bundes- und EU-Ebene, entwickelst Projektideen mit Partnern und schreibst Skizzen und Anträge.

Das bringst du mit

  • Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem ingenieur-, natur- oder datenwissenschaftlichen Fach, z. B. Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Bauphysik, Physik, Mathematik oder Informatik.

  • Forschungserfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der angewandten Forschung gearbeitet, etwa an einem Fraunhofer-Institut, einer anderen Forschungseinrichtung, einer Hochschule oder in einer F&E-Abteilung, idealerweise im Umfeld Gebäude, Energie oder TGA.

  • Methodik und Daten: Du hast Studien oder Messkampagnen selbst konzipiert und ausgewertet, wendest statistische Verfahren wie Regression, Zeitreihenanalyse und Hypothesentests sicher an und arbeitest dabei mit Python oder R sowie SQL.

  • Projektleitung: Du hast Projekte mit mehreren Partnern geleitet oder koordiniert und bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen.

  • Kommunikation: Du schreibst klar und belastbar, vom Förderantrag bis zur Veröffentlichung. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau.

Das ist ein Plus

Niemand bringt alles mit. Vieles davon lernst du bei uns.

  • Förderprojekte: Du hast schon Anträge geschrieben oder öffentlich geförderte Projekte abgewickelt.

  • Heizungstechnik: Du kennst dich mit Heizungshydraulik, hydraulischem Abgleich und Wärmeerzeugern wie Fernwärme oder Wärmepumpe aus.

  • Einsparnachweise: Du kennst Verfahren zur Messung und Verifikation von Einsparungen, z. B. IPMVP.

  • Modelle: Du hast Erfahrung mit Gebäudesimulation (z. B. Modelica, TRNSYS) oder Machine Learning.

  • Promotion oder eigene Publikationen

Gute Gründe, um bei uns durchzustarten

  • Forschung, die ankommt: Wenn du eine Hypothese an einem realen Gebäude prüfen willst, organisieren wir das. Was du herausfindest, landet im Produkt, und Veröffentlichungen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Hardware, Firmware, Funk, Cloud und Daten. Wer das gebaut hat, wonach du fragst, sitzt im selben Team.

  • Gestaltungsfreiraum ab dem ersten Tag, in einem agilen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid in Düsseldorf oder München, mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

  • Konditionen: Unbefristete Festanstellung, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub, Urban Sports und Corporate Benefits sowie regelmäßige Teamevents.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, gern mit Publikationsliste oder Links zu deinen Projekten. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schreib uns lieber ein paar Sätze dazu, welche Forschungsfrage dich bei uns besonders reizt.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Tailscale, you’ll be the bridge between our technical capabilities and the needs of our most strategic customers. You will work directly with customers to ensure their success with Tailscale’s products, helping them get onboarded, driving their long-term adoption, and providing expert technical guidance throughout their journey. This role requires a combination of technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and an empathetic customer-centric approach to ensure customers are fully empowered to leverage the power of Tailscale. The role will report directly to the Team Lead, Customer Success Engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the onboarding process for new strategic customers, ensuring they quickly understand and adopt Tailscale. Provide training and resources that set customers up for long-term success.
  • Offer technical support for customers, diagnosing and resolving issues across Tailscale's platform. Assist with configuration, integration, and troubleshooting to ensure smooth implementation.
  • Conduct QBRs with customers to review usage, success metrics, and future goals. Use these touchpoints to identify opportunities for deeper engagement and horizontal expansion.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor. Help customers optimize their use of Tailscale by identifying best practices, and by providing recommendations based on their specific use cases and desired business outcomes.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, relaying feedback and insights to the product and engineering teams to help improve the product and the customer experience.
  • Work closely with sales, product, engineering, and support teams to ensure smooth handoffs, escalate critical issues, and drive customer success across the organization.
  • Develop and maintain a repository of technical documentation, FAQs, and guides to help customers self-serve. Share insights and best practices with both the customer and internal teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ Years in a technical role with minimum 2 years of customer-facing experience (Solutions engineer/architect, Sr. Support Engineer, etc.)
  • Experience working with enterprise customers in a consultative capacity
  • Strong understanding of networking, VPNs, and security principles. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and other DevOps technologies
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer/architect, or Customer Success Engineer at a SaaS company
  • Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to a diverse audience, from non-technical stakeholders to engineers. Strong written and verbal communication skills are a must
  • Analytical mindset and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to think critically and methodically to resolve complex technical issues
  • A passion for delivering excellent customer service and a strong focus on building long-term customer relationships
  • Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and keep projects on track. Strong time management and organizational skills are key
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with product, sales, and engineering teams to deliver customer success

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

The role

This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last.

It is not a support role. It is a build role, deployed forward, defining a new function rather than filling a seat. You will be based at our London factory, with roughly 30 to 50 per cent of your time embedded at other sites. We are open to graduate and experienced engineers. The package includes equity.

  • Run onboarding, training and day-to-day adoption with machinists, engineers and site operators.

  • Turn repeated support questions into playbooks, training material or self-service tools. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed.

  • Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status.

  • Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer.

  • Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap.

What you bring

  • The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision.

  • Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows.

  • Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site.

  • The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue.

  • Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems.

Eliott (CEO) and Hugo (CTO) have more topics to open than time to work on them: the US launch, new verticals, new countries, a finance function to structure. Maxime, our Chief of Staff, turns their priorities into projects, and his own scope is growing fast.

Your mission

Take on the topics Eliott and Hugo cannot dig into themselves and bring each one to a result they can use: a quantified recommendation they can decide on, a model or a process the team works with, or an experiment with measured results.

Expected outcomes

After 1 month:

  • You know the product, our customers and how each team works, in France and in the US

  • You run two or three recurring topics on your own

  • You have designed and run at least one growth experiment, from hypothesis to a statistical reading of the results, with a recommendation to scale or stop

  • At least one of your recommendations has become a company decision

What you will work on

You cannot list everything a Founder Associate does. This is what your day-to-day looks like.

Market exploration

  • Run quantified studies on new verticals and new countries: market sizing, segmentation, go-to-market modeling

  • Run product and competitive benchmarks

  • Bring structured recommendations back to the founders

Growth and US sales enablement

  • Design growth experiments and measure them: hypotheses, metrics, statistical reading of the results

Finance structuring

  • Build financial models with Maxime: unit economics, expansion scenarios, sensitivity to pricing assumptions

  • Build the reports used to steer the company

  • Run the analyses the founders need to make a decision

Public affairs

  • Follow the regulation of AI in healthcare and the public debate around it, and flag what affects us

  • Map the public bodies, health authorities and professional organizations that matter for Vocca, in France and in the US

  • Prepare the founders' meetings with them: briefs, position notes, follow-ups

Founder branding

  • Make Eliott and Hugo known and listened to in two communities: the healthcare professionals who buy Vocca, and the talent we want to hire

  • Run their content with them: LinkedIn posts, talks, events

  • Track what works with each audience and adjust

Ops playbook, depending on your profile

Depending on what you thrive in, business, engineering or something else, you can also take ownership of pieces of our Ops playbook: the process by which we deploy a voice agent in a new clinic, from configuration to go-live.

  • Map each step and instrument it with the right data

  • Find where time and quality are lost

  • Redesign the process so it scales from hundreds to thousands of sites without growing the team at the same rate

Beyond this list

Depending on what you are good at and what you want to learn, you will pick up other topics: recruiting, internal operations, internal communication.

This role is for you if

Requirements:

  • You are in your final year at a top-tier engineering or business school and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in January 2027

  • You have already built something: you ran a student society, launched a project, or worked in a demanding environment such as a startup, a bank or a consulting firm

  • You are fluent in French and English

What we will assess:

  • You understand fast, and you can turn a vague question into a structured answer with a recommendation

  • You have strong business sense. You will work with the founders and Maxime every day

  • You are at ease with numbers and data: you can build a model, size a market and read the results of an experiment

  • You are very autonomous and organized. You manage up: you say what you need, raise blockers early and follow up without being asked

  • You are entrepreneurial. You know the startup world, you love tech, and you want to start a company one day

This role is NOT for you if

After the internship

We built this internship as a way into Vocca. If it goes well, we want you to stay full time, in a role we define together based on what you did best.

Compensation and benefits

  • €2,000 gross per month

Why should you join Vocca?

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt: Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist.

  • Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte: Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert.

  • Du bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess: Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl – und testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI reflexhaft, nicht gelegentlich. Du hast eigene Agents, Automatisierungen oder Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), testest neue Modelle sofort und weißt, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst das System hinter dem einzelnen Kunden. Beim zweiten Mal baust du den Prozess, der das manuelle Lösen überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn für die nächste Person.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du prüfst Daten, verfolgst Flows, liest Logs und grenzt Probleme sauber ein – und behebst sie, wo es geht, selbst mit KI-Tools. Du bist in der Software zu Hause, nicht nur in der Präsentation darüber.

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss.

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

  • Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience und bestimmst Prozesse, Tools, Standards und Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

  • Customer Experience ist einer von sechs, sieben Bereichen, die alago tragen – und du besitzt ihn.

  • Du sitzt am Tisch, wenn die Entscheidungen fallen, die die Firma prägen. Der Weg führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

  • KI-Unternehmen suchen händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt zugleich beherrschen – bei Palantir heißt das Forward Deployed Engineer.

  • Du lernst, Vertrauen aufzubauen, schwierige Gespräche zu führen und Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert zu begleiten.

  • Ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, Pairing mit dem Engineering-Team und echte Code-Reviews. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen.

Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert

  • Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 16 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren.

  • Du knackst den Code, wie Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar werden – und nimmst dieses Playbook überallhin mit.

Du beschleunigst deine Entwicklung

  • Ob eigene Gründung oder Head of Customer Experience: Halbjährliche Performance-Reviews, konkrete Entwicklungsschritte alle ~9 Monate.

  • Wöchentliche Trainings, erfahrene Coaches und Mentor:innen und eine umfangreiche Bibliothek.

Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern

  • Tag für Tag mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain).

  • Frühe Phase heißt: viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, in die Rolle zu wachsen, die zu deinen Stärken passt.

Zusätzlich

  • Wellpass, zweimal pro Woche Team-Dinner und Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Arbeitsplatz im WERK1, einem der aktivsten Startup-Hubs Münchens.

Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung

  2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

  3. Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (40 Minuten)

  4. Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen

  5. Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉
