title: Founding Product Manager - Claap
descriptionHtml:
we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO.

About Claap

Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams.

What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work.

This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible.

Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade.

We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM.

As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one.

You will work with Robin on three big topics:

- In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching.

- Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app.

- Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics.

The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing).

Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached.

Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together.

The PM at Claap wears different hats

- A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed

- A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance

- An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe

- A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation

- A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it

What you are not

- A Project Manager who only talks about methodologies and frameworks

- A Product Owner writing super detailed 4-page tickets for devs

- A feature factory building every custom request an enterprise prospect asks for

- The "Notion docs & meetings person" with no real impact on our users and the business

- A "yes man" for every idea and suggestion people bring to you

- A people manager looking for a team to run: this role is hands-on

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

- Developed a deep understanding of Claap, the call intelligence market and our product vision

- Built relationships with Claap users, from sales reps to the admins of our largest accounts

- Mapped the enterprise requirements that slow down or block our deals, and shipped the first ones

- Identified the key closing jobs to be done and shipped first iterations with your squad

- Won the trust of your squad, Robin, and the Sales and CS teams

Within 12 months you will have

- Made Claap truly enterprise-ready: governance, settings and configuration are no longer a reason we lose a deal

- Made Claap a must-have in our users' closing workflow, with measurable adoption and retention

- Positively impacted the company's revenue through solutions you've helped launch

- Influenced the Claap product vision by suggesting transformative developments

What's in it for you?

- A founding role: you're the first PM at Claap, with real ownership on a fast-growing AI product and a direct line to the founders

- Helping thousands of sales professionals close more deals

- A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action

- Opportunity to shape our company's direction

- Potential to establish yourself as an expert in AI for sales

Preferred experience

Must have

- You have 5+ years of experience in product. Scale-up experience is highly preferred.

- You have a strong academic background (business school, engineering school or equivalent) and/or experience in top-tier companies.

- You are a hands-on PM: you are an individual contributor today, or you led product at an early-stage startup.

- You have a real taste and curiosity for AI and tech, ideally with features or agents you've launched end to end.

- You have a big bias for action: you are a "débrouillard" and understand the value of speed & execution.

- You have strong communication skills.

- You speak French and English. This is non-negotiable: most of our enterprise accounts are French-speaking.

- You have a strong pragmatism.

- You have a solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms.

- You have a strong business acumen.

Nice to have

- You have experience in enterprise or upper mid-market SaaS (permissions, admin, SSO, security reviews).

- You have worked on sales tech, revenue intelligence or tools used by sales teams.

- You have Growth, Revenue Operations or Sales experience.

- You know how to wireframe designs.

- You are humble and look for clues that you are wrong.

- You are curious, always asking questions and learning new stuff.

Additional Information

- Competitive salary + profit sharing

- Where you live and work is totally up to you: we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷

- Profit sharing: when lempire wins, all team members share the profits

- Alan Blue: comprehensive 100% premium medical coverage for you and your family

- Swile Meal Tickets: daily meal tickets to fuel productivity

- Navigo Card: 100% covered Navigo card

- Full-remote work setup: a well-funded home office budget

- Gear: a laptop + the tools and equipment you need for your job

- Team building: we all meet once a year at really cool places around the world

Recruitment process

- Interview with Victoire, our Talent Acquisition Manager

- Interview with Robin, Claap co-founder and CEO

- Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Robin and Pierre

- Team fit

- Interview with Charles, our CEO

- Reference Check

- Offer

How to apply

Include a short note (200 words max) on an AI feature or agent you shipped end to end. It's the hardest thing to read on a CV, so we screen for it from day one.

title: Friseurmeister (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei flaconi glauben, dass Diversität Kreativität, Innovation und Wachstum fördert. Diese Diversität lebt in allen Formen von Beauty. Deshalb ist auch unser Team ein Mosaik aus Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Kulturen und Lebenswegen, die eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für die Beauty-Welt verbindet. Unser Engagement basiert auf unseren Grundwerten, insbesondere #trustinpeople. Wir übernehmen bewusst die Verantwortung für ein Umfeld, in dem jede:r Mitarbeiter:in aufrichtig wertgeschätzt und gehört wird und in dem jede:r die Möglichkeit hat, eine einzigartige Perspektive einzubringen, um das Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit zu stärken.

flaconi setzt sich als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßt und ermutigt alle qualifizierten Bewerbern mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund und Identität, unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Geschlechtsidentität, Migrationshintergrund, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderungsstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Alter, sich zu bewerben.

Als unser/e neue/r Friseurmeister:in (all genders) schaffst du außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und prägst gleichzeitig die kreative und operative Exzellenz unseres Salon-Teams. Du bringst Expertise in den Bereichen Schnitt, Farbe und Styling mit – kombiniert mit der Leidenschaft, andere zu fördern und eine Kultur aus Beauty, Professionalität und Innovation voranzutreiben.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du sowohl direkt am Gast als auch im operativen Tagesgeschäft unseres Salons. Dabei behältst du den Fokus auf den Verkauf und das Erreichen kommerzieller Ziele, während du für eine reibungslose Koordination, herausragende Servicequalität und ein motiviertes, leistungsstarkes Team sorgst.

Deine Rolle

  • Du bietest erstklassige Services wie Beratung, Schnitt, Farbe und Styling nach den Premium-Standards von flaconi an.
  • Du bleibst über Trends, Techniken und Produkte auf dem Laufenden, um sowohl Kund:innen als auch Kolleg:innen zu inspirieren.
  • Du schaffst personalisierte Beauty-Erlebnisse, die die Kundenbindung und -zufriedenheit stärken.
  • Durch professionelle Beratung unterstützt du den Zusatzverkauf von Produkten und Dienstleistungen (Upselling).
  • Du steuerst die Terminplanung, den Salonbetrieb und das Inventar im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen.
  • Du stellst die Einhaltung von Hygiene-, Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards sicher.
  • Du arbeitest mit den Retail- und Marketing-Teams zusammen, um In-Store-Kampagnen und Events umzusetzen.
  • Du förderst die Teamleistung, bearbeitest Kundenfeedback und stärkst eine positive, inklusive Arbeitskultur.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist zertifizierte/r Friseurmeister:in mit mehrjähriger praktischer Erfahrung im Salon.
  • Du bringst nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Teamleitung oder im Salonmanagement mit.
  • Du besitzt starke Kommunikations-, Mentoring- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.
  • Du brennst für Beauty, Trends und eine außergewöhnliche Customer Experience.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du hast eine proaktive Hands-on-Mentalität, ein Gespür für Stil und Liebe zum Detail.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind uns wichtig: Wir bieten dir einen befristeten Arbeitsvertrag an und übernehmen die Kosten deines Deutschland Tickets.
  • Work-Life-Balance: 29 Urlaubstage plus 2 zusätzliche freie Tage: 24. und 31. Dezember und die Möglichkeit eines bezahlten Sabbaticals.
  • flaconi Academy: Mit unseren internen und externen Weiterbildungsangeboten kannst du deinen eigenen Karriereweg aktiv gestalten.
  • Mitarbeiter:innenrabatte & andere Vergünstigungen: Tolle Rabatte in unserem Online-Shop sowie bei Partnerunternehmen, coole Teamevents & Firmenfeiern!
  • Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Wir möchten dich auch in schwierigen Zeiten unterstützen. Dazu bieten wir dir und deinen Angehörigen Beratungsgespräche mit psychologischen Fachkräften an.
  • Gemeinsam an morgen denken: flaconi bezuschusst deinen Sparbeitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit zusätzlichen 20%.

Über flaconi

flaconi ist einer der führenden deutschen Online-Kosmetikhändler mit einem umfangreichen Portfolio von fast 1000 Marken und 50.000 Produkten. Von Drogerie über Bio-Kosmetik bis hin zu Premium und Luxus decken die Online-Shops in Deutschland, Frankreich, Österreich, Polen und der Schweiz alle Produktsegmente ab und bieten eine vielfältige Auswahl an Produkten für eine einzigartige und tägliche Beauty-Routine.

2011 als eine der ersten Online-Parfümerien gegründet, arbeitet flaconi heute mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeitern aus 60 verschiedenen Nationen in der flaconi-Zentrale in Berlin-Charlottenburg und im Fulfillment-Center in Halle.

Gestalte mit uns den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens und bewirb dich jetzt online! Wir freuen uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen inklusive deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. 

flaconi akzeptiert keine unaufgeforderten Lebensläufe aus anderen Quellen (z.B. Personaldienstleister) als direkt von einem Bewerber.

KI-Hinweis

Wir setzen KI-gestützte Tools ein, um einzelne Schritte unseres Recruiting-Prozesses effizienter zu gestalten und zu unterstützen. Diese Tools helfen unserem Recruiting-Team beispielsweise dabei, passende Kandidaten zu identifizieren, Bewerbungen zu priorisieren oder recruitingrelevante Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen.

Die KI trifft dabei keine Einstellungsentscheidungen. Jede Bewerbung wird von Menschen geprüft und bewertet, und sämtliche Personalentscheidungen erfolgen unter menschlicher Aufsicht und Verantwortung. Unser KI-System wird regelmäßig auf mögliche Verzerrungen überprüft und verfügt über eine ISO 42001-Zertifizierung für KI-Governance. 

Bei Fragen zum Einsatz der KI oder zur Erläuterung der Kriterien können Sie sich jederzeit an unser Talent Acquisition team (

Das angebotene Gehalt wird stets innerhalb dieses Rahmens liegen und basiert auf den Ergebnissen des Rekrutierungsprozesses.

About us

Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 students and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

 

About the role

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) you'll play a key role in shaping and building our product at Zenjob. Working across the full stack, including event-driven backend services and polished user-facing interfaces, you'll collaborate closely with product managers and stakeholders, set engineering standards, and mentor others along the way. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment and want to make a real impact on a product used by thousands of workers and businesses, we'd love to hear from you.

 

How you will contribute

  • Design, develop, and own end-to-end features-from ideation and technical proposal through to production deployment and ongoing maintenance.

  • Build and evolve backend services and frontend applications using TypeScript and Java, leveraging gRPC as our primary service communication protocol

title: Fullstack Entwickler Java / Angular (m/w/d) – Mid-Level
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams. Du übernimmst eigene Features von der Schnittstelle bis zur Oberfläche, erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind ansprechbar.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung mit Java/Spring Boot und Angular

  • Features eigenständig umsetzen, testen und ausliefern

  • Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor

  • Code Reviews geben und bekommen

  • Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, UX und DevOps

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist das aber keiner. Beim Kunden vor Ort bist du nur für einzelne Termine alle paar Wochen, meist in Frankfurt am Main.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt: Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel, öffentlicher Sektor und Behörden, Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwickler, gezählt nach Ausbildung oder Studium.

Das erwarten wir:

  • Java (17+) und Spring Boot

  • Angular mit TypeScript

  • REST-Schnittstellen und relationale Datenbanken, vor allem PostgreSQL

  • Tests mit JUnit als Teil der Definition of Done

  • Git, CI/CD, agiles Arbeiten

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • LLM-Integration in Anwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten), auch aus einem Nebenprojekt

  • Docker und Kubernetes, Kafka

  • Kotlin, Camunda (BPMN-Prozessautomatisierung), Keycloak/OAuth 2.0

  • AWS oder Azure, JPA/Hibernate

  • Frontend-Tests (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA)

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Unsere Kunden erwarten das, und wir arbeiten auch so. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest

  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)

  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte

  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Geschäftsführer (m/w/d)

Stahlbau | Technisches Projektgeschäft | Internationalisierung

Region Dresden / Südbrandenburg | Vertrauliches Suchmandat

Für ein etabliertes mittelständisches Unternehmen mit dem Kerngeschäft Stahlbau suche ich eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die unternehmerisch denkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und das Unternehmen in seine nächste Entwicklungsphase führt.

Unser Mandant realisiert anspruchsvolle Stahlbauprojekte für Kunden aus Industrie und Infrastruktur. Das Leistungsspektrum reicht von der technischen Planung über die eigene Fertigung bis zur Umsetzung komplexer Projekte.

Das Unternehmen verfügt über gewachsene Strukturen, langjährige Erfahrung und eine etablierte Marktposition. Nun geht es darum, das bestehende Geschäft weiterzuentwickeln, neue Märkte zu erschließen und insbesondere die Internationalisierung voranzutreiben.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Operative und strategische Gesamtverantwortung für das Unternehmen

  • Weiterentwicklung des bestehenden Geschäfts und Erschließung neuer Märkte

  • Ausbau nationaler und internationaler Kundenbeziehungen

  • Wirtschaftliche Steuerung komplexer technischer Projekte mit hohen Auftragsvolumina

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Vertrieb, Projektmanagement, Technik, Fertigung und kaufmännischen Bereichen

  • Optimierung bestehender Strukturen und Prozesse

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gesellschafter bei der strategischen Unternehmensentwicklung

Ihr Profil

  • Mehrjährige Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung, idealerweise als Geschäftsführer oder in einer vergleichbaren Position

  • Umfangreiche Erfahrung im technisch anspruchsvollen Projektgeschäft, beispielsweise im Stahlbau, industriellen Anlagenbau, Maschinenbau oder angrenzenden Industriezweigen

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Geschäftsentwicklung, im Vertrieb und in der wirtschaftlichen Unternehmenssteuerung

  • Fundierte technische und betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikation

  • Internationale Geschäftserfahrung und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, Entscheidungsstärke und die Bereitschaft, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für den Mittelstand, seine Strukturen und die Menschen, die dort arbeiten. Sie führen auf Augenhöhe, sind nah an den Mitarbeitern und wissen, wie man eine Mannschaft mitnimmt.

Ihre Perspektive

Sie übernehmen die Führung eines etablierten mittelständischen Stahlbauunternehmens mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und einer klaren strategischen Entwicklungsaufgabe.

Gesucht wird keine Persönlichkeit, die lediglich bestehende Strukturen verwaltet, sondern jemand, der eigene Ideen einbringt, wirtschaftliche Chancen erkennt und das Unternehmen nachhaltig weiterentwickelt.

Die Suche erfolgt deutschlandweit. Voraussetzung ist die Bereitschaft, künftig am Unternehmensstandort in der Region Dresden / Südbrandenburg tätig zu sein.

Interesse?

Die Suche erfolgt im Rahmen eines vertraulichen Executive-Search-Mandats. Die Identität meines Auftraggebers wird im persönlichen Austausch offengelegt.

Ich freue mich über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Selbstverständlich wird jede Anfrage vertraulich behandelt.

title: Global Network Growth Managing Director
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

The Role

As the Growth Managing Director, you will own a defined enterprise growth domain and are personally accountable for hunting, triaging, shaping and progressing live WPP Enterprise Solutions opportunities within it. Large organisations create ambiguity. Your job is not to manage it internally; it is to resolve it commercially.

This is an active commercial role, not a strategic advisory one. You sit close to live client work, and your value is measured by the momentum you create: turning relationships, market signals and direct client needs into qualified, moving ES opportunities. You are a senior commercial operator who does not wait for a brief to arrive in its final form or for the organisation to clear a path before you act. You find the signal, you qualify it, you shape it, and you drive it forward.

This role is as much for the person ready to step into full commercial ownership as it is for the seasoned enterprise growth operator. What we are looking for is not a specific tenure; it is a specific kind of commercial maturity.

Core Responsibilities

Identify & Qualify:

  • Lead a defined area of Enterprise Growth, such as WPP Media, WPP Creative, GCL / Top Accounts, WPP Open / Data / AI, Enterprise Growth Architecture, Commercial Architecture or Solution Architecture and take personal accountability for everything that moves within it
  • Actively identify and pursue ES growth opportunities through WPP relationships, direct client signals, agency teams, GCLs, platform opportunities, partner motions and enterprise transformation needs, not waiting for leads to come to you, but going to find them before anyone else has
  • Work directly and consistently with client leaders, GCLs, agency leaders, media and creative leadership, consulting teams, partner teams and ES capability owners; building the kind of trust that means you are called first, not copied in later

Shape & Pursue:

  • Assess opportunity fit, revenue potential, urgency, readiness, route to client, stakeholder access, competitive context and activation requirements, with the rigour and speed to know quickly what to pursue, what to park and what to pass on
  • Create clear problem statements, opportunity briefs, points of view, value hypotheses, stakeholder maps and pursuit recommendations, giving live opportunities the strategic structure and narrative they need to move forward with confidence
  • Lead discovery, workshops, executive conversations, proposal direction, credentials, pilots and pitch development where needed, owning the early stages that determine whether an opportunity gains real traction or quietly loses momentum

Own & Build:

  • Bring together ES capabilities across CRM, commerce, CX, content, data, AI, platforms, media, measurement, marketing technology and managed services; assembling the right combination of expertise around a live opportunity rather than defaulting to a generic response
  • Maintain ownership of next actions and commercial momentum until the opportunity is ready for formal pursuit, activation, handoff or expansion, ensuring nothing stalls because no one was accountable for the next step
  • Identify repeatable themes, playbook needs, case study requirements and market signals that help WPP Enterprise Solutions scale its growth motion, contributing to the system that makes the next opportunity easier to find, shape and win

Who you are

  • You are a senior growth leader equally at home in a strategy conversation, a client meeting, a commercial negotiation and the execution that follows, because for you, these are not separate modes; they are the same job
  • You build trust quickly with senior stakeholders and navigate complex global matrix environments without losing pace or clarity, moving across lines of authority and geography as a natural part of how you work, not as an obstacle you manage around
  • You bring genuine domain fluency in one or more of media, creative, consulting, platforms, marketing technology, CRM, commerce, data, AI, content or transformation, enough to be credible in client conversations, not simply directionally informed
  • You can spot opportunity patterns before they become obvious, qualify what deserves your energy and resist the temptation to turn ambiguity into internal process noise
  • You are high-agency, collaborative and commercially mature, able to move across teams, create momentum and make things happen without waiting for perfect structure or explicit permission

What you'll need

  • You bring typically 12 to 15 or more years of experience across enterprise growth, strategic account growth, consulting, technology transformation, digital transformation, media transformation, agency leadership, enterprise sales or client leadership, with a career that has consistently placed you at the point where commercial decisions are made, not downstream of them
  • You have direct experience originating or shaping opportunities with measurable revenue potential, and you can point to them specifically, not just describe them in aggregate
  • You understand how enterprise clients buy transformation, technology, marketing, data, customer experience and managed services solutions, not as an academic proposition, but from having sat across the table from the people making those decisions and learned how they actually think
  • Your background may have been built inside WPP operating companies, major agency networks, consulting firms, systems integrators, digital transformation firms, technology companies, media networks or platform businesses. What matters is whether that background taught you how to find opportunity, qualify it honestly and move it forward in a complex, high-pressure commercial environment
  • You have a proven ability to work across senior clients and internal stakeholders across multiple disciplines and markets, and a track record that reflects genuine accountability for commercial outcomes, not just meaningful involvement in them

title: Global PR Operations Lead - 12 month FTC
descriptionHtml:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Global PR Lead to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About the role
(Hybrid)

This is a role at the heart of our fast-paced, high-volume PR team, helping keep our communications flying in formation across 23 markets worldwide. You’ll be the central point connecting plans, people, budgets, agencies and operations — making sure our global PR machine runs smoothly, efficiently and at scale.

Working closely with our Senior Director of Communications, regional PR leads, internal teams and global agency partners, you’ll help turn our international PR strategy into coordinated action. From shaping global initiatives to sharpening the way we plan, measure and operate, you’ll bring the structure that helps brilliant PR ideas travel further.

What you’ll be doing

  • Driving global PR planning: You’ll lead the planning process with our global PR agency hub, partnering with the Senior Director of Communications to keep forecasting, budgets, resources and priorities aligned.

  • Turning measurement into momentum: You’ll work closely with our measurement lead to make sure reporting is accurate, useful and connected to the strategies and decisions that matter.

  • Optimising our PR ecosystem: You’ll partner with Procurement and Finance to make sure we have the right suppliers, commercial setup and financial tracking in place to support growth — without the spreadsheet drama.

  • Keeping priorities moving: You’ll traffic-manage inbound requests, help the team navigate competing priorities and make sure resources are focused where they can have the greatest impact.

  • Leading global PR initiatives: You’ll spearhead strategic PR initiatives and special projects beyond our core campaigns, while supporting the delivery of our Awareness strategy and Big Bet activity through PR.

  • Making operations smarter: You’ll lead and collaborate on cross-functional improvements spanning tools and technology, including Tableau, ThoughtSpot, AI and our Product Ops model — finding smarter ways for a global team to work at scale.

  • Creating consistency across markets: You’ll partner with market leads, our global agency hub and Corporate and B2B PR teams to develop playbooks, strengthen processes and drive consistent adoption and delivery across 23 markets. You’ll also manage and develop our PR Coordinator, keeping calendars, finance trackers and reporting firmly on course.

About you

  • Global PR operator: You’ve worked in complex, international communications environments and know how to turn lots of moving parts into one joined-up plan.

  • Strategic and operational: You’re equally comfortable shaping a global PR initiative and getting into the detail needed to make it happen. Big picture, meet beautifully organised spreadsheet.

  • Stakeholder savvy: You build trusted relationships across senior leaders, market teams, agencies and cross-functional partners, bringing people together around shared priorities.

  • Agency confident: You know how to get the best from global agency relationships, balancing clear direction, strong partnership and accountability for delivery.

  • Commercially switched-on: You’re comfortable working with budgets, forecasting, suppliers, Procurement and Finance, and you understand how strong operational foundations help teams achieve more.

  • Tech and data curious: You’re interested in how measurement, dashboards, AI and smarter tools can improve PR operations, reporting and decision-making at scale.

  • Calm in the whirlwind: You thrive in fast-paced environments, can prioritise when everything feels important, and enjoy helping teams work more effectively. You’re also comfortable managing and developing others along the way.


What it's like here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

title: Go-To-Market Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at United Media

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

We are looking for an exceptional Industrial Designer to join our award-winning creative team. Our design team create breakthrough physical and digital products for some of the world’s most innovative brands. This is a hands-on role where the ability to visualise and deliver exciting user centred solutions is essential.  You will have the opportunity to contribute to a range of projects across industries such as Healthcare, Industrial, Consumer, Energy, and Defence.    This position offers an excellent opportunity to immerse yourself in a fast-paced, diverse, and creative environment, whilst contributing your own flair to our team.   Successful candidates can join us between May-October 2027. There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

About the role

Championing user experience and brand is central to our work at CC, and Industrial Designers lead this thinking for our clients. You will work in diverse multifunctional project teams together with highly talented engineers, scientists and designers to generate innovative solutions and develop world-leading medical, consumer and wider products for our clients around the globe. You will be using your design skills to contribute to a wide variety of development projects with support and guidance from seniors, from initial idea generation through to the delivery and manufacturing support for market ready products. At Cambridge Consultants we work on complex and challenging briefs and our clients look to us to shape their futures. You will work alongside other designers to craft compelling design outputs.   • Create clear and impactful presentations to convey ideas to clients and development teams. There will be opportunities to interact with clients.
  • Prepare designs at a range of fidelities i.e., from sketches to detailed 3D renders or animations
  • Manufacture prototypes, hands-on or by liaising with suppliers
  • Evaluate user needs and designs at user studies
  • Share your skills and experience with the wider design team whilst also receiving mentorship from experienced designers
 

What you’ll need

A successful designer at CC will:
  • Be a talented and creative Industrial Designer who is an enthusiastic team player
  • A top degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related design discipline
  • An excellent portfolio demonstrating your visual flair, meticulous attention to detail and ability to communicate innovative designs in a clear and attractive way.
  • Mastery of graphical presentation tools (e.g. hand sketching, Creative Cloud, 3D rendering)
  • Strong ability to use CAD tools to design attractive, functional and manufacturable designs (e.g., SolidWorks)

Additionally, experience designing a digital and physical user experience would be advantageous although not a necessity.   We cannot accept applications that do not include a portfolio.

title: Head of Talent
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role: hire the best, fast

As Head of Talent Acquisition, you own how Andercore hires: from the hiring plan to the signed contract, across engineering, product, data, commercial and operations. You report to the CEO and work closely with every member of the leadership team.

We are growing fast, and in a small team every hire changes what the company can do. Today, hiring runs through our hiring managers, a few search partners and a lot of individual effort. What we don't have yet is a repeatable system that consistently finds exceptional people, especially the driven, curious builders who rarely apply through standard channels.

Your job is to build that talent engine: direct sourcing, an employer brand that reaches the right people, a structured and fast process, and search partners that deliver. You go deep on every critical search yourself, try new channels and formats, and make the whole function AI-native, so a small talent team can hire at the pace of a scale-up.

What you will do: build the talent engine

01 Hiring plan and strategy

  • Translate the company plan into a hiring plan with leadership, and prioritise the roles that matter most.

  • Own headcount forecasting together with Finance.

  • Report on pipeline health, speed and quality, and act on what the numbers show.

02 Direct sourcing and employer brand

  • Build in-house sourcing so most hires come directly or through referrals.

  • Tell Andercore's story where builders are: events, communities, content and our own team.

  • Set up a referral programme that our people actually use.

03 A structured, fast process

  • Define interview loops, scorecards and hiring committees with leadership, and train hiring managers to use them.

  • Keep time-to-offer short without lowering the bar.

  • Make the candidate experience excellent, from scheduling to feedback.

04 Search partners

  • Select and manage search partners on clear terms, and brief them sharply.

  • Hold them to quality, and use executive search only where it pays off.

05 AI-native recruiting

  • Use AI and our applicant tracking system to automate screening, outreach, scheduling and reporting.

  • Run recruiting on data: funnel conversion, source quality and time-to-hire.

06 Lead and close

  • Build and lead the talent team.

  • Own the most critical searches yourself, including leadership roles, and close offers with candidates and hiring managers.

What success looks like: great people, hired fast

  • Critical roles filled with people who raise the bar, on time

  • Most hires through direct sourcing and referrals, with lower agency spend

  • Short time-to-offer and a high offer acceptance rate

  • Hiring managers use consistent scorecards and calibrate together

  • Candidates, including those we turn down, would recommend our process

title: Health Data Protection and Data Licensing Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check whether a company has the legal right to use the health data its business depends on, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in data and AI companies. Buyers in life sciences want to know that client data is handled lawfully, deleted when it should be, and not used for anything the contracts do not allow.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Confirm who is the controller and who is the processor for each type of data, and check the data processing agreements in place.

  • Review client contracts to see whether client data may be used to improve AI workflows, test suites or models.

  • Check how data is deleted when contracts end, and whether that is possible where data has shaped models or tests.

  • Review licences for real world data from third party providers, and what happens to them if the company changes owner.

  • Check data transfers outside the UK, including any use of outside AI providers.

  • Check HIPAA readiness where US health data is involved.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years advising on data protection in health, pharmaceutical or life sciences settings.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and international data transfers. HIPAA knowledge is a strong plus.

  • Experience reviewing data processing agreements and data licences.

  • A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate, or legal practice in data protection.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience of AI and data rights, or of due diligence work, is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £450 to £600 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
descriptionHtml:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

title: Integration and Test Engineer (Software)
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Maritime International Engineering : International - Integration and Test
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril we are developing multi-domain unmanned systems that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of integrated multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects require Integration and Test Engineers with hands-on experience to drive the delivery of hardware-focused capabilities to our customers. Anduril I&T Engineers rapidly develop expertise in new domains in order to architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation capabilities through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work within a dynamic team of multidisciplinary engineers and specialists throughout the life of AUV design, integration, and test efforts
  • Support design and integration of AUV subsystems and components, including electrical systems and software
  • Develop, build and operate physical integration environments to support system maturity efforts
  • Write software to automate testing of hardware and software systems, including test frameworks and data analysis tools
  • Debug and troubleshoot electrical and software integration issues
  • Write, review and execute test plans for internal and customer-facing efforts to test and evaluate AUV platforms and new capabilities
  • Provides subject matter expertise to test operations for AUV platforms, including conducting pre-mission testing, vehicle tasking, and data analysis
  • Support infield debug, repair, operation, and maintenance of AUVs
  • May be in the field up to 20% of the time, supporting nearshore and offshore testing

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A genuine interest and 4+ years experience in software, mechatronic, electrical or systems engineering, with a focus on integration and test
  • Proficiency in software development for test automation and data analysis
  • Strong experience with Linux, command line interfaces and network debugging
  • Knowledge of electronics troubleshooting and hands-on experience using test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes and logic analysers
  • Familiarity with embedded systems, sensor integration, or robotics control concepts
  • Familiarity with concepts of mechanical engineering and control theory
  • Extremely organised and detail-oriented with strong analytical problem-solving skills
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills
  • A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture
  • Experience with subsea operational procedures and equipment (including AUV launch and recovery systems) is advantageous, as is vehicle level testing (any domain)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Security Clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Interim Senior Consultant Strategy & Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Freelance | Hybrid, Netherlands | Interim, immediate start

Riverflex supports technology leaders at major organisations, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join us on an interim basis. You'll work within a Riverflex team, alongside our in-house consultants and reporting into a Riverflex project lead. The client will know you as part of the Riverflex team, not as a standalone contractor.

Current opportunity

A leading European retailer is merging its regional technology departments. You'll work with the leadership team that reports to the CTO to shape, document and drive the convergence plan. That includes team changes, the case for funding and how the plan is communicated across the organisation.

We're looking for a strong communicator with a top-tier consulting background. You'll pull ideas out of senior people's heads, structure them and turn them into a clear story. You also need to challenge the thinking so the message gets sharper. This is a strategy and storytelling role, not project management.

About Riverflex

Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018 and is now a global team of consultants helping courageous leaders drive intelligent transformation. We work across three pillars: strategy and transformation consulting, talent services, and AI products. www.riverflex.com

What you'll do

  • You'll own a clear workstream within the wider Riverflex project, working daily with the project lead and the team and reporting on progress several times a week.

  • You'll interview senior stakeholders and turn what you hear into a structured plan, a narrative and executive-ready materials.

  • You'll run workshops that help client leaders agree on decisions, priorities and next steps.

  • You'll challenge client thinking constructively, asking “what do you mean by that?” and “have you considered X?” so the final message holds up.

  • You'll build storylines and slide decks for different audiences, from C-suite updates to communications for project teams.

  • You'll re-plan quickly when priorities shift, and add value from week one.

  • You'll uphold Riverflex's quality standards: your work is reviewed and joined into the wider team's deliverables before it reaches the client.


Job requirements

  • 5-7 years' experience, including strategy or technology consulting at an MBB or Big 4 firm, Accenture or similar

  • Excellent PowerPoint and storytelling skills: you can turn complex, unstructured input into a sharp storyline

  • Experience running workshops and stakeholder interviews

  • Business change or change communications experience

  • A collaborative, low-ego style, and comfortable working within a team and reporting into a project lead

  • Available immediately; based in the Netherlands and able to be on site in Amsterdam around two days a week

  • Fluent English and the right to work in the EU

Nice to have

  • Experience with a post-merger integration or a reorganisation of technology teams

  • Experience designing or running communications programmes

  • Comfort using AI-enabled ways of working

Why this role

You'll do senior-level strategy work for a technology leadership team, with real input into the thinking from day one and the support of a Riverflex team around you. We have several engagements in progress, so strong delivery can lead to further interim work, and we're open to talking about permanent roles for the right people.

Apply now

Send us your CV and a short note on your most relevant experience, through Recruitee or by contacting our talent team. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share three or more anonymised slide decks they created themselves before the interview.

Riverflex is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic. If you don't meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we'd still love to hear from you.

title: International Expansion - Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

title: Junior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the Role

As a Junior Data Platform Engineer, you'll work alongside senior team members to tackle complex challenges, while taking ownership of your own areas of the problem, in a fast-paced environment where no two days look the same. The role is fundamentally about problem solving: understanding business challenges, breaking them down, and delivering pragmatic, scalable solutions.

You’ll work closely with product, analytics, and engineering teams, operating with a high degree of autonomy. That means proactively gathering context, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring work lands effectively.

Data Platform sits at the centre of the business, with a real opportunity to shape how teams interact with data. The focus is on enabling fast, iterative analytics, moving from idea to insight quickly, while maintaining strong foundations around reliability, cost, and security.

Our Modern Tech Stack

You’ll work across a broad set of technologies as we evolve the platform. Experience is helpful, but not essential:

  • Languages: Python, SQL, Terragrunt, JavaScript

  • Cloud: AWS (primary), some GCP

  • Warehouse & Storage: Snowflake, S3/Parquet

  • Data & ETL: dbt, Fivetran

  • Platform & Infra: Kubernetes, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Argo, GitHub Actions, HashiCorp Vault

  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana

  • Dashboarding: Preset

  • Other: Claude

What we’re looking for

Strong fundamentals and the ability to apply them pragmatically:

  • Solid programming ability (Python or similar)

  • Strong experience with Snowflake (or similar warehouses)

  • Good understanding of software engineering patterns and architectures

  • Experience building data-intensive systems

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform ideally)

  • CI/CD best practices

  • Familiarity with modern data architectures (Lambda/Kappa)

Just as importantly, how you work:

  • A self-starter who takes ownership and drives work forward

  • Strong problem solver who focuses on understanding before building

  • Good judgement on build vs buy decisions

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping direction

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Able to manage multiple streams of work without losing momentum

  • Pragmatic, balancing speed with scalability and reliability

  • Actively looks to improve ways of working, including leveraging AI tooling

Interview process

  • Initial call with Talent team

  • Hiring manager call

  • Technical interview

  • Final interview with VP of Platform

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
