title: Regional Director Construction UK
descriptionHtml:
Company Profile 

nLighten is a leading European edge data centre platform operating across key markets throughout Europe. Founded in 2021, we are redefining digital infrastructure through our vision of being Close, Coupled and Connected, bringing sustainable, highly connected data centres closer to the businesses and communities we serve. As a fast-growing company, we are helping power the future of AI, cloud and digital innovation across Europe. 

Learn more about us: www.nlighten.com 

About the Role 

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Regional Director Construction UK to take full ownership of the delivery of multiple data centre construction and capital projects across the UK. 

This is a senior leadership role responsible for driving projects from early concept and design through construction, commissioning, and final handover to Operations. You will lead a regional team of Design and Construction Managers, working closely with senior stakeholders, internal teams, and external partners to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to nLighten’s quality standards. 

Health and safety is a core priority across all projects, and you will play a critical role in promoting continuous improvement and best practice across the regional portfolio. 

Key Responsibilities 

Regional Leadership & Accountability 

  • Own the successful delivery of all construction and capital projects across the assigned region, ensuring alignment with nLighten’s strategic objectives.
    • Lead, develop, and performance-manage a regional team of Design and Construction Managers.
    • Act as the senior point of accountability for project outcomes, governance, and decision-making within the region. 

End-to-End Project Delivery 

  • Lead projects from early concept and design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
    • Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within approved budgets, and to nLighten’s quality and performance standards.
    • Maintain appropriate site presence and oversight across all active regional projects. 

Commercial & Financial Control 

  • Maintain full accountability for regional project budgets, forecasts, and cost performance.
    • Ensure robust control of scope, variations, and change management to protect programme and cost certainty.
    • Work closely with Finance and Project Controls to provide accurate and timely reporting. 

Health, Safety & Risk Management 

  • Champion a strong health and safety culture across all regional projects, ensuring zero compromise on safety standards.
    • Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate project risks and issues, escalating where required in line with governance processes.

Technical, Design & Commissioning Oversight 

  • Ensure compliance with nLighten design standards, technical specifications, and regulatory requirements.
    • Provide senior oversight of commissioning activities, ensuring facilities are fully tested, certified, and ready for operational use.

Stakeholder & Partner Management 

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, consultants, contractors, and supply chain partners.
    • Lead effective collaboration and resolve conflicting priorities to achieve successful project outcomes.

Reporting, Handover & Continuous Improvement 

  • Provide clear, concise reporting on regional project performance, risks, and milestones to senior leadership.
    • Ensure structured and seamless handover to Operations, including documentation, training, and acceptance sign-off.
    • Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, standards, and team capability across the region. 

What We’re Looking For 

Leadership & Delivery Experience 

  • Senior leadership experience delivering complex construction projects within data centre or critical infrastructure environments.
    • Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent projects and geographically dispersed, multidisciplinary teams.
    • Demonstrated success delivering projects in live operational environments. 

Commercial & Project Control 

  • Strong expertise in budget management, cost control, and financial reporting.
    • Solid understanding of project scheduling, risk management, and change control.

Technical Capability 

  • Strong technical understanding of data centre construction and critical engineering systems.
    • Engineering qualification or relevant technical trade background is desirable.

Stakeholder & Problem-Solving Skills 

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive effective decision-making.
    • Excellent problem-solving skills with a track record of resolving complex project issues.

Why Join Us? 

  • Senior Leadership Impact: Play a key role in shaping the growth of nLighten’s European data centre platform.
    • High-Profile Projects: Lead complex, business-critical infrastructure developments across multiple countries.
    • Collaborative Culture: Work within a supportive, forward-thinking environment that values expertise and initiative. 

If you have the right experience and are excited about contributing to the next evolution of edge data centers, we’d love to hear from you! 

Apply now and be part of our journey toward a more connected, efficient, and sustainable digital future. 
 

Diversity & Inclusion Statement 
nLighten is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Even if you do not meet every requirement listed, we welcome your application. We particularly encourage women and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Regulatory Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a Regulatory Counsel to join our Legal team to oversee global regulations governing physical AI and ensure comprehensive compliance across our growing product lines. You will serve as a regulatory advisor to many cross-functional teams, managing regulatory reporting and mitigating compliance risks in the rapidly evolving physical AI landscape.

 

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Analyze, interpret, and advise on global laws and regulations that affect physical AI and intelligent vehicles, including automated driving and ADAS rules (NHTSA, FMVSS, state AV frameworks, UNECE regulations, EU type approval), vehicle software and cybersecurity standards (UN R155/R156, ISO 21434, ISO 26262, SOTIF), AI governance laws (EU AI Act, US state AI laws), privacy and data access regimes, and related defense and export control requirements

  • Serve as a regulatory advisor to product, engineering, sales, and cross-functional teams, translating requirements into practical guidance and into the toolchain, Vehicle OS, and software development lifecycle

  • Draft and review comments on proposed regulations, written feedback on proposed legislation, responses to agency requests for information, and trade association submissions

  • Scope regulatory requirements for prospective partnerships, customer programs, and new markets, and support deal teams on regulatory terms in commercial agreements

  • Own regulatory reporting and agency filings, and build the internal processes and controls that keep them accurate and on time

  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, and information requests, in coordination with Public Policy, Security, Privacy, and outside counsel

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing

  • 4 to 8 years of regulatory experience in-house, at a law firm, in government, or at a trade association, with substantive depth in administrative law, agency rulemaking, and compliance

  • Hands-on experience analyzing and drafting comments on proposed regulations or legislation

  • Experience advising on at least one of: vehicle safety regulation, autonomous vehicle or ADAS regulation, or export controls and defense compliance

  • The ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly to engineers, product managers, salespeople, and policy professionals, and to write memos and submissions that a regulator or legislator would find persuasive

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, a practical and solutions-oriented approach, and the organization to run several matters at once under deadline

Nice to have:

  • Prior in-house experience at an autonomous vehicle (AV), OEM, or Tier 1 automotive supplier

  • A technical or engineering background to deeply understand autonomy product architecture and capabilities

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a Regulatory Counsel to join our Legal team to oversee global regulations governing physical AI and ensure comprehensive compliance across our growing product lines. You will serve as a regulatory advisor to many cross-functional teams, managing regulatory reporting and mitigating compliance risks in the rapidly evolving physical AI landscape.

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, a practical and solutions-oriented approach, and the organization to run several matters at once under deadline

descriptionHtml:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Senior Account Executive (AE) to play a pivotal role in the growth and expansion of our business in the DACH region. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

  

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets in DACH, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

Anstellung: Festanstellung mit vielen Freiheiten dank Gleitzeitmodell; zudem auch flexibles Lohnmodell möglich mit Gewinnbeteiligung, bei selbstbestimmter Abrechnung und eigener Gestaltung des Caseload

Pensum: 40-100%

Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

  • Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüssen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschliesslich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

title: Enterprise Account Executive - FR/BNL/SE (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Account Executive (m/f/x) (French Speaking)

Location: EU

(Remote)

Comp: 120k EUR base

Territories: France / Benelux / Southern Europe

Who You’ll Work For:

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance.

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.

Who we're looking for:

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you!

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.

The role:

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe.

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion.

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts.

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners.

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles.

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities.

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value.

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities.


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills.

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values.

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion.

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects.

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations.

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features.

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments.

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals.

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks.

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue.

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions.

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity.

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers.

  • Nice to have: experience selling services.

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value.

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent).

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development.

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel.

The Experience:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of.

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life.

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters.

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

Diversity and Inclusion

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

title: Generalist (Operations)
descriptionHtml:
Take on the business and back-end operations that keep Kairos running: finances, payments, HR, compliance, and systems, plus support for our programs and Pathfinder groups.

Note: This role description is a first draft. Scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve as our plans develop over the coming weeks, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply.

 

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from METR, Redwood Research, AI Futures Project, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a Generalist (Operations) to do the wide range of things that keep Kairos running in the background. The bulk of the role is core business and back-end operations: paying vendors, supervising accountants, supporting bookkeeping and our audit, figuring out how to employ and onboard people, and keeping us compliant. Alongside that, you’ll support our Pathfinder groups, process grants, build internal systems and automations, and pitch in on program ops.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build systems and automations. Spot the operational work that shouldn’t be done by hand and automate it, so you and the team can spend time on the things that actually need judgment.

  • Run our finances and back-end operations. Pay vendors and contractors, supervise accountants, support bookkeeping and our annual audit, handle the logistics of employing people (payroll, benefits, onboarding and offboarding), and help keep us compliant. You won’t need to be an expert on day one, but you’ll learn to own these functions.

  • Process grants and payments. Run grant processing across Pathfinder and our other programs, make payments to individuals and organizations, and manage expense processing.

  • Pitch in on program ops and whatever else needs doing. Inbox triage, problem-solving on program logistics, and the occasional program-ops crunch where we need the hands.

 

Who You Are

  • Smart, agentic, and able to figure things out. A lot of this role is picking up unfamiliar processes (a new accounting task, a compliance requirement, a group’s odd request) and just working out how to do them well. We care about this more than about specific prior experience.

  • Great at automation and tooling. You instinctively reach for a better system rather than resigning yourself to doing things by hand, and you use AI and automation tools to get more done, complementing rather than replacing your own judgment. The best person in this role makes much of the repetitive work disappear.

  • Eager to help, and able to be assertive. You like unblocking people and improving their experience. You can be gentle but honest with a rejected applicant, and politely firm with an overly demanding one.

  • Organized and on top of things. You keep careful track of to-dos and information. When you drop a ball, it’s on purpose.

  • Strong writer and communicator. You’re clear and concise, and you think through your messaging from the reader’s perspective.

  • Mission-aligned. You care about making advanced AI go well, and you’re comfortable operating in the AI safety ecosystem and its culture.

While not required, we especially value:

  • Some experience in finance, accounting, HR, nonprofit compliance, event planning, or other business operations or nonprofit administration (but we’re glad to have you learn these on the job)

  • Strong automation and AI-tooling chops

  • Context on AI safety and the broader ecosystem

 

Why Work With Us

  • You’ll be working toward reducing risks from advanced AI, potentially the most important challenge of our time. The programs you’ll support influence hundreds of future AI safety and policy professionals.

  • Few ops roles are this broad. You’ll touch grants, finance, compliance, systems, and programs, and build unusually wide operating experience fast.

  • You’ll get to shape the role around your interests, with a say in which skills you build and which functions you take on.

  • We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, and CEA who share your commitment to impact.

  • Collaborate regularly with leading AI safety researchers, policy professionals, funders, and organizers.

 

What We Offer

  • Base salary: $95,000–$190,000, depending on experience and location, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates

  • Location: Access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston; optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses.

  • Benefits: Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget

  • Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture.

 

Logistics

  • Start date: Flexible, though we generally expect new hires to be able to start within a couple of months of applying

  • Remote, with expected travel 3-6 times a year for conferences and events, predominantly in the US

  • We’d also be happy for you to work out of any of the AI safety hubs in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, though we have a light preference for people to work out of Berkeley.

  • We prefer candidates who can attend meetings in the ET time zone (though our team currently spans GMT-8 to GMT+1).

  • We may be able to provide visa sponsorship to the US, depending on the circumstances (especially, but not exclusively, O-1As).

 

Our Culture

We’re a small, high-trust team motivated by the urgent challenge of making advanced AI go well. We try hard to figure out where we’re wrong, which means we say uncomfortable things to each other and change our minds fairly often. We value collaborative truth-seeking, a scout mindset, agility, and an alliance mindset with the broader ecosystem.

We also believe meaningful work should be enjoyable. We support each other’s well-being, celebrate wins, and maintain a healthy sense of humor even when the work is hard.

 

Application Process

  1. Application form (10–20 mins)

  2. Screening call (15 mins)

  3. Take-home assignment (1.5–3 hours, paid)

  4. Interview (45 mins)

  5. Reference checks

  6. Work trial (3–4 days, paid - this can be flexibly scheduled around your other commitments)

  7. Offer

If you’re excited about this role but unsure whether you meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re interested in multiple roles, apply to the one that best fits your skills and interests, and note in your application the other roles that you’d like to be considered for.

 

Questions? Reach out at Know someone who might be a good fit? If your referral gets hired and completes 6 months with us, we’ll pay you a $5,000 referral bonus. Learn more here.

Compensation: $95K – $190K

title: Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Shopware ist eine international führende Open-Commerce-Plattform für ambitionierte Unternehmen im digitalen Handel. Mit einem API-first-Ansatz, maximaler Flexibilität und einer starken Community schaffen wir zukunftsorientierte E-Commerce-Lösungen. Unsere 450 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa teilen eine Leidenschaft für Innovation, Offenheit und Teamgeist.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d), der für die Leitung mehrerer Engineering-Teams innerhalb unseres Services-Bereichs verantwortlich ist. In dieser Rolle stellst du sicher, dass jedes Team befähigt wird, unabhängige SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden zu erstellen, zu betreiben und zu pflegen, und förderst dabei operative Exzellenz und hohe Servicequalität. Du schaffst außerdem ein kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem Teams Tools, Infrastrukturpraktiken und Wissen sowohl intern als auch mit der breiteren Open-Source-Community teilen können.

Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder auch vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in ausgewählten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, ausgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.


  • Leadership & Management: Du führst, mentorst und unterstützt mehrere Engineering-Teams, die für die Bereitstellung unserer SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden verantwortlich sind.

  • Operational Excellence: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Services höchsten Anforderungen an Performance, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit entsprechen. Dafür etablierst du entsprechende Standards und Prozesse, sorgst für kontinuierliches Monitoring und treibst proaktive Verbesserungen voran.

  • AI & Engineering Transformation: Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Organisation durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC), um Produktivität, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Shared Infrastructure: Du treibst die Entwicklung einer gemeinsamen Infrastruktur sowie einheitlicher Anwendungsstandards über verschiedene Teams hinweg voran. Damit stellst du sicher, dass unsere Services konsistent entwickelt, bereitgestellt und betrieben werden.

  • Agile & DevOps Practices: Du förderst eine agile und DevOps-orientierte Kultur innerhalb der Teams und stellst sicher, dass kontinuierliche Integration, Bereitstellung und Verbesserung fest in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb unserer Services verankert sind.

  • Interne & externe Zusammenarbeit: Du förderst den teamübergreifenden Austausch von Tools, Frameworks und Best Practices – sowohl innerhalb von Shopware als auch mit unserer Community. So ermöglichst du es auch unserem Ökosystem, auf gemeinsame Technologien und Standards zurückzugreifen.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen wie Product und Operations zusammen, um Engineering-Initiativen mit unseren Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und sicherzustellen, dass die Anforderungen unserer Kunden berücksichtigt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte Führungserfahrung: Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Führung von Engineering-Teams, idealerweise mit einem Schwerpunkt auf der Bereitstellung von SaaS-Services in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • AWS-Expertise: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse der AWS-Cloud-Infrastruktur mit und hast praktische Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Services mit Terraform und Kubernetes.

  • Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über tiefgehende Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cloud-Architektur, Infrastrukturautomatisierung und Containertechnologien.

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Transformation: Du hast bereits erfolgreich gezeigt, wie du Teams über den Einsatz von KI-gestützter Programmierung hinaus zu einem KI-basierten Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) führst. Dazu gehören die Automatisierung von Entwicklung, Testing und Qualitätssicherung, die Etablierung geeigneter Governance-Strukturen sowie nachweisbare Verbesserungen hinsichtlich Produktivität, Qualität und Kosten.

  • Strategische Denkweise: Du bist in der Lage, strategische Initiativen für gemeinsame Tools, Infrastruktur und Best Practices zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die sowohl unseren internen Teams als auch dem gesamten Ökosystem zugutekommen.

  • Kommunikations- und Führungskompetenz: Du überzeugst durch ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten und hast bereits erfolgreich die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Teams sowie mit externen Stakeholdern gefördert.

  • Community Engagement: Du begeisterst dich für Open Source und möchtest die Community aktiv unterstützen, indem du Best Practices, Tools und Infrastrukturkonzepte mit unserem Ökosystem teilst.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

title: Implementation Manager - German Speaking (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
About Divio

Divio is a remote-first company spread across Europe. Our core product is a multi-cloud Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for deploying and managing web applications, used by agencies, developers, and enterprises who want to move fast without DevOps overhead. Alongside our platform, we provide application development and support services to a select group of key enterprise accounts. They rely on us not just for their infrastructure, but also to build, evolve, and support the applications that run on it. Because we run the platform as well as the code, we own the whole chain from development to production.

The role

You will join a small cross-functional team working on a large, multi-site enterprise application, building re-usable frontend components and complete user-facing features, implementing tools, integrating external services and creating features and functionality that are used across multiple sites and audiences. You will work closely with our backend and infrastructure engineers, our platform team, and the clients themselves.


Your work will include:

  • Building features: designing and developing modern, maintainable frontends for client applications, mainly in React and TypeScript.
  • Owning quality: keeping client codebases healthy, secure, accessible, and performant over the long term, not just shipping and moving on.
  • Working with clients: turning requirements into practical solutions, giving estimates, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Deploying: taking your work from development to production on the Divio platform and on AWS.
  • Supporting: helping with technical questions and issues on the applications we maintain, as part of a weekly support rotation.
  • Shaping how we work: contributing to frontend standards, reviews and tooling across the project, and having a say in our quarterly objectives.

Requirements

Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 7+ years of professional frontend experience, with strong React and TypeScript skills
  • Is comfortable with Node.js
  • Has an excellent understanding of HTML, CSS, Accessibility and web performance
  • Has experience working with headless CMS (e.g. Storyblok)
  • Is comfortable working directly with clients and translating their needs into working software
  • Is at ease talking with the client directly, in English
  • Takes ownership of what they build, including after it goes live
  • Can work independently but enjoys building things as part of a team
  • Has ideas and wants a say in how things evolve

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Static site generation (Gatsby, Next.js, Astro, …)
  • Experience in AWS and infrastructure as code (CDK, Lambda, CloudFront, CodeBuild)
  • Experience in using component libraries or design systems used by many sites
  • Experience in end-to-end and frontend testing (e.g. Playwright)

We're not looking for someone who knows everything, just someone curious, reliable and ready to grow with us.

In short

We're a small team of passionate engineers working on an exciting product and on interesting, challenging projects for our clients. You get freedom in how you work and responsibility for what goes live. There are real challenges, and plenty of chances to learn, improve things and make an impact on the applications we build, on our platform, and on how we work as a team.

If that sounds like your kind of job, we'd really like to hear from you.

title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern
descriptionHtml:
Title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern

Type of contract: Paid internship

Contract duration: 6 months

Work time: Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time

Reporting to: Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator

Technical guidance: BI and Systems Officer

Location: Remote (home-based outside Switzerland)

Start date: January 2027

Application deadline: 10/12/2026

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

Role Summary

The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements.

Position Responsibilities

Systems and User Support

  • Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day;

  • Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews;

  • Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases;

  • Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly.

Data Quality and Information Management

  • Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues;

  • Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance;

  • Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions;

  • Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions.

Documentation, Training and Continuity

  • Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials;

  • Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities;

  • Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates;

  • Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

  • The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship;

  • Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management;

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset.

Other Requirements

  • Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset.

  • Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality;

  • Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately;

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment;

  • Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology.

descriptionHtml:

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
descriptionHtml:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié
