About DTA

DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We bring together technology, data and analytics to help agencies and clients transform the value of data.

Our platform, Open Media Studio, is an AI-enabled media and data platform built for the next era of advertising. Our 1,000-plus team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem-solvers works across 20 markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We’re looking for a hands-on Security Engineer to help design, build and operate secure cloud platforms, data pipelines and data-sharing solutions. These capabilities support our internal product teams and deliver data to clients—either in client-owned cloud environments or in our own.

The role is GCP-first, with security patterns that can be applied across AWS and Azure. You’ll help embed security into infrastructure, identities, data products and AI-enabled services from the start—not bolt it on later.

As AI agents connect to data and systems through technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), our security model needs to account for machine identities, tool permissions and automated actions. You’ll help build the controls that make these services safe to use, including authentication, authorisation, monitoring and protection against risks such as prompt injection, tool misuse and data leakage.

You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Security Operations, Privacy, Legal, Marketing and Client Delivery teams. The goal is to make the secure approach the easiest approach—and to deliver reliable, well-governed data to our clients.

What you’ll do

Secure cloud platforms and automation

  • Build and improve secure cloud foundations in GCP, including resource hierarchies, organisation policies, VPC Service Controls, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) and centralised logging.
  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and project factories so teams can provision, test and redeploy secure environments consistently.
  • Apply policy-as-code in CI/CD, use keyless pipelines through workload identity federation, and automate detection and remediation of configuration drift.
  • Help establish equivalent security patterns in AWS and Azure.

Protect AI agents and MCP services

  • Help design and evolve secure patterns for MCP hosts, clients, servers, gateways and registries.
  • Build or operate MCP gateways and registries with approved-tool allowlisting, tool-level authorisation, rate limits and auditable records of tool calls.
  • Implement OAuth 2.1/OIDC authorisation using short-lived, scoped and audience-bound tokens; avoid token passthrough and require human approval for high-impact actions.
  • Help secure MCP services hosted on Cloud Run or GKE, using controls such as Identity-Aware Proxy and prompt or response screening.
  • Threat-model and help defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, unauthorised tool changes, confused-deputy attacks and data exfiltration through chained tool calls.
  • Help secure the agent and connector supply chain through vetting, signing, versioning, scanning and sandboxing.

Engineer identity and access controls

  • Implement identity patterns for people, workloads and agents across Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including federation, SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access and phishing-resistant MFA.
  • Extend identity governance to service accounts, API keys, workload identities and AI agents, using Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform.
  • Support clear ownership, lifecycle management and regular access reviews for non-human identities.
  • Apply zero-standing-privilege principles through just-in-time elevation, short-lived credentials and automated access revocation.
  • Assess emerging capabilities such as Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Okta Cross App Access.

Protect data and enable secure sharing

  • Build data transformation pipelines and governed data products using dbt, SQL and Terraform.
  • Apply controls such as data classification, lineage, model contracts, policy tags, masking, row-level security and least-privilege access.
  • Help deliver data securely to clients and partners through BigQuery Analytics Hub, cross-cloud storage transfers and API integrations.
  • Support secure ingestion, cleansing, enrichment and transformation, with scoped access, encryption, audit logging and monitoring at each hand-off.
  • Develop secure data-sharing patterns, including data clean rooms and consent-aware pipelines.
  • Help prevent sensitive data from leaking into agent prompts, context windows, logs or third-party models, and ensure agents access curated data rather than unrestricted raw tables.

Secure social and marketing platforms

  • Bring brand social accounts, advertising platforms and martech tools under central identity control using Cerby or a comparable solution.
  • Support secure onboarding and offboarding, credential rotation, enforced MFA and time-limited, auditable access for agencies, freelancers and creators.
  • Treat social content—including comments, direct messages, reviews and mentions—as untrusted input.
  • Design guardrails so agents cannot combine access to private data, untrusted content and the ability to publish externally without appropriate safeguards.
  • Work with Marketing and Communications teams to detect and respond to account takeovers, impersonation and advertising-account fraud.

Improve detection, response and secure delivery

  • Send cloud, identity, MCP, model-safety and social-platform logs to the SIEM.
  • Build detections as code and develop SOAR playbooks that can revoke tokens, disable agents, quarantine MCP servers and rotate credentials, with human approval for high-impact actions.
  • Create golden paths, reference implementations and runbooks that help delivery teams build securely and independently.
  • Contribute to threat-modelling sessions, red-team exercises, design reviews and audit-readiness activities.
  • Help map controls to relevant standards and automate evidence collection.
  • Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers.

What you’ll bring

Experience and technical skills

  • Seasoned experience in cloud infrastructure, platform, data or security engineering, including hands-on GCP experience in production.
  • Strong practical GCP skills, such as IAM, organisation policies, networking, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Run or GKE, and BigQuery.
  • Working knowledge of comparable security capabilities in AWS and Azure.
  • Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, environment and state management, testing, CI/CD and policy-as-code.
  • Experience engineering identity controls with Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta, including SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access, MFA and privileged or just-in-time access. Familiarity with Saviynt or another IGA platform is expected.
  • Hands-on SIEM and SOAR experience, including onboarding log sources, developing detections and building response playbooks.
  • Practical understanding of MCP and agent security. This could come from production work, open-source contributions or well-developed proofs of concept.
  • Experience with dbt and SQL for data transformation or data products, and a working understanding of data-layer controls such as classification, masking, row-level security and access grants.
  • Experience delivering data to clients or partners across organisational or cloud boundaries, using services such as BigQuery Analytics Hub, GCS, S3, Azure Blob Storage or APIs.
  • Coding ability in Python, Go or TypeScript for automation, tooling or MCP server development.
  • Familiarity with social, advertising or marketing platforms and the security challenges involved in managing brand accounts and non-SSO applications.

How you work

  • You build securely by default and consider how systems could be misused from the outset.
  • You automate repeatable work, test what you codify and look for ways to make secure delivery easier.
  • You balance risk, usability and delivery needs, and can explain when a solution is not ready—and what would make it safe to proceed.
  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and can explain security risks in plain language.
  • You document decisions and create practical standards, golden paths and runbooks.
  • You measure outcomes, learn from incidents and feedback, and improve controls over time.
  • You collaborate inclusively, seek different perspectives and support the development of colleagues.

Security and regulatory frameworks

You’ll be familiar with relevant security, privacy and AI frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, CIS Benchmarks, UK GDPR/GDPR and the EU AI Act.

Certifications

You should hold—or be willing to achieve after joining:

  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect within six months.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer within 12 months.

WPP will fund exam fees and provide dedicated study time.

Nice to have

  • Experience operating MCP servers or gateways in production, or contributing to open-source agent or security tooling.
  • Google Security Operations or Microsoft Sentinel experience, particularly detection-as-code practices.
  • Kubernetes or service-mesh security experience, including workload identity, policy controllers or mTLS.
  • Software supply-chain security experience, such as SLSA, Sigstore/cosign, SBOMs or Binary Authorization.
  • Privacy engineering or AI assurance experience, including data clean rooms, consent management, pseudonymisation or AI red-teaming.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS, OWASP GenAI guidance or AI security testing.
  • Agency, media or consumer-brand experience, particularly in environments requiring multi-client data segregation.
  • Further relevant certifications, such as Google Professional Security Operations Engineer, Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Microsoft SC-300/AZ-500, Okta Certified Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or CCSP.

Life at WPP Media

Our work is powered by a commitment to Be Extraordinary: investing in our people and supporting transformational creativity. We Lead Optimistically, champion growth and development, and create opportunities for colleagues to build connections and learn across WPP Media and WPP’s global network.

We aim to create an open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and can progress. Employee resource groups, in-office events and opportunities to share ideas help bring our teams together. WPP Media also offers a comprehensive benefits package; specific benefits vary by location.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer. We consider applicants without discrimination and are committed to an inclusive workplace. Teams typically work in the office around four days a week to support collaboration and connection. If you need an accommodation or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team.

This is a UK-based role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

  • Datenbankentwicklung mit Oracle/PostgreSQL inkl. Schema-Modellierung, PL/SQL und Flyway-Migrationen

title: Senior Accountant
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to join our management accounts and controllership function. This is the team that delivers the monthly close for the UK group companies and owns the accuracy of what sits behind it.

We're a high-transaction-volume lending business scaling across the UK, US and Mexico. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own real deliverables early and help automate and improve the processes within the Financial Reporting team.

What you'll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Deliver monthly close for the UK group companies, accurately and within set timelines

  • Partner with the wider finance team and business stakeholders to prepare product-level P&Ls that support commercial decision-making, help with queries and month-end inputs

  • Taking ownership, and automating, balance sheet reconciliations Month on Month, whilst applying an inquisitive mindset by being able to identify and investigate variances and unusual data trends

    • Assisting with the preparation of the consolidated balance sheet, P&L and cash flow

What we're looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA/CIMA) with 0-2 years PQE

  • Working knowledge of UK GAAP and/or IFRS

  • Exposure to US GAAP is beneficial given the group's US operations

  • Strong Excel skills for high-volume ledger and reconciliation work

  • Meticulous and deadline-driven, suited to a fast-paced, high-transaction-volume environment

  • Collaborative, hands-on style rather than a purely technical or advisory orientation

  • Comfortable supporting continuous improvement of financial controls and policies rather than operating a static process

Interview process

  • Online assessment: a 15 minute cognitive assessment followed by a 40 minute Accountancy Task (to be taken at a time of your own choosing)

  • 20-30 minute remote interview with our Talent team

  • 30 minute remote team interview to discuss your task and dive deeper into your experience

  • Final stage: Onsite interview with finance leadership for 45 minutes

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Über Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.

Stellenübersicht

Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.

Senior Associates bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.

Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsethik, Kreativität, eine positive Einstellung und ein hohes Maß an Engagement.

Aktuell suchen wir insbesondere Consultants mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Pricing- und Market-Access-Systeme in Europa und weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie identifizieren und konzipieren eigenständig die erforderlichen Analysen und wirken an der Entwicklung des übergreifenden analytischen Ansatzes für Beratungsprojekte mit.
  • Sie stehen im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, informieren sie über den Projektfortschritt und präsentieren Ergebnisse.
  • Sie erstellen Berichte und Präsentationen oder übernehmen die Ausarbeitung einzelner Abschnitte.
  • Sie wirken bei der Projektplanung und der Steuerung von Projektbudgets mit.
  • Sie unterstützen weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder bei ihrer fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, prüfen deren Analysen und geben ihnen fachliche Anleitung und Feedback.
  • Sie bringen sich in die Geschäftsentwicklung ein und wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten für Kunden mit.

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Life Sciences, z. B. in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmakologie oder Chemie, oder in einem relevanten Studiengang mit analytischem Schwerpunkt sowie einschlägige Berufserfahrung
  • 3 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Anwendung quantitativer und qualitativer Analysemethoden
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung und im Projektmanagement
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt, in der Moderation und Präsentation sowie in der Budget- und Projektplanung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Pricing und Market Access in europäischen und internationalen Märkten
  • Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Bewerbung

Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:

  • Lebenslauf – bitte geben Sie Ihre aktuelle Adresse, eprsönliche E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer an;
  • Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

  • CRA bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

Verantwortungsvoller Einsatz von KI im Recruiting

Bei CRA verstehen wir Recruiting als eine Tätigkeit, bei der Menschen eine zentrale Rolle spielen. KI und andere digitale Tools unterstützen uns zwar dabei, effizienter zu arbeiten, ersetzen jedoch nicht den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern. Entsprechend erwarten wir auch von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, dass sie sich persönlich mit CRA und ihrer Bewerbung auseinandersetzen und sich auf die Gespräche mit uns vorbereiten. Weitere Informationen zum angemessenen Einsatz von KI im Recruiting bei CRA finden Sie auf unserer Website.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

title: Senior Bid Manager/Bid Lead
descriptionHtml:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

How you’ll drive Accurx’s primary care bid strategy

The Bid Lead is the strategic lead for each bid they own, from early capture to post-award handover. They set the bid's direction and win strategy and lead the cross-functional team that delivers it. They bring capture and bid expertise to produce outstanding responses to multi-million-pound tenders. They also lead Accurx's work on frameworks in their portfolio.

The role will lead Accurx's responses to trust-wide and/or ICB primary care bids.

  • Capture. You’ll shape our biggest primary care opportunities 6–12 months before release, working with opportunity owners and regional teams to build account insight, influence early engagement and turn customer needs into distinctive win themes.

  • Decide where we can win — and how. You’ll lead qualification and go / no-go decisions, bringing together NHS priorities, ICB needs, Accurx’s strategy and the commercial approach to build a clear strategy for winning each opportunity.

  • Lead multiple complex bids from start to finish. You’ll bring together and motivate cross-functional teams, owning the plan, governance, risks and deadlines from kick-off through to submission, presentations and handover — while keeping stakeholders informed along the way.

  • Turn our impact into responses that stand out. Working closely with the Bid Writer / Manager, you’ll set the win themes, key messages and evidence for each response, lead quality reviews and make sure every submission is compelling, compliant and commercially sound.

  • Make every bid strengthen the next one. You’ll turn feedback, wins and losses into better content and ways of working, strengthen our position on the frameworks used to buy primary care digital services, and use tools including AI thoughtfully to make our capture and bid processes more effective.

You should apply if...

  • You have APMP certification (Foundation or above) and/or equivalent proven bid expertise, with extensive experience leading multiple complex, high-value public sector tenders at the same time.

  • You’re experienced in capture and pursuit management, with a track record of shaping opportunities before release, uncovering customer drivers and turning insight into clear pursuit and win strategies.

  • You’re an excellent writer and reviewer, able to turn complex requirements, evidence and customer needs into compelling responses, with a strong focus on exceeding evaluation criteria and delivering high-quality, compliant submissions.

  • You’re confident leading through influence, coordinating large cross-functional teams to tight deadlines, managing competing priorities and risks, and having difficult conversations when needed.

  • You’re a detail-oriented completer-finisher with a strong working knowledge of public procurement, including the Procurement Act 2023, the Social Value Model and frameworks.

  • You understand clinical systems and workflows and can clearly explain how technology fits into them. For this role, that includes how Accurx works with GP clinical systems such as EMIS and SystmOne, and how it fits into practice and PCN workflows, including integration and hosting.

  • Ideally, you’ve bid into NHS primary care, ICBs or CSUs and understand general practice, PCN operations and how digital primary care is commissioned. Experience leading bids for SaaS or digital transformation solutions would also be a strong advantage.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £70,000 - £90,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £30,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £70K – £90K • Offers Equity

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Your Mission

We are looking for a (Senior) Business Development Lead / Manager to build and grow CDDS's business in Germany and selected European markets. You will develop our presence across the Bundeswehr and wider national-security ecosystem, shape growth priorities with leadership, and turn operational needs into funded opportunities, trials, procurement programmes, and contracts. Working independently and with our engineering, product, and operations teams, you will connect German and European customer requirements with achievable solutions and help establish sustained growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own business growth in Germany and selected European markets, deliver agreed commercial targets, and set market priorities with CDDS leadership.

  • Build trusted relationships with Bundeswehr end users, BAAINBw programme organisations, procurement officials, relevant federal authorities, defence primes, and senior decision-makers; identify mission needs and develop priority accounts.

  • Identify and qualify opportunities through direct engagement, procurement monitoring, and industry networks, then lead capture from initial engagement and trials through contract award across complex public-sector sales cycles.

  • Develop capture strategies covering customer requirements, budgets and funding cycles, procurement routes, partners, competitors, compliance requirements, and CDDS's value proposition; recommend which opportunities to pursue.

  • Work with engineering, product, and operations to shape feasible solutions and delivery commitments, bringing customer feedback into product priorities.

  • Lead responses to requests for information, requests for proposals, and public tenders; coordinate technical and commercial inputs; and negotiate contracts with leadership and relevant legal or contracting support.

  • Represent CDDS at customer meetings, Bundeswehr and partner demonstrations, industry events, and trade fairs, coordinating technical teams to demonstrate capabilities against operational requirements.

  • Maintain a qualified German and European pipeline, accurate CRM records, account plans, and reliable forecasts, reporting award timing, risks, resource needs, and progress against targets.

  • Coordinate contract handover to delivery teams, maintain customer and partner relationships after award, and develop follow-on opportunities as operational needs evolve.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in defence business development, capture management, public-sector sales, government acquisition, or military procurement.

  • Demonstrated success winning defence contracts or advancing funded government acquisitions, with clear responsibility for the outcomes.

  • Hands-on knowledge of German defence requirements development, Bundeswehr budgeting and acquisition pathways, BAAINBw procurement, and public contracting; familiarity with EU or NATO procurement is an advantage.

  • Established relationships and credibility within the German defence ecosystem, ideally including Bundeswehr users, BAAINBw, the Federal Ministry of Defence, defence primes, or relevant federal authorities.

  • Fluent German and professional English, with strong negotiation and communication skills and the ability to explain technical capabilities in terms of operational value.

  • Commercial judgment and the ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority, prioritize competing opportunities, and take ownership in a fast-moving startup.

  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo and maintain any security clearance required for the role under German law, with sound judgment on sensitive information, procurement, security, and export-control requirements.

  • Based in Germany with eligibility to work in Germany and willingness to travel regularly for customer engagements, demonstrations, European events.

Nice to have

•Previous experience with UAS, counter-UAS, autonomous systems, air defence, or related defence technologies.

•Prior service with the Bundeswehr or another NATO or EU armed force, particularly in operational, acquisition, capability-development, air-defence, or force-protection roles.

•Experience moving emerging technologies from trials and demonstrations into Bundeswehr or European funded procurement and operational use.

•Experience growing a defence-technology startup or building partnerships with German and European defence primes, systems integrators, research organisations, or public-sector partners.

Why CDDS

  • Opportunity to work directly with the CEO and leadership team

  • Build and shape an organisation in hyper growth phase

Mit ASRAD, unserer eigenen Methodik für risikobasierte System- und Prozess-Assessments, bieten wir zudem einen eigenständigen Ansatz zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung industrieller Qualitätsprozesse.

Für den gezielten Ausbau unseres Geschäfts suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d), der bestehende Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiterentwickelt, neue Geschäftspotenziale erschließt und anspruchsvolle Beratungs- und Dienstleistungsprojekte erfolgreich gewinnt.

Dabei kombinierst du die Betreuung strategischer Bestandskunden mit einer aktiven, systematischen Neukundengewinnung.

Was dich bei QMH erwartet

  • Firmenwagen: Ein Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

  • Direkte Verantwortung: Eigenständige Gestaltung deines Vertriebsgebiets mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Starke Unterstützung: Fachliche Rückendeckung durch erfahrene Senior-Berater sowie organisatorische Unterstützung durch unseren Vertriebsinnendienst

  • Internationale Perspektive: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team in China und die Möglichkeit, internationale Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Attraktives Leistungsportfolio: Anspruchsvolle Beratungs- und Ingenieurdienstleistungen, eigene Methoden und Referenzen bei namhaften Industriekunden

Deine ersten Monate bei QMH

In deinen ersten Wochen lernst du unser Leistungsportfolio, unsere Kundenstrukturen und unsere internen Vertriebsprozesse kennen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung, dem Vertriebsinnendienst und unseren erfahrenen Senior-Beratern zusammen.

Du analysierst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, übernimmst erste strategische Accounts und identifizierst neue Geschäftspotenziale in deinen Zielbranchen.

Parallel entwickelst du deine Vertriebspipeline in HubSpot, aktivierst dein bestehendes Netzwerk und führst erste Kundengespräche sowie konkrete Projekt- und Angebotsverhandlungen.

Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist, dass du eigenständig Kundenbeziehungen entwickelst, neue Projekte gewinnst und den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts in Deutschland und an der Schnittstelle zu China aktiv vorantreibst.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Vertriebsprozesse verwalten, sondern neue Märkte erschließen, strategische Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und messbare Geschäftserfolge erzielen?

Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in der Industrie, verstehst komplexe technische Dienstleistungen und weißt, wie man aus Kundenbedarfen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen entwickelt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von QMH Consulting – in Deutschland, China und darüber hinaus.

title: Senior Consultant - ICS/OT Cybersecurity
descriptionHtml:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

As a Senior Consultant on the Professional Services team, you’ll be at the forefront of helping industrial organizations across the UK and EU strengthen their cybersecurity posture. You’ll lead hands-on engagements like architecture reviews, OT cybersecurity assessments, tabletop exercises, and threat baselines for electric, oil and gas, water treatment, chemical, and manufacturing customers. This role blends technical depth with real-world impact: you’ll shape customer strategies and turn lessons learned into smarter tools, playbooks, and stronger defenses. What you learn in the field won’t stay there. You’ll feed it back to our product teams through research, training material, and Dragos Platform playbooks, and represent Dragos in the ICS/OT community. This role is ideal for those passionate about industrial security who want to drive meaningful change.

Responsibilities: 

  • Deliver ICS/OT professional services engagements, including architecture reviews, compromise assessments, and tabletop exercises, for customers in electric, oil and gas, water treatment, chemical, and manufacturing.
  • Collect and analyze data in customer environments, including network configuration reviews and crown jewel analysis.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for consulting clients, giving practical guidance that builds trust.
  • Deliver findings and recommendations documentation at the end of each engagement, presenting to customers and addressing their questions and concerns.
  • Perform Scope of Work (SOW) reviews, develop Rules of Engagement (ROE), and complete other engagement documentation.
  • Turn engagement insights into research and product input, such as training material and Dragos Platform playbooks, and refine existing workflows using lessons learned.
  • Represent Dragos through webinars, whitepapers, and conference presentations, and mentor junior consultants as they develop.

Qualifications: 

  • 4+ years of hands-on ICS/OT cybersecurity experience, including delivery of professional services consulting, with proven expertise in OT systems, protocols, environments, risks, threats, vulnerabilities, frameworks, and standards.
  • Working knowledge of threat groups, TTPs, tools, and vulnerability assessment, applied to improve engagement outcomes.
  • Familiarity with the Network and Information Systems (NIS2) Directive.
  • Hands-on experience with common toolsets for collecting and analyzing network and host data to baseline networks, validate documented state, and identify malicious or anomalous activity.
  • Proven experience using large language models (e.g., Claude) in consulting engagements to analyze network and configuration data, review customer documentation, and draft findings, with sound judgment in validating AI output and securely handling client data.
  • Strong report-writing, presentation, and verbal and written communication skills, including facilitating training and presenting complex analysis to technical and executive audiences.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for onsite engagements (up to approximately 30%).

Compensation:

title: Senior Content & Search Activation Lead
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Senior Content & Search Activation Lead (6 Month-FTC)

Location: London, or Northampton, England (3 days a week on-site from our Client's offices)

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a six-month contract opportunity to join OLIVER’S managed services team, embedded within our client, a leading & Global Banking Institution.  Sitting within their Marketing Centre of Excellence as a Senior Content & AI Search Specialist, you’ll be responsible for turning search, GEO and audience insight into live content and customer experiences across priority journeys.

Based in London or Northampton, with a hybrid working pattern (three days a week on-site), you’ll take insight from specialist agency partners and turn it into approved, delivery-ready content and digital briefs, working with delivery teams to get activity live. Your judgement and writing will help the Unified Search programme improve how customers find and use our client’s content.

About the role: 

This is a hybrid activation role that combines content strategy, SEO, copywriting, campaign management and stakeholder management. Rather than being the primary source of search insight, you’ll add value by translating specialist recommendations into clear, prioritised and deliverable activity. Your value is in taking recommendations from partners such as OMD and Profound, checking them against the Unified Search strategy, and shaping them into clear, prioritised activity.  

You'll secure the right approvals and work with Delivery Managers and Digital Delivery teams to move work into delivery. You'll use AI-enabled tools and workflows, such as Profound and Pencil Pro, to speed up briefing and content creation, while applying careful human judgement.  

You'll help build confidence in the Supercharge model by keeping recommendations moving from insight to approval, delivery and post-live learning. You'll work across a matrix of Product, Content, Design, Digital Delivery, Legal, Compliance and agency partners, with no direct reports. 

What you will be doing: 

  • Move search, GEO and content recommendations from agency insight or content brief through to deployment-ready activity. 
  • Review recommendations from OMD, Profound and other insight sources, and confirm they fit the Unified Search strategy, customer journey priorities and sprint objectives. 
  • Work with Product stakeholders, including product owners, to secure alignment and sign-off before activity moves into delivery. 
  • Use Profound, Pencil Pro and other AI-enabled workflows to shape content, write briefs, develop copy and optimise pages. 
  • Write, edit and refine copy and messaging where needed, turning recommendations into clear and usable content outputs. 
  • Work with the assigned Delivery Manager to translate recommendations into clear content, optimisation and digital delivery requirements. 
  • Check with Content, Design, Digital Delivery and agency partners that requirements are clear, prioritised and complete before handover. 
  • Prepare opportunities for the relevant sign-off board and coordinate stakeholder input where approval is needed. 
  • Maintain a visible backlog for your area or sprint wave, so recommendations are prioritised, progressed and tracked. 
  • Decide whether to progress, pause, re-scope or escalate an opportunity, based on risk, dependency and delivery readiness. 
  • Flag blockers, dependencies and governance issues early, and escalate them clearly through the Supercharge operating model. 
  • Make sure all content aligns with our client’s brand, tone of voice, accessibility, legal, compliance and risk requirements. 
  • Feed live performance results and learnings back into future sprint activity. 
  • Risk and Control Objective: Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Enterprise-Wide Risk Management Framework and our clients’ internal Policies and Policy Standards. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Experience across financial services or a heavily regulated industry
  • Experience in content strategy, content design, copywriting or digital content. 
  • A good understanding of SEO principles, including search intent, page structure, metadata, internal linking, content quality and customer journey optimisation. 
  • Understanding of GEO and AI search principles, or a strong appetite and ability to learn quickly. 
  • Experience reviewing, writing or refining digital content, and turning recommendations into actionable briefs. 
  • Skill in using insight, customer need and search data to shape practical content and optimisation activity. 
  • Stakeholder management experience with Product, Content, Design, Digital, Legal, Compliance or agency teams. 
  • Experience taking work through approval, governance or delivery processes in a regulated environment. 
  • Organisational skills, including managing backlogs, priorities and actions, and keeping work moving through ambiguity and competing priorities. 
  • Clear communication, including explaining search and content recommendations to non-specialist stakeholders. 
  • Experience applying sound judgement and working within appropriate risk, legal, compliance and governance controls. 
  • Confidence using Gen AI tools to improve the quality and speed of content, briefing and optimisation activity. 
  • An ability to adopt and help embed repeatable AI-assisted content and briefing workflows. 
  • A systematic approach to breaking down complex, multi-step challenges. 
  • Sound judgement about where AI can add value and where human review, specialist expertise and governance are required.

descriptionHtml:

About The Role
This is an exciting opportunity for an established Senior CRM Manager to lead the LOOKFANTASTIC CRM team. This role is responsible for ensuring markets deliver against the overall CRM strategy, creating plans aligned with market maturity and business growth ambitions. Managing a CRM team of eight who have responsibility for the UK & Ireland and EU regions, you will work closely with our marketing activation and trading teams to increase the CRM mix-of-business, drive customer activation and customer retention metrics.

Why be a Senior CRM Manager at THG Beauty? 

This is an exciting opportunity for an established Senior CRM Manager to lead the LOOKFANTASTIC CRM team. This role is responsible for ensuring markets deliver against the overall CRM strategy, creating plans aligned with market maturity and business growth ambitions. Managing a CRM team of eight who have responsibility for the UK & Ireland and EU regions, you will work closely with our marketing activation and trading teams to increase the CRM mix-of-business, drive customer activation and customer retention metrics.

  • Identify touchpoints for improvement and implement strategies to maximise customer satisfaction, retention and lifetime value. For example, initiatives to increase opt in rates; initiatives to reduce unsubscribe rates; getting CRM customers into our app, loyalty scheme, subscription propositions, and so on.
  • Contribute regularly to trading meetings and communicate to senior stakeholders the performance of CRM channels, both campaigns and automations.
  • Manage and motivate the team to deliver against targets, whilst supporting their personal goals and objectives. As part of this, ensure ways of working set the team up for success.

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

  • 4+ years in a CRM role with direct line-management experience of managing multiple team members at the same time
  • Proven ability to analyse data and draw out actionable insights
  • Highly articulate and confident communicator with strong influencing skills
  • Ability to work with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Confident dealing with senior stakeholders
  • Self-motivated multi-tasker able to handle multiple projects with good time management
  • Strong commercial acumen

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. title: Senior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and creating products that build trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization who thrive on the challenging work we do and doing it with other exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry changes constantly, and our job is to create user-facing products supported by our best-in-class data, allowing us to adapt to those rapid changes and bring maximal value to our customers.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Research and Intelligence organisation in London. You'll sit within the Wallet Intelligence Research team focussing on one of the most critical and important data sets in the company and help maintain and build it out through investigative research, behavioral heuristics, graph algorithms, and machine learning techniques. Much of what we work on is state of the art, and often ahead of academia, and your work will directly shape the data that fuels Chainalysis' products and customers across the globe.

This role is ideal for someone who is energised by deeply technical, ambiguous problems at the intersection of data science, graph computation, and on-chain investigation, and who wants to take ownership of projects end-to-end.

In this role, you'll:

  • Own the execution of one or more production data science projects, translating broad problem statements into well-scoped tasks and credible analytical results that meet stakeholder expectations.

  • Design, develop, and validate novel behavioral heuristics and algorithms over blockchain data to attribute on-chain activity and uncover new insights.

  • Apply advanced techniques including graph computation, statistical modeling, and machine learning to large-scale on-chain datasets.

  • Identify and resolve inefficiencies in code, methodology, and workflows; ensure your work integrates cleanly into our production data and tooling stack.

  • Clearly articulate and defend methodology and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, maintaining alignment through consistent communication.

  • Mentor junior team members, contribute to technical hiring, and share knowledge.

  • Collaborate closely with peers to bring research from prototype to production.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field – or equivalent industry experience working on advanced, data-intensive problems.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL, with a track record of writing clean, testable, production-quality code using agentic workflows.

  • Demonstrated experience applying advanced analytical techniques (e.g. graph algorithms, ML, statistical inference) to large, messy datasets.

  • Comfort working with blockchain data, or strong evidence of the aptitude to ramp up quickly on blockchain data structures and protocols.

  • A demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects: decomposing requirements, driving them to completion, and proactively seeking clarity from stakeholders.

  • An analytical, open-minded approach to problem solving – comfortable navigating ambiguity and willing to dive into problems outside your day-to-day scope.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex methodology to diverse audiences.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Databricks, DBT, Spark/PySpark, or similar large-scale data platforms.

  • Experience modifying infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform) or contributing to production data pipelines.

  • Experience mentoring junior data scientists or engineers.

  • Knowledge of, or passion for, the cryptocurrency and blockchain space.

Technologies we use:

Python

SQL

Databricks

DBT

PySpark / Spark

Terraform

AWS

Postgres

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Director - EMEA Enterprise Business Development
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Role

The Senior Director, Enterprise Business Development – EMEA will report to the Vice President and Managing Director, EMEA and lead the strategy and execution model for CoreWeave’s Enterprise business across the region.

This is a business development and strategy leadership role that works through CoreWeave’s field organisation. Country sales teams will retain account ownership, opportunity management and revenue responsibility, while you define the Enterprise strategy, customer propositions, industry points of view, sales plays and adoption mechanisms that enable them to win and grow strategic Enterprise customers.

You will work closely with Field Sales, Product, Field Engineering, Product and Field Marketing, partners and customers to build a differentiated Enterprise narrative and translate it into repeatable field execution. You will also build and lead a team of Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to priority vertical industries, bringing deep expertise in how AI will reshape those sectors.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define and execute CoreWeave’s EMEA Enterprise business development strategy in partnership with regional and country sales leadership.
  • Establish CoreWeave’s Enterprise point of view, including Enterprise architecture, market segmentation, AI wallet distribution, buying centres, workload evolution and competitive positioning.
  • Define how CoreWeave participates in the Enterprise AI transformation journey, from initial AI initiatives through production adoption, operationalisation and scaled Enterprise Intelligence.
  • Develop the narrative for how CoreWeave enables customers to operate their AI Learning Loops, positioning the platform as the infrastructure, software and operational foundation through which organisations continuously build, deploy, learn and improve.
  • Build a systematic view of Enterprise AI adoption across EMEA, including where investment is occurring, which workloads are moving into production, how budgets are shifting and where CoreWeave can gain market share.
  • Define Enterprise segmentation and prioritisation models that help field teams identify the customers, industries, workloads and buying centres with the greatest strategic and commercial potential.
  • Develop CoreWeave’s Enterprise sales plays, including target customer profiles, business triggers, technical use cases, executive value propositions, competitive positioning and expansion motions.
  • Own the development of Enterprise sales content, executive narratives, pitch decks and field assets in partnership with Field and Product Marketing.
  • Build a repeatable Enterprise adoption methodology that helps customers progress from initial workload evaluation through production deployment, scaled consumption and broader platform adoption.
  • Develop programmes that enable customers to adopt CoreWeave as a strategic component of their AI architecture rather than as a point solution for individual workloads.
  • Partner with Product leadership to ensure CoreWeave’s Enterprise strategy reflects product capabilities, roadmap direction and the requirements of large-scale Enterprise customers.
  • Translate customer and market insight into clear recommendations for product investment, developer experience, security, governance, observability, integration and Enterprise platform capabilities.
  • Work closely with Field Engineering to define Enterprise adoption strategies using Forward Deployed Engineers, specialist technical resources and services.
  • Build repeatable engagement models that combine business, technical and operational resources around the most important Enterprise transformation opportunities.
  • Partner with Field Sales leaders to translate Enterprise strategy into country and account-level execution, ensuring sellers understand where to focus, what to lead with and how to progress customers through the adoption journey.
  • Work with partners to build joint Enterprise propositions, solution patterns and routes to market that accelerate customer adoption and extend CoreWeave’s reach.
  • Maintain executive-level relationships with strategic Enterprise customers, technology partners and ecosystem leaders.
  • Act as an executive sponsor for strategically important Enterprise transformation opportunities.
  • Build and maintain an active graph of Enterprise AI adoption across the region, mapping customers, industries, workloads, AI investment, architecture choices, partners, competitors and stages of maturity.
  • Build, lead and develop a team of Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to priority industry segments.
  • Ensure each industry leader develops a differentiated view of how AI will reshape their sector, including priority use cases, economic impact, data and infrastructure requirements, buying centres, barriers to adoption and relevant ecosystem partners.
  • Establish a rigorous operating cadence and scorecard covering market penetration, Enterprise adoption, field execution, pipeline influence, consumption, revenue performance and market share.
  • Represent CoreWeave’s Enterprise narrative externally with customers, partners, industry bodies, analysts, media and at major industry events.

Objectives

During the first 12 months, you will:

  • Define CoreWeave’s EMEA Enterprise strategy, operating plan and growth priorities.
  • Establish a clear Enterprise segmentation model covering priority industries, customers, workloads and buying centres.
  • Develop CoreWeave’s Enterprise architecture and AI transformation points of view.
  • Define the Enterprise AI Learning Loop narrative and articulate how CoreWeave becomes the ways and means through which customers operate and scale those loops.
  • Build the initial Enterprise sales plays, executive narratives, sales content and pitch materials required by field teams.
  • Develop and launch a repeatable Enterprise adoption methodology covering evaluation, production deployment, expansion and scaled adoption.
  • Define the engagement model for Forward Deployed Engineers, Field Engineering and services within strategic Enterprise opportunities.
  • Build and maintain the first regional Enterprise AI adoption graph, identifying market penetration, wallet distribution, major workloads, competitive positions and whitespace.
  • Establish the vertical industry strategy and determine the first priority industry segments.
  • Hire and onboard the initial Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to those industries.
  • Build executive relationships with an initial set of strategic Enterprise customers and partners.
  • Establish the business review cadence, measurement framework and market-share methodology for the Enterprise segment.
  • Demonstrate measurable contribution to Enterprise pipeline, adoption, consumption and overall EMEA Enterprise revenue performance.

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise business development, go-to-market strategy, sales, industry leadership, consulting or product strategy within cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology, AI or another complex technology environment.
  • Significant experience defining and executing Enterprise growth strategies across multiple markets or industries.
  • A proven record of translating market and customer insight into repeatable sales plays, adoption programmes and measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of how large Enterprises evaluate, adopt, govern and scale new technology platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data environments and the operational requirements of production AI.
  • Experience developing segmentation models, executive value propositions, sales plays, industry narratives and adoption methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical architecture with business strategy, operating-model change and executive priorities.
  • Experience working closely with field sales organisations to improve customer targeting, opportunity development, competitive positioning and expansion.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to translate Enterprise requirements into roadmap and investment priorities.
  • Experience designing or leading complex customer adoption programmes involving specialist engineering, consulting, services or Forward Deployed teams.
  • Strong understanding of the Enterprise AI buying landscape, including technology budgets, buying centres, strategic partners and evolving workload economics.
  • Demonstrated experience building senior relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, business leaders and other Enterprise executives.
  • Experience developing industry-specific strategies or leading business development across major Enterprise verticals.
  • Strong analytical capability, with the ability to build market models, adoption frameworks, segmentation strategies and executive-level business reviews.
  • Experience building, hiring, coaching and developing high-performing business development, strategy or industry teams.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing and partner organisations.
  • A record of operating successfully across EMEA markets and cultures, with the ability to travel regularly.

Preferred

  • Leadership experience in Enterprise strategy, business development, industry go-to-market or sales at a major hyperscale cloud provider, AI platform company or global infrastructure technology business.
  • Direct experience building or scaling an Enterprise cloud or AI business measured through customer adoption, consumption, revenue and market share.
  • Experience defining Enterprise architecture or transformation points of view used by large customer-facing organisations.
  • Experience building AI, cloud or data-platform adoption methodologies for large Enterprise customers.
  • Experience with Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, transformation consulting or other high-touch Enterprise adoption models.
  • Deep expertise in one or more major Enterprise industries and a strong understanding of how AI will change industry value chains, operating models and economics.
  • Experience developing public-facing thought leadership and representing a technology company with customers, analysts, media and at major industry events.
  • Established executive relationships across the EMEA Enterprise and technology ecosystem.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Wondering If You’re a Good Fit?

We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring different experiences, even if they do not meet every requirement.

  • You are a builder. You are comfortable starting with an ambition, creating the model and then driving it into execution.
  • You can turn a complex technology and market landscape into a clear point of view that customers and field teams can act on.
  • You can move comfortably between a CIO, a product leader, a field seller, an engineer and an industry executive.
  • You influence through clarity, credibility and conviction rather than positional authority.
  • You understand that great strategy only matters if the field can execute it consistently.
  • You are a confident spokesperson who can represent CoreWeave’s Enterprise narrative in executive meetings, on stage and with the media.
  • You are motivated by building a category and changing how Enterprises think about AI infrastructure, not simply competing for individual transactions.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun and move fast. We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth, we’re not afraid of a little chaos and we’re constantly learning.

Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking, and foster an environment that encourages collaboration and innovative solutions to complex problems. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, with the opportunity to help shape CoreWeave’s future.

Compensation

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location.

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.
