title: Senior Electronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: Our office is located in Oxford, England (UK), with hybrid working 
Job ID: 1820

The Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to join our Reliability Engineering team at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for finding, root-causing, and permanently resolving electronics  and control hardware issues on our operational trapped-ion quantum computers, contributing to the team's mission of improving fleet uptime and driving down the operational cost of our commercial and development systems.

You'll play an important part in owning the full lifecycle of electrical reliability fixes — from identifying a real-world bottleneck through to standardizing the resulting fix into every future build — working closely with Operations, Science, Manufacturing, and Engineering to keep our quantum systems running reliably and effectively. 

Responsibilities:

In this position, you will work on root-causing, designing, and deploying electronics system design fixes across our fleet of quantum systems, supporting the effective delivery of reliable, development and production hardware. You'll have the opportunity to drive system upgrades, standardize control and drive electronics across systems, and build the observability that catches problems before they cause downtime, contributing directly to the success of the Reliability Engineering team.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Triage & root cause: Actively monitor, root-cause, and prioritize electrical, control-system, and drive-electronics issues on live systems based on severity and impact to uptime and performance.
  • Solution development: Design, prototype, build, and test electrical fixes — spanning schematic capture, PCB layout, and board- and system-level test — taking solutions from concept through to permanent integration.
  • Reliability upgrade leadership: Drive electrical workstreams for major fleet-wide upgrades (e.g. control-hardware consolidation, drive-electronics standardization, remote telemetry/monitoring for laser and system health) to reduce variance and downtime across systems.
  • Retrofitting & deployment: Coordinate directly with Operations and Science teams to schedule, deploy, and retrofit upgrades onto live systems while managing operational constraints, and verify fixes improve system performance, reliability or operability. 
  • Documentation & standardization: Feed validated fixes back into engineering documentation, build manifests, and the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process so every improvement is baked into the baseline for all future builds.

Requirements:

To be successful, you will need strong foundations in analogue, RF, and mixed-signal electronics design, experience with the Altium PCB toolset, familiarity with RF concepts and confidence working directly on operational hardware under time pressure. We're looking for someone who can translate a system-level reliability problem into a concrete engineering solution, work across Operations, Science, and Engineering to get it deployed safely, and document it so it sticks. You'd be a great fit with:

  • Analogue and mixed-signal electronics: strong practical experience designing and debugging op-amp circuits, low-noise amplifiers, filters, ADC/DAC modules, grounding, shielding and common digital interfaces. 
  • Altium design control and documentation: strong experience managing evolving schematics and PCB designs in Altium, producing clear technical documentation, and establishing effective review, ERC/DRC, release and change-control processes. 
  • Fault-finding and electrical integration: able to diagnose power supplies, analogue circuits and control electronics, and develop reliable PCBs, adapters, connectors, breakout cables and harnesses. 
  • Stakeholder engagement and delivery: able to gather requirements, explain technical issues and trade-offs across different disciplines, and take solutions through testing, deployment and documentation. 
  • Bonus: familiarity with LVDS and FPGA-based control electronics, cryogenic or RF/microwave systems, and Python-based test automation or telemetry.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Senior Entwicklungsingenieur Mechanik
descriptionHtml:
Über pplwise

pplwise ist eine Recruiting-Beratung für schnell wachsende Technologieunternehmen in ganz Europa. Mit Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search besetzen wir Schlüsselpositionen für unsere Kunden – vom Start-up bis zum börsennotierten Unternehmen. Diese Position besetzen wir für unseren Kunden Filics.

Über unseren Kunden: Filics

Filics erfindet die Intralogistik neu – mit autonomen mobilen Robotern (AMR), die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Dank seines Double-Runner-Systems ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Das bricht mit der Gabelstapler-Logik und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Filics ist ein kleines, praxisorientiertes Team, das schwierige Probleme mit technischer Exzellenz löst. Führung übernimmt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Senior Entwicklungsingenieur -Mechanik bei Filics leitest du die mechanische Konstruktion der Roboter auf dem Weg vom Prototyp zur Serienfertigung.

Die Rolle

Die Stelle ist vor Ort/hybrid in München, nah an Entwicklung und Montage.

Filics entwickelt seine Roboter-Hardware komplett selbst: Mechanik, Elektronik und Software. Die Auftragslage wächst, und die Roboter gehen vom Prototyp in die Serie. Konstruktionen, die im Labor funktioniert haben, müssen jetzt zuverlässig, in Stückzahl und zu den richtigen Kosten gebaut werden. Die schwierigsten Probleme liegen oft zwischen den Disziplinen: Teile, die für sich allein funktionieren, können versagen, sobald sie mit der Elektronik verbaut sind.

Das Mechanik-Team besteht aus vier Personen, die meisten am Anfang ihrer Karriere – und sie brauchen jemanden, der sie täglich anleitet. Du bist der technische Lead für die Mechanik des Produkts und das Gegenüber zum Elektronik-Lead, damit sich die aktuelle Mechanik-Leitung auf die Kernentwicklung konzentrieren kann. Deine Zeit teilt sich etwa zur Hälfte auf praktische Ingenieursarbeit und technische Führung auf. Du arbeitest eng mit Elektronik, Produktion, Einkauf und dem CTO zusammen und prägst die Arbeitsweise im Engineering, solange das Team noch klein ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du coachst das Mechanik-Team im Alltag: Du unterstützt bei Konstruktionsentscheidungen, legst Methoden fest und hältst Projekte im Fokus

  • Du konstruierst Bauteile und Baugruppen im CAD inklusive Tolerierung und prüfst jede Konstruktion vor der Freigabe auf Fertigbarkeit und Kosten

  • Du leitest Test und Integration von Mechanik und Elektronik und löst die Probleme, die erst im zusammengebauten Zustand auftreten

  • Du priorisierst eingehende Aufgaben, verfolgst den Fortschritt und triffst die täglichen technischen Entscheidungen in der Mechanik

  • Du setzt den Stage-Gate-Entwicklungsprozess in der Praxis um und führst Design Reviews (Sicherheit, Mechanik, Elektronik, Fertigbarkeit) durch, bevor Teile integriert werden

  • Du etablierst Design for Manufacturing und Design for Cost: weniger und standardisierte Teile sowie Fertigungsverfahren, die skalieren

  • Du arbeitest vom ersten Prototyp an eng mit den Elektronik-Verantwortlichen der einzelnen Robotermodule zusammen – und mit der Produktion an Fertigbarkeit und Fertigungsvorrichtungen

  • Du baust Prototypen und entwickelst sie auf Basis von Kunden- und Feldfeedback weiter

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion in der Entwicklung eines Unternehmens, das eigene elektromechanische Produkte entwickelt und baut (z. B. Elektrowerkzeuge, Haushaltsgeräte, E-Mobilität, Produktionsmaschinen, Robotik, Schiffsantriebe)

  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, ein elektromechanisches Produkt vom Prototyp in die Serie zu bringen (idealerweise 1.000+ Einheiten pro Jahr) – in einem schnellen Entwicklungszyklus von etwa einem Jahr, nicht in einem jahrzehntelangen Programm

  • Du konstruierst weiterhin selbst im CAD, vor allem Metallteile und Baugruppen, und bist sicher in der Tolerierung (CAD-Tool egal; Onshape ist ein Plus)

  • Du hast Design for Manufacturing und Design for Cost angewendet und Kosten durch Konstruktion gesenkt: weniger Teile, Normteile

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Mentoring oder in der fachlichen Führung von anderen im Engineering; ein Teamleitungstitel ist nicht erforderlich

  • Erfahrung im Testen und in der Integration von Mechanik und Elektronik

  • Du hast Prozesse, Design Reviews oder Engineering-Standards eingeführt, die einem Team geholfen haben, Ergebnisse zu liefern

  • Du gehst souverän mit unklaren Anforderungen um und zerlegst komplexe Probleme so, dass andere daran arbeiten können

  • Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, da in der Produktion überwiegend Deutsch gesprochen wird

  • Bonus: GD&T und Toleranzketten, Konstruktion von Fertigungsvorrichtungen oder Projekte mit Motoren, Motorsteuerungen oder Elektronik

Was Filics bietet

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einer frühen Phase: Du prägst sowohl das Mechanik-Team als auch das Produkt

  • Echte Verantwortung für die Mechanik – vom ersten Prototyp bis zur Serienfertigung

descriptionHtml:

Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you can gain a tremendous amount of responsibility quickly? Do you want to be part of an exceptional team with motivated and extremely driven people? Are you curious or passionate about event operations and logistics? If so, you might be our next member of the operations team.

About Private Equity Insights
Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with over 500k followers on LinkedIn, organizing a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 3,000+ GPs and 2,000+ LPs among the attendees. Private Equity Insights is part of United Media, which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What We Offer You
You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London, where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll get operational experience in a growth company where your work and the results are tangible and have a high impact on the business.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - Boost your interpersonal, research, organization, outreach, and project management skills through experience and training.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Travel opportunity - You will be attending our conferences.

Your Responsibilities
Responsibilities in this job will vary; however, they will be mostly centered around the following:

  1. Supplier Research and Management:
    • Source, compare, and find the best suppliers for various event needs.
    • Conduct thorough research to identify potential suppliers for add-ons, branding materials, and other event requirements.
    • Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure cost-effectiveness and high-quality services.
    • Maintain positive relationships with suppliers, addressing any issues or concerns.

  2. Event Planning:
    • Planning sponsored VIP events, lunches, dinners, and after-hours activities.
    • Coordinating with venue staff to ensure all logistical details are in place.
    • Provide on-site support during events, ensuring everything runs smoothly.

    • Keep track and condense internal team queries.
    • Maintain inventory tracking and regularly update event inventory sheets.

    • Quality check of design aspects such as banners, signage, brochures, and other promotional materials.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Event Management, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience/knowledge in event planning, client management, or supplier research.
  • Strong organisational, multitasking abilities and detail-focused.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with graphic design software such as Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator is highly recommended.
  • UK work permit (we do not sponsor visas).


Start date: Flexible, ASAP

The role is on-site, Monday to Friday, based in our offices near Victoria. It is essential, as we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading events throughout the year.

title: Senior Finance & Strategy Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and want to model the future of a global tech brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager to join our Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you’ll play an integral part in building our business strategy, ensuring we make the most efficient investment and capital allocation decisions to accelerate our global growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We partner cross-functionally to improve the profitability, scalability, and defensibility of our business model, carrying projects from initial conception through to final execution.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Decision Support: Partner with stakeholders across the business to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and drive strategy in a dynamic environment.

  • Growth vs. Profitability: Own complex models and analyses to help the business strike the optimal balance between aggressive growth and long-term profitability.

  • Custom Financial Modelling: Lead high-impact modelling exercises to support key initiatives, sizing new opportunities and building business cases for innovative products.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key financial and business KPIs to uncover trends, assessing current and future risks while identifying new market opportunities.

  • Process Innovation: Lead special projects to automate and scale our forecasting and reporting tools, ensuring our methodologies evolve alongside the business.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with operators and departmental leaders to develop new policies and ensure day-to-day execution aligns with our financial targets.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Finance Leadership: Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within a high-growth tech environment.

  • Team Development: Proven track record of managing and mentoring teams; you are passionate about building a high-performing "gold standard" finance function.

  • Influencing Power: The ability to earn the trust of senior leaders and influence strategic thinking across a matrixed organisation.

  • Technical Mastery: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with the ability to build robust, complex financial models that distill data into digestible insights.

  • Budget Ownership: Experience owning forecasts and budgets for major functional areas, working directly with operators to hit performance targets.

  • Data Agility: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large datasets and uncover hidden business insights.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

Cooles Team – Fairness – Herausforderungen

Unsere Innovation und unsere Power liegen in unseren Mitarbeitern. Darauf sind wir stolz! Mit kununu (Score von 4,7) und dem sachsen-anhaltinischen Landessiegel „Das mitarbeiterorientierte Unternehmen“ zeigen wir das auch gern der ganzen Welt.

  • Du bringst Deine Erfahrung aktiv in technische Diskussionen ein und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Frontend-Standards und Entwicklungsprozesse voran.

    • Jasmine, Jest, Cypress, Playwright oder Selenium

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Frontend Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role — our Frontend team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them

  • Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency

  • React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces

  • Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols

  • Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years)

  • Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols)

  • Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs

  • Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced

  • You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

title: Senior Growth Manager (Health/Supplements) (m/w/d)

Benefits

Warum embelly?

  • Sinnhafte Aufgabe: Hilf Menschen mit echten Beschwerden – mit Produkten, die wirken und Kund:innen langfristig begleiten.
  • Growth mit Substanz: Bei uns optimierst du nicht auf „schönen ROAS“, sondern auf Contribution, Payback und Kohorten – mit echtem Einfluss auf Profitabilität und Skalierung.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Talk360 connects people across 190 countries. Every day, millions rely on us to reach family, friends, customers, colleagues. We're profitable and entering new markets, but we're not planning significant headcount growth.

Right now, we're a team of 35 people spread globally. Small enough to know each other's names, big enough to have real impact. As we grow, everything changes. How we hire, how we grow, what it feels like to be here. That's why we need someone who doesn't just manage HR, but shapes culture intentionally.

Your Goal: Own the Full Employee Journey

As our Senior HR Business Partner, you'll take everything we've built so far and make it your own. From how we attract new colleagues, to how our people grow, reward and support the ones already here.

You will:

  • Run the full employee lifecycle end-to-end: attraction, recruitment (with budget for external support on specialised roles), onboarding, development, performance, engagement and offboarding.

  • Be the go-to person for managers and employees on any people-related question, big or small

  • Keep our career growth framework relevant as the organisation evolves

  • Make sure our salaries stay fair and aligned with the market

  • Keep us compliant, without slowing us down

  • Be a genuine sounding board for the CEO and the Executive Team on people topics

  • Own internal communication. Make sure everyone understands where we're going, why, and what it means for them and their team

  • Turn signals from the organisation into clear input for the Executive Team

Shape how it feels to work here

Talk360 is doing well, and we want that to show in how it feels to work here. You will:

  • Organise the team activities, outings and moments that make people want to stick around, and genuinely enjoy doing it

  • Bring energy to the day-to-day, not just to the big projects

Team

You're the only HR person and you report straight to the CEO, which means People & Culture has genuine influence on how we build this company.

We have an international diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond. You'll work closely with everyone, from support to product to leadership, and you'll actually see your impact as we grow and mature.


What you bring

  • 5+ years of HR experience across the full employee lifecycle, ideally in a start-up or scale-up. You've either been there and done that and want to do it again at a purpose-driven company, or you're a fast-growing medior who is ready to grow as fast as we do

  • Comfortable running day-to-day HR operations as well as owning larger, more complex projects

  • Recruitment experience/exposure

  • Experience with career frameworks, compensation benchmarking (we use Figures) is a plus

  • High energy and a genuine interest in creating a great place to work

  • Business acumen, you understand you are helping us to create a high-performing organization

  • Strong internal communication skills: you can make complex things clear, in writing and in person, for a multicultural audience

Who you are

  • Not afraid to challenge the status quo, including challenging the Executive Team

  • As happy organising a team outing as solving a tricky HR cases

  • A trusted sparring partner for managers and employees

  • Curious, hands-on and pragmatic

  • Comfortable working with a multicultural hybrid team setup across time zones

What you get

Competitive compensation

  • 65,000 – 85,000 gross per year, all in.

  • Option to work 32 hours a week.

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

  • 25 vacation days

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday

  • Regular team moments and outings

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say:

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)

You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.

Why join us?

  • 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.

  • 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.

  • 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.

  • 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

  • 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.

About us – in brief

Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.

Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.

Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

Your Role – What You'll Own

You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.

Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.

Your Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.

  • Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.

  • Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.

  • Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.

  • Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.

  • Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.

  • Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.

  • Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.

  • Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.

What You Bring

We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.

Must-have – Essential Requirements

The following skills and experience are essential for this position:

Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.

  • Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.

  • Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.

Infrastructure Modernization

  • A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.

  • Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.

  • Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.

Identity & Access Management

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.

  • Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.

  • Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.

Endpoint Management

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.

Resilience, Security & Monitoring

  • Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.

  • Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.

  • Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.

Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.

Nice-to-have – Additional Experience

The following skills are beneficial but not essential:

  • Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.

  • Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.

  • Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.

  • Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: (Senior) Internal Audit Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin Group is scaling its Internal Audit function with a dedicated focus on Anti-Financial Crime (AFC). We are looking for a proactive expert to help build and mature this critical pillar of our governance framework. As a key member of our team, you will provide independent assurance, helping us navigate complex regulatory landscapes while driving operational excellence. If you are passionate about risk management and eager to shape the future of this young Group Internal Audit team, we invite you to join us.

Your Responsibilities

  • Audit Execution: Conduct audits as per the annual audit plan. Experience in AML and other regulations combating financial crime and relevant standards and frameworks is highly appreciated. In addition, you will have the chance to develop and form the audit function within Raisin Group.
  • Compliance and Risk Assessment: Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of controls, procedures, and systems to ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
  • Reporting and Recommendations: Prepare detailed reports on audit findings, recommend improvements, and monitor the implementation of audit recommendations.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with various internal stakeholders, including risk management, and compliance teams, to ensure alignment on governance and compliance issues.
  • Audit Project Management: Manage and coordinate internal and external audits, ensuring timely and thorough execution of audit plans.
  • Management reporting: Prepare quarterly and annual reporting to Senior Management and presentations for relevant Committees.

Your Profile

  • Educational Background: Degree in Business Administration, Law, Economics, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CIA, CAMS, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of experience in auditing, governance, risk, and compliance, ideally within the international financial services or FinTech industry. Proven experience in outsourcing/service provider management is a significant asset.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of German financial regulations (BaFin, MaRisk) and EBA guidelines, with a specific, demonstrated focus on Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) frameworks.
  • Interpersonal & Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge complex technical requirements and business interests effectively.
  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English and German is required. Proficiency in other European languages is a strong advantage.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

Köln

Dein Tech Stack

Linux I Proxmox I pfSense I Bash I Python I Ansible I Hybrid Infrastructure I Monitoring

IT-Infrastruktur ist genau Dein Spielfeld?

Du möchtest nicht nur Systeme administrieren, sondern die technische Zukunft eines Unternehmens aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann bist Du bei IRIS genau richtig.

Wir sind eines der international führenden Unternehmen für Medien-, Markt- und Sponsoringforschung im Sport. Unsere Analysen unterstützen internationale Sportverbände, Vereine, Ligen, Sponsoren und Unternehmen dabei, den Erfolg ihrer Medien- und Sponsoringaktivitäten messbar zu machen.

Damit unsere Systeme auch künftig stabil, sicher und hochverfügbar arbeiten, suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior IT-Administrator / System Engineer, der die fachliche Verantwortung für unsere IT-Administration übernimmt und unsere Infrastruktur aktiv weiterentwickelt.

Bei uns erwarten Dich kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, technische Ideen schnell in die Praxis umzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres IT-Teams übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle im Betrieb und in der Weiterentwicklung unserer Infrastruktur. Du denkst nicht in Tickets, sondern in Lösungen, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Themen eigenständig voran.

Etwa 60% Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du an Projekten und Modernisierungen, 40% entfallen auf Betrieb und Optimierung unserer bestehenden Systeme.

Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Fachliche Verantwortung für unsere IT-Administration
  • Betreuung, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Linux-Infrastruktur
  • Betrieb und Ausbau unserer Virtualisierungsplattform auf Basis von Proxmox
  • Administration unserer Netzwerk- und Firewall-Infrastruktur (pfSense)
  • Planung und Weiterentwicklung hybrider Infrastrukturen (On-Premise & Cloud)
  • Aufbau und Pflege sicherer Standort- und Cloud-VPNs
  • Monitoring unserer Infrastruktur sowie proaktive Fehleranalyse
  • Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen
  • Weiterentwicklung von Automatisierungs- und Standardisierungsprozessen
  • Technische Bewertung neuer Anforderungen und Ableitung nachhaltiger Infrastrukturentscheidungen
  • Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Systemlandschaft

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

In den kommenden Monaten gestaltest Du unter anderem folgende Projekte aktiv mit:

  • Aufbau einer dezentralen IT-Infrastruktur
  • Einführung einer hochverfügbaren Infrastruktur (HA-Cluster)
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Linux- und Proxmox-Plattform
  • Ausbau der Netzwerk- und Sicherheitsarchitektur
  • Weitere Automatisierung unserer Infrastruktur

Du arbeitest dabei nicht nur an einzelnen Komponenten, sondern prägst die technische Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens langfristig mit.

Deine Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als IT-Administrator, System Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Linux-Administration
  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung, idealerweise Proxmox
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Netzwerken (Routing, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Firewalling)
  • Grundkenntnisse in Bash, Python oder Ansible
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Lösungen (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana, Checkmk oder Zabbix)
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, mindestens auf C1-Niveau
  • Sicheres Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu vertreten

Darüber freuen wir uns zusätzlich

  • Erfahrung mit pfSense oder vergleichbaren Firewall-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit hybriden Infrastrukturen
  • Docker oder LXC
  • Backup-, Storage- oder Hochverfügbarkeitslösungen
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS, Azure, Hetzner)
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich IT-Security und Hardening
  • Erfahrung mit Dokumentation und strukturiertem Change-Management

Das bieten wir Dir

  • Fachliche Verantwortung für unsere IT-Administration
  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum bei technischen Entscheidungen
  • Direkter Einfluss auf unsere Infrastrukturstrategie
  • Rund 60% Projektarbeit statt ausschließlich Betrieb
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege ohne Konzernstrukturen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Hybrides Arbeiten (etwa 2 Präsenztage / Woche, Rest Homeoffice / Mobil)
  • Moderne Linux-basierte Infrastruktur
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien und ein kollegiales Team
  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

Deine Einarbeitung
Natürlich lassen wir Dich nicht allein.
Du erhältst einen strukturierten Einstieg in unsere Systeme und Prozesse. Gemeinsam mit dem Team lernst Du unsere Infrastruktur kennen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für Deinen Bereich.

Warum IRIS?

Wir glauben, dass gute IT dort entsteht, wo Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln.
Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, nicht nur zu betreiben, sondern aktiv zu gestalten. Deine Arbeit ist sichtbar, Deine Entscheidungen haben Einfluss und Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Unsere Standorte: Köln Ehrenfeld und Karlsruhe Durlach: Beide Büros haben eine gute Anbindung an die Autobahn und den ÖPNV. In unseren Büros findet sich überall – in der Dekoration oder auch im Miteinander – das Thema Sport. Alle Büroplätze werden geteilt und über ein Buchungssystem individuell für den Arbeitstag zur Verfügung gestellt. Für diese Stelle suchen wir explizit nur Bewerber im Kölner Raum.

Echt ist uns wichtiger als perfekt

Wir wissen: Künstliche Intelligenz gehört heute für viele ganz selbstverständlich dazu – auch bei Bewerbungen. Das ist für uns völlig in Ordnung.

Nutze KI gerne als Unterstützung. Was uns wirklich interessiert, bist Du: Deine Denkweise, Deine Erfahrung und Dein Anspruch an gute IT. Deine Bewerbung muss nicht perfekt formuliert sein – wichtiger ist, dass sie authentisch ist.

Denn am Ende suchen wir keinen perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust hat, Dinge besser zu machen.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Lebenswegen. Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Kompetenz – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität.

Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Job?
Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!
Auch wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung zu 100% erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Motivation, Haltung und Lernbereitschaft sind uns oft wichtiger als ein lückenloser Tech-Stack.

title: Senior Licensing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA will play a critical role in strategically growing and leading the UEFA Masterlicense business unit.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA serves as the senior lead for the UEFA Masterlicense business, owning client and licensee relationships while ensuring operational and financial objectives are met with precision and efficiency. This role partners closely with senior leadership to develop and execute strategic licensing plans that maximize revenue, position client brands appropriately, and identify new business opportunities across the European licensing landscape. The Director, Licensing – UEFA delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Communicate division strategy clearly across licensing, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure cohesive execution against the UEFA Masterlicense program's goals and objectives.
  • Partner with senior leadership to report key business results to corporate officers and align divisional priorities with enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Finance on royalty reporting and royalty accounting, and with Legal on contract drafting and negotiation, ensuring seamless cross-functional delivery.

People Leadership:

  • Lead and direct the UEFA licensing business unit, setting performance goals for direct reports and providing ongoing evaluation against the group's objectives.
  • Develop team members through clear expectations, coaching, and alignment to BOLD leadership principles to build a high-performing licensing organization.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with UEFA and all licensing clients, key stakeholders, business partners, and strategic alliances to advance each client's licensing program.
  • Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of all Fanatics Licensing Management (FLM) clients to proactively anticipate needs and deliver consistently high levels of service.
  • Oversee day-to-day management of client licensing programs — including contract negotiation and royalty reporting — ensuring clients receive accurate, timely, and strategic partnership support.
  • Represent FLM at industry licensing trade shows and participate in business sessions with leading licensees to strengthen relationships and elevate the Fanatics brand in the European market.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Assist in identifying new business opportunities that align with high-quality business strategies and support both short-term and long-term objectives of the UEFA licensing program.
  • Work with the senior leadership team to develop and implement innovative strategic licensing plans that position client brands competitively and maximize licensing revenue.
  • Continuously evaluate operational and logistics processes within the licensing business unit, identifying improvements that drive greater efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Stay connected to industry trends and competitive dynamics in the European sports licensing landscape, bringing forward-thinking perspectives to client and business strategy.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Own the day-to-day management of the P&L for the UEFA licensing business unit, ensuring the division achieves its strategic and financial objectives.
  • Oversee the development of annual reports for clients, delivering accurate and insightful performance summaries that inform future licensing strategy.
  • Manage competing priorities and complex stakeholder relationships simultaneously, operating with exceptional attention to detail and a self-starter mindset in a fast-paced environment.
  • Take full accountability for divisional results, driving a culture of relentless execution and continuous improvement across all licensing operations.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in the licensing industry, with demonstrated expertise in managing licensing programs, client relationships, and contractual obligations.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer and client relations, with a proven ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships at a senior level.
  • 3+ years of management experience, including directing teams and evaluating performance against defined business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a business unit P&L and deliver against financial and strategic targets.
  • Experience in contract negotiation and working cross-functionally with Legal and Finance teams on licensing agreements and royalty processes.
  • Motivated self-starter with the ability to excel at multi-tasking in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present key results to senior and corporate leadership.

Education:

Bachelor's degree required.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Paris or Manchester.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

title: Senior Linux Distribution & Validation Engineer

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Messaging Platform
descriptionHtml:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.

The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.

We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.


What You'll Do
  • Design, build, and ship machine learning models that optimize messaging across push, email, and in-app channels
  • Plan and run A/B experiments in a multi-objective environment, balancing conversion, engagement, retention, and reachability
  • Contribute to reinforcement learning systems that optimize for long-term user outcomes rather than immediate interactions
  • Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define what success looks like and how to measure it
  • Own the full ML lifecycle, from data and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Integrate ML models with upstream systems, including domain value signals and opportunity generation frameworks
  • Help shape the future of AI-assisted development within the team, exploring how tools can accelerate experimentation and delivery

    • Who You Are
    • You have strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments at scale
    • You are comfortable translating business problems into ML solutions and discussing trade-offs with cross-functional partners
    • You have worked on complex optimization problems such as ranking systems or multi-objective decision-making
    • You bring hands-on experience with PyTorch and distributed systems such as Ray or similar frameworks
    • You understand experimentation deeply and can design reliable tests in environments with interacting metrics
    • You are able to analyze results using approaches like causal inference or metric decomposition when needed
    • You have experience with or curiosity about reinforcement learning and long-term optimization systems
    • You enjoy working across disciplines and navigating ambiguity while shaping strategy and direction

    Where You'll Be
    • This role is based in London and Stockholm
    • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home
    Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
descriptionHtml:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers.

Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production.

This role is for you if…

you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk.

This role isn't for you if…

your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach.

  • Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces.

  • Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing.

  • Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining.

  • Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design.

  • Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data.

  • Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production.

  • Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems.

  • Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production.

  • Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs.

  • Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions.

  • Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.

  • Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

  • Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting.

  • Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products.

  • Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components.

  • Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

  • Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability).

  • Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes.

  • Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials.

  • Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR.

  • Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge.

  • Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

  • Legacy modernisation experience: You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers.

  • Testing in legacy contexts: Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems.

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of

✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture

✅ You care about product quality, not just “shipping code”.

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features

✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions

This probably isn’t your dream job if…

⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements

⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them
