title: Senior Social Media Manager (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Wir bei T&P verstehen uns als datengetriebene Kommunikationsagentur, deren Mission es ist, Kreativität, Technologie und Daten auf neue, aufregende und effektive Weise zu verknüpfen. Wir nennen es das &Modell und die Prämisse ist einfach: Kreation, Strategie, Media und Daten/CRM arbeiten Hand in Hand und lösen Herausforderungen als ein Team, das nah und partnerschaftlich mit dem Kunden zusammenarbeitet.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Social Media Manager übernimmst du den strategischen Lead für die Kanäle etablierter Marken: Von der Redaktionsleitung über zielgerichtete Kampagnen bis zur fachlichen Führung deines Accounts verwandelst du Ideen in reichweitenstarken Content mit messbarem Impact.
  • Content-Lead & Redaktionsplanung: Du entwickelst kanalübergreifende Social Media-Strategien und Content-Konzepte. Die übergeordnete redaktionelle Verantwortung liegt in deinen Händen. Von strategischen Themenplänen und Kanal-Positionierungen bis hin zu Content-Pillars steuerst du Workflows und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Qualitätssicherung (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube etc.).
  • Kreativ-Lead & Brand Voice: Als Expert:in für alle Plattformen arbeitest du im engen Sparring mit Art & Copy. Du führst und entwickelst die Kanäle in der passenden Tonalitäten, bringst komplexe Themen treffsicher auf den Punkt und gibst als Reviewer wertvolles Feedback.
  • Plattform-Trends & First-Mover: Du hast ein Gespür für Plattform-Updates, Algorithmen, Sounds und Popkultur-Trends,  antizipierst sie vorausschauend und integrierst sie strategisch in die Redaktionsplanung. Du leitest relevante First-Mover-Konzepte ab und machst markenadäquates Trend-Jacking zur strategischen Stärke.
  • Community-Strategie: Neben der Konzeption professioneller Community-Guidelines begleitest du anspruchsvolle Markendialoge mit diplomatischem Fingerspitzengefühl und baust gezielt Brand-Communities auf.
  • Performance & Paid Social: Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für deine Social KPIs, übersetzt Daten in klare strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für Kundentermine und stimmst Kampagnen sowie Budgets auf Meta, TikTok oder LinkedIn gemeinsam mit den Media-Teams ab.
  • Mentoring & Team-Development: Mit deiner Erfahrung leitest du Junior- und Mid-Level Kolleg:innen fachlich an, begleitest ihr Onboarding und förderst den kontinuierlichen Wissenstransfer.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 4–6 Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Management und in der Content-Strategie (von Vorteil: Agenturumfeld o. auf etablierter Markenseite) sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Führung reichweitenstarker Multichannel-Accounts.
  • Strategie- & Redaktionssicherheit: Routinierter und strukturierter Umgang mit komplexen Redaktionsabläufen, kanalübergreifenden Workflows und anspruchsvollen Freigabeprozessen.
  • Kreativgespür & Sparring: Führungs- und Moderationsstärke, ausgeprägte Kooperationsfähigkeit sowie ein Gespür für Storytelling und integrierte Kampagnenansätze.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Stilsicheres Text- und Schreibtalent mit verhandlungssicherem Deutsch (C1-C2-Niveau) und fließendem Englisch (C1) sowie viel Feingefühl im Markendialog.
  • Plattform- & Tool-Know-how: Ausgeprägte Expertise im Umgang mit Meta Business Suite sowie gängigen Social Media Marketing Tools. Tiefes Verständnis der Plattformlogiken von TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und YouTube sowie deren Auswirkungen auf Content-Strategie und Performance.
  • Analytics & Paid-Social-Know-how: Starkes Zahlenverständnis, sichere Anwendung gängiger Social-Analytics-Tools und C-Level-Präsentationen sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von Paid und Organic für einen smarten Budgeteinsatz.
  • Mentoring-Mindset: Motivation und Freude daran, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu coachen und zu fördern.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #proaktiv #kommunikativ #motiviert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

  • Contribute to technical direction and strategy in support of the long-term product vision.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Critically evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot AI-generated output, using effective prompting and appropriate safeguards rather than accepting results at face value.

  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teammates improve how they use AI tools.

  • Improve developer experience through tools, automation, and engineering practices that enable reliable, frequent delivery.

  • Collaborate across product and platform teams, and contribute to an environment where people learn, grow, give constructive feedback, and raise challenges safely.

Your profile:

  • Professional software engineering experience (React, Node.js) and designing reliable backend services and APIs. Experience with React Native experience is a plus.

  • Able to work effectively across system boundaries and collaborate with engineers outside your primary specialism.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Able to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated output, use effective prompting where relevant, and share practical learnings with teammates.

  • Experience working with a public cloud environment such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts and practices, including CI/CD, observability, and operating software in production.

  • Understanding of core application and backend concepts such as authentication, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.

  • A builder-first, pragmatic approach: You turn customer problems into shipped outcomes. You take initiative, test and learn quickly, and make clear trade-offs between speed, quality, maintainability, and risk.

  • Passion for writing maintainable, elegant code and continuously improving how software is built.

  • A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively.

  • You have a builder mindset. You thrive in environments where things are still taking shape, take initiative to move ideas forward, and find ways to create impact even when the path isn't fully defined.

  • You embrace trying things out over waiting for perfect conditions, ship early to learn fast, and treat iteration as progress.

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Software Engineer – DevOps & Infrastructure entwickelst und betreust du die Tools und Infrastruktur, die es unseren Engineering-Teams ermöglichen, Software effizient zu entwickeln, zu testen und bereitzustellen. Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere Entwicklungs- und Build-Infrastruktur, stellst zuverlässige Prozesse sicher und gestaltest aktiv deren zukünftige Architektur und Weiterentwicklung mit.

  • Du entwickelst und optimierst unsere CI/CD-, Build- und Release-Infrastruktur kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du entwickelst und pflegst unsere Nix-basierten Build-Tools und deren CI/CD-Integration sowie unsere NixOS-basierten Betriebssysteme. Dabei nutzt du dein fundiertes Verständnis moderner Linux-Systeme, einschließlich systemd, Netzwerken, Prozessen, Dateisystemen, Paketverwaltung und Systemkonfiguration.
  • Du entwickelst und betreust interne Engineering-Tools, hauptsächlich mit Python und Bash.
  • Du ermöglichst unseren Entwicklungs- und QA-Teams, Software effizient zu bauen, zu testen und zu veröffentlichen, indem du zuverlässige Tools und Infrastruktur bereitstellst.
  • Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere Entwicklungs- und Build-Infrastruktur und gestaltest deren zukünftige Architektur und Ausrichtung aktiv mit.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Software Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Build Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Linux-Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung mit Nix und dem Nix-Build-System, idealerweise auch mit NixOS.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Wartung von CI/CD-Systemen wie GitLab CI/CD oder GitHub Actions sowie im Umgang mit großen Monorepos.
  • Du bringst fundierte Software-Engineering-Kenntnisse mit, idealerweise in Python und Bash.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für komplexe technische Themen und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher mit Entwicklungs-, QA- und Infrastrukturteams und sprichst fließend Englisch. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
  • Du bringst idealerweise zusätzliche Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen mit:
    • Container-Technologien und Kubernetes
    • Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
    • Cloud-Plattformen wie GCP oder AWS
    • Go oder Rust für System- und Infrastrukturentwicklung

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Individuen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativen und vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was Du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, EGYM‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Mitarbeiterbenefits.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

This team spends most of its time working on customer focused features that improve the user experience, from content discovery and search to Roku pay and subscription to embedded software and firmware, and much more. Our product roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide. Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media.

What is the role?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the OS UI/SDK team, you will design, develop, and deliver engaging platform features — including screensavers, static and dynamic wallpapers, trivia, featured experiences, and AI-driven content initiatives — that reach millions of Roku users worldwide. You will leverage AI and machine learning technologies to develop new capabilities that enhance user experiences across the Roku platform. This role requires a proactive, ownership-driven approach where you will create proof-of-concept prototypes in a startup-minded environment and then adapt those prototypes for production-grade deployment. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in UI/UX design, product management, backend engineering, and business leadership to translate ideas into impactful solutions. You will investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain high-quality, commercially viable products. This is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming entertainment through innovation and a deep commitment to engineering excellence.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Design and develop features for new experiences on the Roku platform, including screensavers, wallpapers, trivia, and featured experiences
  • Build proof-of-concept prototypes to validate ideas rapidly, working with a startup mindset to iterate quickly and deliver solutions
  • Collaborate with UI/UX design, backend engineering, and product management teams to create and implement new user experiences
  • Adapt proof-of-concept solutions into production-ready, scalable implementations
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and large language model technologies to develop innovative platform features
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain commercially viable solutions
  • Contribute to API design decisions, understanding considerations and trade-offs
  • Work across cloud development, content management, and UI development to deliver end-to-end feature solutions

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • Extensive experience in a software engineering environment
  • Demonstrated project work using AI/ML and LLM technologies
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React Native, Python, BrightScript, or related technologies
  • Experience working in an embedded environment
  • Experience in productionising solutions, including content management, UI development, cloud development, and cloud backend integration
  • Knowledge of core OS concepts such as memory management and multi-threading
  • Experience in API design, with an understanding of considerations and trade-offs
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Consumer electronics experience in media, content, or ad product development is a plus
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
#LI-AM3

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - EMEA Pricing and Affordability
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - EMEA Pricing and Affordability

You'll join EMEA Pricing & Affordability, the team that owns how an order is priced for consumers across EMEA: service and delivery fees, distance-based pricing and surcharges, fee discounts and the benefits that subscribers get. Our work sits right at the cart and checkout, on the new Pedregal platform shared across Deliveroo and Wolt.

Price is the most visible part of every order. Getting it right means customers can see what they'll pay and trust it, and can afford to order again. That drives conversion, order frequency and retention, and it is one of the biggest levers on both consumer growth and marketplace economics. Our roadmap covers subscriber pricing, service fee optimisation, distance-based pricing, long distance surcharges and priority delivery, so the work reaches millions of orders in many markets.

As a full stack engineer on this team you'll take pricing features from idea to production: designing fee and discount logic on the backend, building the checkout and basket experience that shows it, and measuring the result through experiments. You'll be expected to be comfortable with Go and React, with correctness and testing for money-critical code, and with working closely with Product, Data and the teams across Pedregal. Your changes will be seen by consumers within weeks of shipping, and you'll help decide what we build next.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us build and scale seamless, high-performance features that span our entire stack, ensuring a world-class experience for our customers, partners, and riders.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team's remit, developing, releasing and running large-scale web applications whilst transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture

  • Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features, whilst defining the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area

  • Optimise Operations:Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems

  • Collaborate & Influence: Build relationships across global engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and influence the wider technical roadmap.

  • Mentor & Hire: Support the personal growth of your colleagues through technical guidance and take an active role in conducting engineering interviews to scale our team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software
  • Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software.

  • Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust, React).

  • Data Proficiency: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and "NoSQL" backends like Redis, DynamoDB, or ElasticSearch.

  • Systems at Scale: Proven ability to manage web architecture at scale (handling 20krpm and above).

  • Technical Leadership: Experience breaking down large pieces of work and guiding implementation choices for a team of engineers.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Software Engineer FullStack Kotlin / React - Berlin (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
What we do

Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

 

What you'll do

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer FullStack to join the FIRE (FHIR & Interoperability Requirements EHR) team in the Clinical domain.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your mission will be to ensure that Doctolib DE is well connected to the German digital health ecosystem and compliant with FHIR standards. You will be responsible for the interoperability of the German EHR (Electronic Health Record): connection to the Telematik-Infrastruktur (TI), electronic prescriptions (eRezept), qualified electronic signature (QES), connected medical devices (GDT), and integration of laboratory results.

 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and maintain the integration with German governmental health services, ensuring other Doctolib teams can seamlessly interact with the German health system through your platform

  • Drive the integration of the national EHR (Electronic Health Record) into Doctolib, with a multi-country rollout approach, navigating each country's standards and technical constraints

  • Design, ship, and operate production-grade fullstack solutions that connect the Doctolib platform to complex healthcare infrastructure

  • Partner with other engineering teams to shape the architecture of Doctolib's interoperability platform

  • Ensure privacy, security, and compliance by design in one of healthcare's most regulated technical environments

  • Own performance, observability, and reliability: monitoring dashboards, SLO/SLI, and system health

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's future interoperability strategy across Europe

 

About our tech environment

  • Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • The FIRE team works on a FullStack scope: React / TypeScript on the frontend and Kotlin on the backend.

  • Our broader stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here!

 

Who you are

Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions!

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

  • You have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with strong fullstack expertise, particularly in Kotlin and React/TypeScript

  • You have a track record of building robust, end-to-end solutions that balance technical excellence with intuitive user experiences

  • You are able to design systems (system design) and make sound architectural decisions in complex environments

  • You understand and promote best practices related to the software development life cycle: automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps practices (you build it, you run it)

  • You are curious, autonomous, and have a taste for exploring new systems : you are comfortable solving problems without complete documentation

  • You are at ease in complex technical environments with many external dependencies and evolving standards

  • You are eager to share your knowledge and help the team grow through pair programming and mentoring

  • You are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team, German is a plus

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with healthcare interoperability standards, particularly FHIR, HL7, or similar

  • Have experience integrating with governmental or regulated health systems (e.g. Telematik-Infrastruktur, eRezept, GDT)

  • Are familiar with the German digital health ecosystem

 

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • Feature Building Interview

  • System Design Interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • Reference check

  • Offer!

Job details

  • Full-time

  • Location: Berlin

  • Working mode: Hybrid

  • Start date: as soon as possible

  • Total Cash Compensation: min 65K - max 95K (including 10% performance-based bonus)

f you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles!

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Munich or working remotely from Germany. You will build the services behind our shopping rewards experience, online and in-store, which helps users get more value for their money.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap.
  • Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.

Your Profile:

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with:

  • 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side.
  • Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot.
  • Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems.
  • Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns.
  • Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and mentor more junior members of a software development team.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️

*It varies from 1 to 3 interviews
*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day.One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Drone Software Engineer to join a swarming programme. As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects. 

You will not be siloed; this role spans the entire autonomy lifecycle, from developing autonomy capabilities to investigating real-world flight-test data. 

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across the autonomy stack and partner integrations
  • Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners to define system requirements and translate them into robust software architecture
  • Design and implement robust distributed state machines, leader election protocols, and fault-tolerant architectures.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our Talent Acquisition team is growing! We’re looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to join our team in London.

In this role you will act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on hiring, own our most complex and senior searches from intake through offer and acceptance, and lead improvements that help the whole TA team hire faster and rely less on agencies. This is a senior individual contributor role, working as a peer to our TA Managers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own senior, confidential and particularly complex searches personally, from intake through offer and acceptance, sourcing directly and building the pipeline yourself

  • Translate the approved hiring plan into a delivery plan for your portfolio, advising the Head of TA on capacity, trade-offs and risks, and recommending agency or tool use where it is needed

  • Partner with senior business leaders as a trusted advisor on hiring strategy, talent availability, market conditions and compensation, challenging requirements when the evidence supports a change

  • Bring market insight and talent data into conversations with hiring managers, and turn business goals into hiring plans and targets

  • Coach hiring managers beyond process compliance, helping them spot gaps, bias and blind spots and make fair, consistent, evidence-based decisions

  • Improve intake quality, structured assessment, interviewer preparation and candidate communication, and take ownership of the improvement projects agreed with the Head of TA

  • Lead reviews of your searches, and facilitate wider reviews when agreed with the Head of TA, to spot stalled searches, weak pipelines and decision delays

  • Strengthen candidate experience, turn candidate feedback into improvements and support employer brand activity where agreed

  • Share search expertise, mentor peers and support the TA Specialist on complex briefs, leading through expertise and influence rather than line authority

  • Keep Ashby data reliable, report delivery forecasts, funnel conversion, offer outcomes, quality of hire and risks, and build on our AI-led recruitment tools with people making every hiring decision

About You

  • Experience delivering senior or complex recruitment in-house, having personally owned end-to-end hiring across multiple role types and levels, not only managed a team that does it

  • A track record in targeted recruitment campaigns and direct sourcing, with clear examples of what you built and what it produced

  • Experience influencing and challenging senior leaders and hiring managers as a trusted advisor on talent decisions, without line authority (formal line management experience is not required)

  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to turn business goals into hiring plans and targets

  • Excellent assessment skills and a good eye for potential, with a commitment to inclusive, structured hiring

  • Confident using recruitment data and market insight to diagnose problems, forecast delivery and check whether changes are working, with familiarity with ATS platforms and recruitment tools (Ashby is a plus)

  • Sound judgement with confidential information, experience negotiating offers and strong organisation across several live searches

  • Helpful but not essential: building a sourcing capability, improving recruitment processes or supporting hiring through organisational growth

title: Senior Value Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The UK Value Engineering team is responsible for our largest Fortune500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with Data and AI. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis data & AI platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments. 

The Role:

As a Senior Value Engineer you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers by owning their end-to-end value journey. You are their trusted technology & business advisor, helping organisations achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, helping organisations understand where Celonis fits into their IT landscape and AI strategy, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements. Your skillset combines a strong understanding of technology at both strategic and practical levels with consulting skills around strategic thinking and program management. 


The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Advise organisations on how Celonis’ platform fits into their existing IT landscape and AI strategy
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Use hands-on tech skills (SQL/Python) to build out (AI) prototypes to bring the Celonis platform to life for new audiences
  • Communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives.

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), Hands-on SQL and/or Python skills,, experience in collaborating with IT teams, experience developing dashboards and automations in tools like PowerBI or RPA, knowledge of and experience with AI-powered solutions.

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics or a comparable technical degree

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: SEO Content Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij werken voor een bedrijf met een duidelijke missie? Zo eentje waar ze klant en collega op de eerste plaats zetten? En waar je met jouw teksten écht van waarde bent in het leven van de lezers? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen als SEO Content Specialist
Als SEO Content Specialist ben jij samen met je collega’s verantwoordelijk voor alle teksten en blogs op de Independer website. Het schrijven en optimaliseren van flitsende teksten zit jou in het bloed. Tegelijkertijd haal je ook energie uit het verbeteren van onze contentstrategie en -planning. Je bepaalt samen met je SEO-collega’s waar de prio’s komen te liggen. Wordt jouw tekst gevonden via Google? Jij houdt de resultaten nauwlettend in de gaten. Want dat er altijd ruimte is voor verbetering begrijp jij maar al te goed.

Geen dag is hetzelfde bij Independer. Onze producten hebben betrekking op veel levensgebeurtenissen en raken zoveel mensen dat je alle kanten op kunt. De ene dag schrijf je een inhoudelijke tekst voor onze eigen website, de andere dag werk je mee aan een nieuwsbericht of onderzoek. Dat kan over van alles gaan. Van het verduurzamen van je huis tot het vinden van een goede hypotheek. Zo steek je de teksten de ene keer commercieel in en de andere keer juist informatief. Aan afwisseling geen gebrek. En je leert er inhoudelijk ook nog veel van. Mooi meegenomen, toch?

Concreet ga je aan de slag met: 

  • Het schrijven en optimaliseren van online content
    Je schrijft 70% van de tijd, waarbij je altijd begint met een SEO onderzoek.

  • Schrijven voor de gebruiker
    Als SEO Content Specialist weet je dat je goed moet kijken naar de intentie en doelen van de gebruiker. Ook houd je de concurrentie scherp in de gaten.

  • Rapportage en presentatie
    Je houdt de voortgang van onze contentprestaties bij en kijkt voortdurend of we onze doelstellingen halen. Dit rapporteer je ook naar je team. En natuurlijk stuur je bij als dat nodig is.


Team
Als SEO Content Specialist ben je onderdeel van het negenkoppige SEO-team, dat weer onderdeel is van het brede Independer marketingteam. We zijn als team ook onderdeel van de afdeling Online Services van DPG Media (ons moederbedrijf). Hierdoor werken we één keer per maand met zijn allen samen in Hilversum of in Amsterdam op het DPG kantoor. Tussendoor kun je altijd bij je mede-specialisten terecht met vragen en ideeën.

Wat wij bieden

  • Leuke events, borrels en sportactiviteiten

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide en gezonde lunch

  • Een fijn kantoor met gratis parkeergelegenheid en station Hilversum op loopafstand

  • En natuurlijk een bedrijf vol enthousiaste collega’s!


Wat wij zoeken
Onze nieuwe collega is bovenal een supergoede schrijver. Je maakt met jouw pen ieder onderwerp boeiend, schrijft foutloos en werk gestructureerd. Daarnaast geef je feedback op teksten van je collega's. Ook houd je de contentprestaties bij in een rapportage en weet hier lessen uit te trekken. Als SEO Content Specialist heb je al de nodige SEO werkzaamheden verricht. Je blijft graag op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen en verwerkt deze ook in je werkzaamheden. Wat maakt jou verder de ideale kandidaat:

  • Minimaal 2+ jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol

  • Je vindt het leuk om af en toe je eigen zij-projecten op te zetten.

  • Je kunt je goed uitdrukken in zowel Nederlands als Engels, en foutloos Nederlands schrijven is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Waarom juist Independer?
Omdat je bij Independer echt impact kunt maken op het leven van de klant. Samen met jouw SEO-collega’s bind en boei je klanten door middel van krachtige teksten Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid bij ons en hierdoor is er veel ruimte voor jouw ideeën en oplossingen.

Het DNA van Independer kenmerkt zich door optimisme, klantgerichtheid en actief samenwerken. Dit zie je terug in een werkomgeving waar je volledig jezelf kunt zijn, zelf de regie hebt over je professionele ontwikkeling en alle vrijheid krijgt om je werk naar eigen inzicht uit te voeren. Daarnaast werk je op een plek waar je in de pauzes kunt poolen of tafeltennissen, én krijg je de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

We mogen onszelf officieel een Great Place to Work noemen. We hebben de titel gekregen van onze collega's en Great Place to Work Nederland. Wat dat inhoudt? Onze collega's noemen dit een fijne organisatiecultuur waar ze met veel plezier, vertrouwen en trots willen werken.

title: Social & Creative Content Manager
descriptionHtml:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

At DeepL, our team is passionate about bringing creativity, fresh perspectives, and bold ideas to how we show up in the world. We believe great social content goes beyond visibility—it builds connections, sparks conversations, and makes complex technology feel approachable, relevant, and human.

We're a collaborative, creative team that values strong ideas, experimentation, and a deep understanding of digital culture. From developing standout content to shaping larger brand campaigns, we work closely with internal teams, agencies, and creative partners to bring DeepL's story to life in meaningful and engaging ways.

As our brand continues to evolve, there's plenty of room to make an impact, challenge conventions, and help define what's next for DeepL's social presence.

Your responsibilities

  • Create standout content: Concept, produce, and publish social-first content across formats, including short-form video, motion graphics, static assets, carousels, and copy, collaborating with creative partners where needed.

  • Shape our visual presence: Translate DeepL's brand identity into distinctive, high-quality creative that feels native to each platform and builds a recognizable presence.

  • Own social strategy and execution: Lead our editorial calendar, publishing, and channel strategy, developing creative concepts and formats that grow our audience and engagement.

  • Lead agency and creative partners: Manage our social agency, freelancers, and production partners, setting clear briefs, guiding creative execution, and ensuring consistently high-quality output.

  • Tell compelling stories: Turn product launches, technology breakthroughs, customer stories, and company moments into content that makes complex ideas accessible and engaging.

  • Stay ahead of culture and technology: Spot emerging trends and creative opportunities, and experiment with GenAI tools to push the boundaries of content creation.

  • Build and engage our community: Work with our agency and partners to foster meaningful conversations, identify relevant creators, and explore collaborations that introduce DeepL to new audiences.

  • Measure and improve: Use performance data, audience insights, and social listening to understand what resonates and continuously sharpen our creative approach.

  • Bring our brand to life: Collaborate across Communications, Brand, Marketing, and Product on storytelling and creative campaigns, with opportunities to contribute to broader brand projects as the role evolves.

Qualities we look for

  • 5+ years of experience in social content creation, creative production, design, or a related role, ideally at a technology, AI, or design-led company.

title: Software Engineer - Backend - Behavioral Security Products
descriptionHtml:
At Abnormal AI, we protect our customers against nefarious adversaries who are constantly evolving their techniques and tactics to outwit and undermine the traditional approaches to Security.

About The Team

This team owns the end-to-end development and operation of the infrastructure, ML models, AI agents, customer-facing APIs, and internal tools that power Abnormal's Identity Threat Protection (ITP) product. Our work is central to detecting malicious behavior and protecting customers from advanced identity-based attacks — including account takeover, identity spoofing, data leakage, and other high-impact threats.

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build and evolve our platform as it scales to meet expanding product requirements. This role blends hands-on backend systems development with growing ownership of features and production systems, including AI-powered and agentic components, working closely with senior engineers to improve system reliability, reduce latency, and accelerate feature release cycles.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and iterate on scalable backend and ML systems, APIs, frameworks, and internal tools.
  • Take ownership of well-scoped features and components, with guidance from senior engineers on more complex, cross-system work.
  • Contribute to the stability, reliability, and operational excellence of critical systems.
  • Write clean, testable, and resilient code with attention to edge cases and performance.
  • Contribute to technical design documents and participate in design discussions.
  • Participate in code and design reviews, and contribute to on-call rotations.

AI Engineering & Agents

  • Help design and build LLM-powered features and agentic workflows (e.g., automated investigation, triage, or remediation assistants) as part of the ATO platform.
  • Integrate LLM APIs and agent frameworks into backend services, with attention to reliability, cost, latency, and evaluation.
  • Contribute to prompt design, tool/function-calling integrations, and guardrails for AI-driven components under senior engineer guidance.
  • Use GenAI coding assistants and agents as part of your own development workflow to accelerate delivery and testing.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to align on specifications and priorities.
  • Break down well-defined projects into clear executable steps and drive them to completion.
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and share ideas for technical improvements.
  • Communicate effectively in an async-first environment, providing clarity on updates, challenges, and solutions.
  • Actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers to accelerate your growth.

What We're Looking For

  • Ownership & Growth: A proactive engineer who takes ownership of assigned work and is eager to grow into increasingly complex projects.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong focus on code quality, reliability, monitoring, and performance.
  • Solid Fundamentals: Good grounding in system design principles, with a growing ability to reason about scaling and reliability tradeoffs.
  • Strong Collaborator: Comfortable working cross-functionally and in a distributed environment.
  • AI & Agent Engineering Curiosity: Genuine interest in LLM-powered features and agentic systems, and proactive in leveraging modern developer productivity tools, including GenAI assistants and coding agents, to accelerate delivery.

Must-Have Skills

  • 3-5 years of industry experience as a Software Engineer, with a track record of shipping production backend systems.
  • Solid backend proficiency in Python, with experience building and maintaining production systems.
  • Experience with system design fundamentals and building reliable, scalable applications.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and modern data storage technologies.
  • Exposure to service-to-service communication (gRPC, Kafka) and caching (Redis) is a plus.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services (S3, RDS) and deployment practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) is a plus.
  • Understanding of service health, monitoring, and incident response practices.
  • Comfortable writing technical documentation and contributing to design discussions.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into production applications.
  • Exposure to agent frameworks or patterns (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, tool/function calling, ReAct-style agents).
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation, and observability for AI-driven features.

VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground. We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems.

About the Role



We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team supporting the OPSPREP service at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany.

The position involves supporting the software tools used within the OPSPREP service, particularly in the areas of database and procedure management.

We are open to both junior and senior Software Engineers. More important than a specific level of seniority is a solid technical foundation, the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks, and a genuine willingness to learn and work with a combination of established and modern technologies.

This is a great opportunity for a software engineer who wants to apply and further develop their technical skills within an operational space environment.

  • Supporting applications related to database and procedure management.
  • Developing and maintaining software using technologies such as Java, TypeScript, Python and SQL.
  • Analysing technical and operational requirements and translating them into effective software solutions.
  • Investigating software issues and supporting troubleshooting and resolution activities.
  • Contributing to the maintenance and improvement of existing applications and tools.

What We Look For



We are looking for candidates with a solid software engineering foundation. You do not need to tick every box, particularly when it comes to previous space-sector experience.

Technical Experience

Ideally, you will bring experience or practical knowledge in several of the following areas:

  • Software engineering and software development.
  • Java development.
  • TypeScript development.
  • Python development.
  • SQL and relational databases.
  • Database-related applications and data management.
  • Development, maintenance and troubleshooting of operational software.
  • Software testing and debugging.
  • Version control and collaborative software development environments.
  • Working with existing or legacy software while contributing to its continued evolution.


Hands-on experience across all four core technologies is not necessarily required, but candidates should have a strong software development foundation and the ability and willingness to quickly become familiar with technologies they have not previously used.

Space Domain Experience



Previous experience in the space sector is a plus, particularly in areas such as:

  • Satellite or spacecraft operations.
  • Operational ground segment software.
  • Mission operations preparation.
  • Procedure management systems.
  • Database management within an operational environment.
  • EUMETSAT or ESA projects, systems or tools.
  • Previous experience with EUMETSAT/OPSPREP-specific tools.


Previous space or EUMETSAT experience is desirable but not mandatory.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Relevant professional experience in a similar role is a plus.


Personal Skills



We're looking for someone who:

  • Is able to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Is a fast learner and comfortable becoming familiar with unfamiliar technologies and systems.
  • Is curious and willing to work with both new and established technologies and approaches.
  • Takes a structured and reliable approach to software development and troubleshooting.
  • Has good attention to detail.
  • Can communicate effectively with engineers, technical teams and operational stakeholders.
  • Works well as part of a multidisciplinary and international team.
  • Has English language proficiency at C1 level or above, both written and spoken.


Additional Requirements

  • Candidates must have the right to work in the European Union.
  • This is a full-time, on-site position at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany.
  • Candidates must therefore be willing and able to work regularly from the EUMETSAT premises.
  • Availability to start in January 2027 is required.
  • Application deadline: 13-11-2026


Ready to join us?



If you are passionate about software engineering and would like to apply your skills to real-world space operations, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether you are a junior engineer looking to grow within the space sector or an experienced software engineer looking for a new technical challenge, we encourage you to apply.

title: Solution Integrations Architect - Oracle
descriptionHtml:

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Oracle ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Oracle EBS and Fusion environments.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core Oracle EBS/Fusion business processes, schema layouts, and data models, specifically within Oracle Purchasing (PO), Payables (AP), and General Ledger (GL).
