  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

title: Staff Cryptography Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1919 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities:

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

  • Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS
  • Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills
  • Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.

What We Offer:

  • A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world
  • A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence
  • Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career
  • Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track
  • A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies
  • A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts
  • A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition

Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
descriptionHtml:

We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.

This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.

  • Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.

title: Staff Engineer - Search
descriptionHtml:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

As a Staff Engineer on the Search team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: making every employee able to find what they need, and get a trustworthy answer, across Staffbase and the tools around it. Today search spans people, posts, pages, files and connected integrations, and it increasingly feeds AI-generated answers. You'll define how retrieval, ranking and grounded answers work at that scale.

Your north star is a search platform that finds the right thing, fast, for the right person. It must respect permissions on every query, work in every language our customers use, and give answers that cite their sources. You'll build the core, set the quality bar, and decide where we use proven techniques and where we experiment, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.

This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver. You'll shape the direction of an open-ended problem, and you'll measure your work with real relevance data, not gut feeling.

Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Java, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, MongoDB, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, plus LLM and embedding services for retrieval, reranking and summarisation.

The Team

The Search team sits at the heart of how employees find information at Staffbase. We own the full path from query to result: indexing and embeddings, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, ranking and reranking, typeahead, and the AI summaries that answer questions with citations. Search is also a core source of knowledge for Navigator, our AI assistant, and the main way it grounds its answers in company content.

That means two big things. First, we make results relevant: understanding the query, retrieving the right candidates, ranking them well, and doing it in the user's language. Second, we make search safe and fast: every result respects the user's access rights, every tenant stays isolated, and the fast path stays fast. We don't ship relevance changes on a hunch. We run offline evaluations, golden query sets and online signals, and we change one thing at a time.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it

What you'll be doing

  • Define and drive the search and retrieval strategy: hybrid (BM25 + vector) retrieval, reranking, query understanding and rewriting, chunking and embedding choices
  • Build and evolve the core ingestion and query pipeline, from sync and indexing to ranked results and AI summaries with citations
  • Own search quality: build evaluation tooling and golden sets (including unanswerable and permission-varying queries), define relevance metrics, and turn them into decisions
  • Protect the non-negotiables at scale: permission-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, multilingual handling, and graceful degradation when a dependency is slow or down
  • Balance latency, quality and cost, for example what runs on the fast path versus what is allowed on the slow path
  • Make search observable: tracing, relevance dashboards, and a clear way to debug why a result did or did not appear
  • Lead technical strategy and architecture, and document key decisions so others can build on them
  • Take ownership of major technical decisions, proactively addressing bottlenecks and ensuring product quality
  • Work with Product and Design to turn user problems into measurable search improvements
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps with engineering leadership, and coordinate with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)
  • Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, design discussions and experiment reviews
  • Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)

What you need to be successful

  • Proven track record as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead with strong leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience building production search or retrieval systems (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr or similar), including relevance tuning, analyzers, and index design
  • Hands-on experience with modern retrieval: vector/kNN search, hybrid fusion (e.g. RRF), cross-encoder reranking, chunking and embeddings; ideally RAG or LLM-grounded answers
  • A measurement mindset: you've built or used relevance evaluation (recall, MRR, nDCG, golden sets, LLM-as-judge with human checks) and can tell a real improvement from noise
  • Strong understanding of multi-tenant architecture and permission-aware retrieval, with good judgment on security and isolation in search
  • Experience with latency-sensitive systems: budgets, timeouts, caching, fallbacks and degradation
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin/Java (or Go) on the backend; comfortable with React/TypeScript on the frontend
  • Knowledge of architecture and design patterns, and the judgment to make trade-offs and weigh their long-term impact
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain relevance and ranking trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with Product and Design leaders to deliver customer value in an Agile environment
  • Passion for building high-quality software
  • Passion for diversity and inclusion, and the ability to foster a culture where everyone's voice is heard

Nice to have

  • Multilingual search (analyzers, language detection, cross-language retrieval)
  • Query understanding: rewriting, expansion, typeahead and spell correction
  • Prompt-injection and data-poisoning awareness in RAG systems
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling

What you'll get 

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support-we offer offering a company pension scheme

title: Staff Product Engineer, AI
descriptionHtml:

What's the opportunity? 

We’re looking for Staff Product Engineers to join the AI Group to build Fin's AI-powered products. Product Engineers working in ML work closely with both our ML Scientists and product teams. They must deeply understand our product, our customers, our ML tech stack and our broader product stack. 

Our group is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.

We are an extremely product focussed team. We work in partnership with Product and Design functions of teams we support. Our team's dedicated Engineers enable us to move to production fast, often shipping to beta in weeks after a successful offline test.

We are very passionate about applying machine learning technology, and have productized everything from classic supervised models, to cutting-edge unsupervised clustering algorithms, to novel applications of transformer neural networks. We test and measure the real customer impact of each model we deploy.

If you are an experienced product engineer who takes an analytical approach to development and has some hands-on experience with ML systems, we'd love to hear from you! 

What will I be doing?

  • Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence within the group and across Fin.

Profile we’re looking for 

These are meant to be indicative, not hard requirements.

  • 10+ years of experience shipping high-quality products.

  • You can demonstrate significant impact in the work that you have done.
  • You take pride in having strong technical fundamentals; you love learning and are willing to work hard to invest in your development.
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Javascript etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here!
  • Strong willingness to fight for good outcomes
  • Bias towards progress over perfection

Bonus skills & attributes 

  • Previous experience in data analytics, or statistical role

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. title: Stage Bouw
descriptionHtml:
Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor!

Dit wordt jouw stage

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is!

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen.

Hier zit je goed!

Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie.

Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen.

Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie.


Dit breng je mee

  • Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde);

  • Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij!

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

Meer weten?

Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens.

Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

title: Stagiair commerciële binnendienst Team Zakelijk
descriptionHtml:
Best - Ben jij op zoek naar een leerzame stage waarin je klantcontact combineert met administratieve werkzaamheden? De Commerciële Binnendienst speelt een cruciale rol in het ondersteunen en versterken van zakelijke klantrelaties. Het team richt zich op het beheren van relaties met grootzakelijke klanten en intermediairs en op het realiseren van commerciële groei. Hierbij staan snelheid, klanttevredenheid, service en het ontzorgen van zakelijke klanten centraal. Het team ondersteunt zakelijke klanten bij hun abonnementen, zowel voor dagbladen als tijdschriften, en draagt daarmee bij aan de commerciële doelstellingen van de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?
Als stagiair Commerciële Binnendienst ben je een belangrijk onderdeel van het team en krijg je de kans om waardevolle ervaring op te doen. Onder begeleiding van ervaren collega’s werk je aan de volgende taken:

  • Beantwoorden van klantvragen, telefonisch en via e-mail, met betrekking tot zakelijke abonnementen.

  • Afhandelen van eenvoudige verzoeken, zoals wijzigingen in abonnementen en factuurvragen.

  • Invoeren van nieuwe abonnementen en verlengingen in het systeem.

  • Controleren en bijwerken van klantinformatie in de database.

  • Behandelen van opzeggingen en ondersteunen bij het opstellen van offertes.

  • Telefonisch contact opnemen met klanten, bijvoorbeeld voor de opvolging van offertes.

Door jouw inzet zorg je voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van klantverzoeken, wat bijdraagt aan klanttevredenheid en het behalen van de commerciële doelen van de afdeling.

Wat zoeken wij?
We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair die graag wil leren en een positieve bijdrage wil leveren aan ons team. Jij herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je volgt een relevante MBO- of HBO-opleiding, bij voorkeur in leerjaar 2 of 3.

  • Je bent minimaal 3 dagen per week beschikbaar. Aantal weken stage kan in overleg besproken worden.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk in de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je hebt een positieve en proactieve houding.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en ordelijk.

  • Je hebt een sterke service- en klantgerichte instelling.

  • Je beschikt over een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

  • Ervaring met administratieve processen, zoals het verwerken van klantgegevens, is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Marktconforme stagevergoeding en toegang tot onze online Academy.

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving waarin je veel kunt leren.

  • 1 op 1 begeleiding, zodat je écht leert van je stage.

Zo solliciteer je

Stuur ons via de button op de website een motivatiebrief met je cv, waarin je ons laat weten waarom deze stage perfect bij jou past.

title: Stagiair Strategy & Operations (meewerkstage)
descriptionHtml:
31-38.75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Ben je nieuwsgierig naar hoe bedrijven en organisaties in de Nederlandse industrie zijn georganiseerd? Wil je bijdragen aan de verbetering en vernieuwing van toonaangevende bedrijven? Wil je samen met een team consultants bijdragen aan complexe vraagstukken, het ontwikkelen van slimme inzichten en deze vertalen naar strategische oplossingen? Dan is deze stage bij Berenschot iets voor jou.

In deze meewerkstage help je mee aan het oplossen van strategische en operationele vraagstukken van klanten uit de industrie: je bekijkt hun grootste uitdagingen op het gebied van strategische positionering, product- en marktkeuzes,, procesoptimalisatie en digitalisering.

Dit ga je doen

Je gaat meewerken aan diverse opdrachten voor klanten uit de industrie en het bredere bedrijfsleven, zoals het ontwikkelen van een nieuwe strategie, het in beeld brengen van een markt of sector, het verbeteren van de operationele processen, het implementeren van technologische innovaties en het organiseren van transformaties voor groei en prestatieverbetering. Bij ‘industrie’ denken we onder meer aan de maakindustrie, defensie-industrie, voedselverwerkende industrie en hightechindustrie.

Je komt te werken in een platte organisatie die altijd openstaat voor nieuwe en innovatieve ideeën, waar je veel vrijheid krijgt om te leren én om mee te denken.

Voorbeelden van projecten waaraan jij meehelpt:

  • Begeleiding van strategische workshops om de strategie van de organisatie te herijken.

  • Doen van marktonderzoek voor een servicepartner in scheepsmotoren.

  • Verbeteren van de kwaliteit en doorlooptijd van het productieproces bij een fabrikant van auto-onderdelen door toepassing van Lean Six Sigma.

  • Optimaliseren van productieprocessen door gebruik van data van een producent van verzorgingsproducten.

  • Realiseren van bedrijfsbrede performanceverbetering en kostenbesparing bij een offshore-organisatie.

Daarnaast help je mee aan het schrijven van offertes en het maken van pitchdecks van nieuwe opdrachten en het verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Het is mogelijk om een stageonderzoek parallel te doen aan je periode bij Berenschot zolang er ook voldoende tijd beschikbaar blijft om te helpen met klantopdrachten en je daarin te ontwikkelen.

Quote

‘Bij Berenschot bepaal je vaak zelf wat je wilt leren en als stagiair werk je meteen mee aan echte projecten bij onze klanten.’ — Nick Fierloos, junior consultant (voormalig stagiair)

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je gaat werken in het team Strategy & Operations, onderdeel van de adviesgroep Transformatie van Organisaties. Het team bestaat uit zeventien slimme en enthousiaste adviseurs die werken in verschillende sectoren. Zij combineren hun kennis van de markt, strategie en operationele bedrijfsprocessen om scherpe analyses en adviezen te maken. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke collegiale band waarbij hard werken, teamwork, het beste uit jezelf en elkaar te halen, impact en plezier maken hand in hand gaan. Met slimme en gedreven Berenschotters om je heen werk je samen aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken iemand die:

  • ervaring heeft met Microsoft Office (PowerPoint en Excel)

  • gevoel heeft voor rapporteren en visuele presentatie van informatie

  • basiskennis heeft van strategie, organisatiestructuren en bedrijfsprocessen

  • passie heeft voor innovatie, leergierig is en goed kan samenwerken

  • proactief is en opdrachten zelfstandig oppakt

  • uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft

  • bij voorkeur 12 maanden beschikbaar is, maar minimaal 6 maanden bij ons komt.

Eerdere werkervaring is niet nodig, maar kan een pre zijn. Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en waar niet alleen economische winst, maar ook maatschappelijke winst een uitgangspunt is. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei.

Daarnaast bieden we:

  • een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis)

  • de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan trainingen in het stageplusprogramma

  • een laptop

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • begeleiding door twee adviseurs op het gebied van strategie en operations

  • een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng

  • de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven

  • mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Jelle van Pijkeren beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Neem contact op met Jelle via WhatsApp (06 82 39 55 98) of per e-mail ().

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

title: Steuerberater:in für eigene Fachkanzlei
descriptionHtml:
Steuerberatung radikal anders – jetzt mitgestalten

Du bist Steuerberater:in und willst nicht einfach nur eine weitere Kanzlei – sondern eine, die neue Wege geht?

Dann werde Teil von b’steuern, einer digitalen Steuerberatung mit Sitz in Berlin – und einem radikal anderen Selbstverständnis. Wir kombinieren steuerliche Exzellenz mit Automatisierung, unternehmerischer Klarheit und selbstorganisierten Teams.

Über uns

Wir denken Steuerberatung neu.

b’steuern steht für eine agile, digitale und selbstorganisierte Kanzlei.

Unser Anspruch: Steuerberatung, die nicht verwaltet – sondern gestaltet.

Nach vielen Jahren in der traditionellen Steuerberatung war für uns klar:

Es braucht einen strukturellen Neustart.

Deshalb sind wir eine der ersten Kanzleien in Deutschland, die als selbstgeführte Organisation aufgebaut ist – mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten, hoher Transparenz und echter Mitgestaltung.

Jetzt gehen wir einen Schritt weiter. Statt immer größer zu werden, bauen wir Fachkanzleien, also eigenständige Gesellschaften unter der Marke b'steuern, jede spezialisiert auf eine Branche und geführt von jemandem, der diese Branche wirklich kennt. Nicht als Franchise, nicht als Lizenz. Als gemeinsame Gesellschaft, an der du beteiligt bist. 🚀

Deine Rolle

  • Mandantenbetreuung: Du betreust Mandate in deiner Branche und wirst dort zur Instanz, nicht zum Generalisten

  • Steuererklärungen und Jahresabschlüsse: Erstelle und prüfe Einkommensteuer-, Umsatzsteuer- und Gewerbesteuererklärungen sowie Jahresabschlüsse.

  • Kommunikation mit Behörden: Führe die Korrespondenz mit Finanzbehörden und anderen Institutionen.

  • Gestaltung von Prozessen: Hilf dabei, innovative und effiziente Steuerberatungsprozesse zu entwickeln und zu optimieren. Du arbeitest mit unserem KI First Operating System und entscheidest mit, wie es weiterentwickelt wird

  • Strategische Mitarbeit: Arbeite eng mit dem Gründungsteam und unserem KI-Entwicklungsteam zusammen und unterstütze die Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens und unserer Tech-Landschaft.

  • Mentoring: Teile dein Wissen mit dem Team und unterstütze bei der Entwicklung von Best Practices.

  • Mandantengewinnung: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team bei den Erstgesprächen mit potentiellen VIP-Kunden.

  • Auftritt: Du bist Gesicht nach außen: Gespräche mit Mandanten, Sichtbarkeit in deiner Branche, später der Aufbau deines eigenen Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation: Bestellung als Steuerberater:in und mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung

  • Fachkompetenz und Fokus: Umfangreiche Kenntnisse im deutschen Steuerrecht und ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Zusätzlich muss es einen Fachbereich geben in dem du dich besser auskennst als alle anderen und den du weiter perfektionieren möchtest.

  • Unternehmerische Haltung: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, unternehmerisch gestalten und Führen.

  • Kommunikation: Freude an der Arbeit mit Mandanten und der Fähigkeit, komplexe steuerliche Themen verständlich zu erklären.

  • Technologie-Affinität: Erfahrung im Umgang mit bestehenden Tools wie DATEV, Lexware, Buchhaltungsbutler ist Standard. Wir gehen einen Schritt weiter und bauen eigene Lösungen.

Was wir bieten

title: Strategic Client Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients have the most vehicles, the most data and the most to gain from our connected proposition. As our Strategic Client Manager, you’ll be the main face of Flock for them, from multinationals and well-known brands to fast-growing sector leaders, and you’ll own those relationships end to end.

Nearly all our business comes through brokers, so you’ll sit at the centre of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business. You’ll build our corporate client management approach from scratch, from account reviews and performance reporting to bringing claims, safety, underwriting and finance together for our biggest clients. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts and improve reporting. Success means our clients stay with us and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every large corporate client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • Energy and ownership. You’re comfortable picking up a problem, finding the right people and driving it through to a solution.

  • Confident using technology in your daily work, curious about how it can help you work faster and deliver a better client experience.

Nice to have: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to claims or to building a client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

At The Better Cat, we are reinventing the pet food market. 🐾 We are a VC-backed startup (backed by FoodLabs, among others) that has become the fastest growing cat food company in Germany and won the Fressnapf Innovation Award in 2024. We sell D2C, on Amazon and increasingly in retail.

This is our first dedicated finance hire, reporting directly to our co-founder Niklas. The role is a real mix: part finance business partner, giving the founding team accurate and timely numbers to decide on, and part hands-on operational finance, building the close and working with our external accountant and tax advisor. We are AI-first and automate wherever we can, so you will have the freedom (and the expectation) to build finance processes the modern way.

Tasks

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own forecasting, budgeting and performance analysis.

  • Analyse revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, costs and working capital.

  • Support pricing, promotion, product mix, channel and product portfolio decisions.

Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Be the primary finance contact for our Growth & Marketing and Supply Chain teams.

  • Translate financial and operational KPIs into clear insights and actions.

  • Challenge assumptions, connect operational decisions to P&L and cash-flow outcomes, and find opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

Supply Chain & Working Capital

  • Partner on inventory, procurement, fulfilment, logistics and working capital decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve costs, cash flow and operational efficiency.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Cases

  • Build business cases and quantify the financial impact of major initiatives, such as new brand, channel or country launches, and connect them to financial operations.

  • Support the rollout of controlling processes across the organisation.

Accounting

  • Build the monthly and annual close processes from scratch.

  • Work with our external tax advisor and accountants to ensure robust VAT treatment across countries and channels.

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • 2-4 years of experience in Consulting, Investment Banking, FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Commercial Finance or Strategic Finance.

  • Experience in e-commerce, consumer products, retail, distribution or another physical-product business.

  • At least a bachelor's degree in a relevant subject such as Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business. A professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA) in progress or newly completed is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run workstreams independently and deliver high-quality output with minimal supervision.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience with accounting software (e.g. DATEV, Lexware) and AI and automation tools (Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, Zapier) is a plus. Above all, you are curious about AI and want to use it to work smarter.

  • Comfortable working with large datasets and turning analysis into clear, concise business insights.

  • Solid understanding of financial statements, management accounting principles and business performance metrics.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial mindset and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Proactive and self-motivated, with an entrepreneurial mindset and comfort in a fast-paced, scaling company.

Benefits

  • 🦁 An inspiring team: Ambitious, fun, down-to-earth and authentic. Come and meet us!

  • 🏗️ Build it your way: As our first finance hire, you shape the finance function, its processes and its tools from day one.

  • 📈 Direct access to the founders: You work daily with Niklas and the founding team and help make decisions instead of just reporting on them.

  • 🤖 AI-first environment: We automate wherever it makes sense and give you room to experiment with the latest tools.

  • 🐱 Great products: It is more fun to stand behind something that truly works. Read our reviews or ask us for a sample!

  • 💝 Cool benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, MacBook, Wellpass, merch, office snacks and drinks.

  • ⭐ Great workplace: Modern office in Hamburg's HafenCity, hybrid setup, flexible working hours and fast personal growth.

🐾 Ready to build the finance engine of a scaling consumer brand and make the world a better place for cats?

Then get in touch! 📩 Send us your CV and a short cover letter and tell us why you are the right person for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded Strategy Analyst to help us grow and scale the product exponentially. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics.

You’ll help us solve our most complex multi-dimensional challenges, working cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.

  

Key Responsibilities

Drive pricing & promotions optimisation:

  • Support the development and optimisation of pricing and promotional strategies across our channels and products through data-driven analysis, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability, while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling

  • Analyse performance at channel, product and customer segment level to identify opportunities to improve pricing, product and conversion efficiency

  • Build insight into conversion funnel performance and highlight where cost or conversion can be improved

  • Stay abreast of industry trends and market activity to ensure our products remain competitive and fit for purpose

Pricing experimentation & impact assessment:

  • Design, set up and run pricing tests and product A/B and multivariate experiments, working with Product, Data Science and Engineering to ensure they are implemented correctly

  • Track experiment performance against pre-agreed success metrics and guardrails, and deliver clear readouts with recommendations on whether to roll out, iterate or stop

  • Measure the realised impact of commercial initiatives after launch, and compare outcomes against the original business case

  • Build and maintain monitoring of key commercial metrics so the team can track the impact of changes over time

  • Build a growing evidence base on price elasticity from these tests to inform future pricing decisions

  • Validate that implemented pricing and strategy changes are working as intended once deployed in production, flagging and investigating any unexpected behaviour.

Evaluate expansion opportunities:

  • Support the evaluation of new product, channel and segment opportunities by extracting and analysing data and contributing to commercial models

  • Help maintain assessment frameworks and tooling so that evaluations are consistent and repeatable

Collaboration & communication:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life.

  • Present analysis and recommendations clearly and concisely, backed by data, to the team and wider stakeholders.

  • Document analyses, queries and experiment results so they are reusable by the wider team.

Your experience

Essential:

  • 1+ years of experience in an analytical role (e.g. Product Analytics, Growth, Pricing).

    • Can be a placement year within a University Course.

  • Proficiency in SQL; working knowledge of Python.

  • Hands-on exposure to A/B and multivariate testing.

  • A structured approach to problem solving and strong attention to detail

  • Comfort working through ambiguity and working on problems and projects end to end with support.

Desirable:

  • Experience in an FCA-regulated financial services firm.

  • Exposure to pricing or conversion funnel analysis.

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Consumer
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

The Consumer Core team at Deliveroo owns the in-app experience and how consumers explore our product. Our mission is to help consumers build confidence in ordering and discover "the best in their neighborhood." Our team identifies emerging customer needs, shapes long-term strategy for the consumer food discovery journey, and ensures that new features deliver measurable impact. Ultimately, we advocate for the consumer at every step, championing experiences that make Deliveroo feel local, relevant, and delightful.

About the Role

In this role, you will establish and lead the operating rhythm of the EMEA Consumer organization across Deliveroo and Wolt—shaping how we manage weekly business performance, plan for the quarters and years ahead, and deploy investment to deliver ambitious, profitable growth.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Finance, Marketing, and Operations to lead quarterly and annual planning, weekly business reviews, and investment proposal approvals. You will manage in-quarter budgets, track performance against our outlook, and recommend where to increase investment or pull back to achieve our growth and profitability goals.

You will also take ownership of high-priority, cross-functional projects where there is no obvious owner—from growth sprints to new partner launches. You'll be accountable from initial diagnosis and recommendation through implementation and results, getting into the detail while keeping the broader business objectives in view. Ultimately, your work will help the Consumer organization make better decisions, execute more effectively, and put investment behind the opportunities with the greatest impact.

You will report into the Director of Consumer Strategy and Behavior, within the broader consumer organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Strategize – Shape our team's strategy and help decide "what we should do next"
  • Build – Design and launch new initiatives from the ground up
  • Analyze – Analyze experiment results to inform business decisions and future experiments
  • Influence – Partner with other teams - Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics - to drive cross-functional and go-to-market execution

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strategic & Analytical Depth: Significant experience in product, consulting, investment banking, or technology environments with a proven ability to build insight-driven models and solve complex problems.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Strong understanding of how to build trust and drive alignment across diverse senior Commercial and Technology leaders.
  • Complex Project Management: Proven ability to manage large-scale projects from scoping to execution, maintaining momentum across multiple functions and markets.
  • Entrepreneurial Drive: A bias for action and a comfort with ambiguity, with the proactivity to build and iterate where playbooks are still being defined.
  • Structured Communication: Ability to drive clarity through structured, confident communication, translating data into compelling narratives for both upwards and downwards influence.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day – Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment – Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role – Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture – Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


    • Your Profile

  • 5 years experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

  • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

  • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

  • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich. Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

title: Talent Partner - Generalist
descriptionHtml:
About us
Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place.
We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution.
Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures.

Why join us:

title: Team Lead - Internal Solution Consulting
descriptionHtml:

Le ou la Team Lead Solution Consulting est responsable de l’organisation, de la performance et du développement de l’équipe de Solution Consultants.

L’équipe intervient auprès des clients Pennylane sur la dimension fonctionnelle de projets en cours : analyse des besoins, cadrage, mise en œuvre, formation et adoption du produit.

Par son management, sa coordination et son pilotage de la capacité, le ou la Team Lead veille à ce que les clients bénéficient d’un accompagnement de qualité, au bon moment et avec le niveau d’expertise attendu.

Missions principales

  • Manager et développer l’équipe Solution Consulting : définir les objectifs individuels et collectifs, organiser les rituels de management, accompagner la montée en compétences, donner du feedback et suivre la performance. Veiller à l’engagement, à la motivation et à la dynamique collective.

  • Organiser et optimiser le staffing de l’équipe : consolider les besoins liés aux projets en cours, anticiper la charge, répartir les missions en fonction des compétences et des disponibilités, et s’assurer que les ressources sont mobilisées au bon moment et sur les bons sujets.

title: Tech Lead (mobile apps)
descriptionHtml:
Why Coda Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.


The opportunity

You'll join the Recharge team in Amsterdam, part of a global e-commerce platform that makes digital payments simple, fast, and accessible worldwide. From gift cards and gaming vouchers to prepaid payment cards and mobile top-ups, Recharge connects millions of consumers with digital products from leading brands such as Apple, Google, Vodafone, PlayStation, and PaysafeCard.

At Coda, Tech Leads play a pivotal role in shaping both our technology and our teams. Beyond technical expertise, they inspire and develop engineers, foster a culture of trust and collaboration, and take ownership of key technical decisions. With the autonomy to drive meaningful change, our leaders balance innovation, execution, and long-term scalability.

We're looking for a Tech Lead who is equally passionate about people and technology. You'll lead a talented engineering team, shape the technical direction of our platforms, and drive the delivery of scalable, high-quality solutions. Along the way, you'll empower engineers to grow, champion engineering best practices, and help build a collaborative, high-performing team that makes a real impact.


What you'll do
  • Lead the mobile fullstack engineering team, ensuring the successful delivery of product and technical initiatives while striking the right balance between execution speed, engineering quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Recruit, develop, and mentor engineers, fostering a high-performing team and supporting their career growth
  • Take ownership of one or more key systems at Coda, driving their technical direction and shaping an ambitious roadmap with your team
  • Guide the team with prioritazation, resolving complex technical challenges, and adopting best practices
  • Oversee project timelines and deliverables. Ensure resources are allocated efficiently and projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards
  • Collaborate with Product and cross-functional teams to align on goals, define priorities, drive execution from OKRs to day-to-day delivery, and communicate progress, risks, and technical direction
  • Oversee the utilisation of modern platforms and technologies, ensuring they are leveraged effectively to maximise the value the engineering teams deliver.
    • Our Tech Stack: AWS, Next.js, React Native, NestJS, GraphQL, Typescript, Gitlab, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DBT, Playwright, Postman, Jest, etc.

title: Technical Account Manager - Data.One
descriptionHtml:
Technical Account Manager - Data.One

This Technical Account Manager (TAM) role is part of the DataOne business within the ClearScore Group. The TAM demonstrates a balance of deep technical understanding and ability along with outstanding customer service and account management skills. This individual would have responsibility over the full partner lifecycle from onboarding, launch and ongoing maintenance.

The TAM role will work closely with the rest of the DataOne business which includes Product, Engineers, Analytics and Commercial counterparts in order to deliver the best experience to our partners.

The TAM’s main focusses will be setting up new Partners to start using DataOne open banking data, being on hand to assist partners with changes, and help drive the performance of their open banking usage.

What you will be doing:

Relationship Management

  • The main point of contact for our partner relationships after contracts are signed; working closely with our Commercial team to understand needs and goals of Partners.
  • Understand the Partners business objective and be able to be proactive in our approach to establish and maintain excellent partner relationships.
  • Attend and support our Commercial team in partner calls
  • Assist in researching trends and insights around delivering best in class partner relationships.

Integration SME

  • Onboard partners through the integration process, you will be the SME for each individual integration that they own and represent the voice of partners.
  • Ensure that partners stay within the defined strategy of the DataOne team. When a partner is identified for bespoke integration, work with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, and other identified teams to work through solutions for implementing the bespoke work.
  • Take a data-driven approach to provide key partner insights about the integrations, and use these insights to improve our integration experience.
  • Coordinate and manage Partner onboarding plans with our Commercial and Engineering teams.

Performance Management

  • Manage all partner requests related to their usage of DataOne’s open banking services. Not only will you manage and process these changes, but you’ll also recommend improvements to ensure high Partner performance.
  • Develop a working knowledge of the ClearScore marketplace landscape and share that knowledge with the wider DataOne team
  • Create custom reports for Partners as and when requested.

Delivery Management

  • Liaise with DataOne engineers to manage backlog of requests.
  • Develop and document processes and procedures to drive efficiencies
  • Collaborate with the DataOne teams to improve functionality to drive down BAU work and drive productivity of our Engineering teams.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a background in Technical Product Ownership, Engineering, or another technical role with direct relationships with clients or partners.

Skills we'd love you to have:

  • A natural planner - ability to coordinate and lead internal and external teams to deliver strong integration performance
  • Highly analytical and data driven - excited by and proficient at using data to make informed decisons
  • Confident working alongside and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Strong writing, communication and presentation skills
  • Organised, proactive, and great attention to detail
  • Positive attitude, able to work under pressure and within a moving framework

Why ClearScore?

ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. Someone joins ClearScore every 20 seconds.

We have established relationships with over 50 of the main lenders in the U.K., and have been a trusted tool for customers to manage their credit and make better financial decisions.

Since October 2016 we have helped 1.8 million users take out a new credit card or loan. We are user-centric at our core and we believe in leveraging technology to enable positive financial choices. We are design-led and data-driven and we embed these behaviours in everything we do.

What is D·One?

D·One was created in 2022 as a result of ClearScore’s acquisition of Money Dashboard - a company with best in class open banking and categorisation capabilities. The D·One mission exists to provide open banking data to lending partners, market researchers including hedge funds and ClearScore. Currently, our primary goal is enabling lenders to adopt open banking by delivering a lender specific open banking service with best-in-class credit analytics.

As part of the ClearScore Group, you will join a company where our culture is a fundamental part of all we have achieved. We believe in hiring smart, driven, passionate and diverse people who are keen on having a real impact in our organisation. We trust you to manage your own time so we offer flexible work and no fixed desk hours. We don't micromanage and we believe in measuring outcomes rather than effort. We have an inclusive culture where all, regardless of seniority, are encouraged to contribute with their ideas, look after their wellbeing and actively seek opportunities for career growth.

Equal Opportunities

ClearScore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. As an equal opportunity employer, we are able to make reasonable adjustments to accommodate individuals with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please inform us in advance, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

  • Level 6 and above: Minimum 3 days per week in-office
We believe this structure offers the best of both worlds - the flexibility of remote work and the synergy of face-to-face collaboration. Our office days are carefully coordinated to maximise team interactions and learning/ mentorship opportunities.
What This Means for You:
  • Flexibility to manage your work and life
  • Dedicated in-office days for team building and collaborative projects
