We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment that accommodates diverse needs while maintaining our collaborative culture. Join us in shaping the future of work!
Note: While we offer flexibility, commitment to our hybrid schedule is an important aspect of our team culture and performance expectations.

Inclusion Policy

We are always looking for talented individuals to join ClearScore. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our people. Please see our People Policy Notice at https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice.

title: Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (EMS, PPC & SCADA) at NeuVerge-Tron GmbH, you will serve as the technical lead and solution architect during pre-sales and tender phases for utility-scale renewable energy and energy storage power plants.

In this position, your core product portfolio comprises Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), and SCADA platforms. You will analyze customer requirements, regional Grid Codes, and Transmission/Distribution System Operator (TSO/DSO) mandates, translating them into resilient, high-availability, and cybersecure system architectures.

(Note: This role focuses on control software, industrial automation, and OT system architecture; it does not cover battery cell sizing, containerized mechanical design, or civil EPC scope.)

 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Pre-sales & Bid Management

  • Analyze customer technical specifications, RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs for utility-scale solar, wind, and hybrid BESS assets.

  • Author technical proposals, functional architecture diagrams, and Statements of Work (SOW) for EMS/SCADA solutions.

  • Compile compliance matrices and deviation lists addressing customer specifications and utility regulations.

  • Define the Bill of Materials (BOM), covering server hardware, industrial controllers, networking equipment, software licenses, and engineering services.

  • Lead technical deep-dive workshops, solution demonstrations, and clarification sessions with customers, EPC contractors, and grid operators.

Grid Code Compliance & Functional Control Design

  • Evaluate regional Grid Code regulations across target European markets (e.g., VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, ENTSO-E standards) and translate them into EMS/PPC control requirements

  • Architect plant-level control logic, including Active Power Control, Reactive Power/Power Factor Regulation, POI/PCC Voltage Support, Frequency Response, and Ramp Rate restrictions.

  • Define EMS-level operational strategies, such as automated dispatch tracking, State of Charge (SoC) management constraints, energy arbitrage scheduling, ancillary service controls, and fail-safe/black-start logics.

System Integration & Communication Architecture

  • Design overall system architectures connecting EMS, PPC, SCADA, Historian, and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI).

  • Define interface specifications for external subsystems: Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), MV switchgear, digital protection relays, power meters, and TSO/DSO dispatch centers.

  • Develop and maintain interface control documents (ICD), data point lists, and signal mapping registers.

  • Implement and validate standard industrial protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850 (MMS/GOOSE), DNP3, and OPC UA.

  • Architect high-availability schemes, redundancy topologies, automated failover mechanisms, time synchronization (NTP/PTP), and disaster recovery plans.

OT Networking & Cybersecurity Architecture

  • Design Operational Technology (OT) network topologies, VLAN segmentations, IP addressing schemes, and DMZ firewall policies.

  • Formulate secure remote maintenance topologies, jump host concepts, VPN tunnels, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) mechanisms.

  • Ensure EMS solution adherence to cybersecurity standards, including IEC 62443 and IEC 62351 frameworks.

  • Collaborate with customer IT/OT security teams and external auditors during security reviews and threat modeling assessments.

Verification & Handover

  • Define verification scopes and technical criteria for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and grid compliance commissioning.

  • Support engineering, commissioning, and project management teams during post-award handover to ensure seamless project delivery.

 

Scope Boundaries

  • To preserve focus on control systems and software integration, this position explicitly excludes:

  • Battery cell/module selection, chemistry evaluation, and electrochemical degradation modeling.

  • Mechanical layout, thermal HVAC design, or fire suppression engineering of BESS containers.

  • Primary high/medium voltage electrical hardware engineering (transformers, switchgear internals, or EPC civil infrastructure).

 

Qualifications & Profile

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Professional Experience:

  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in technical presales, solution architecture, or systems engineering focusing on EMS, PPC, or SCADA in power generation or grid utilities.

  • Practical familiarity with grid integration procedures and technical dialogue with European grid operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Technical & Protocol Competencies:

  • Solid understanding of power utility communication standards: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, and OPC UA.

  • Hands-on experience with industrial automation platforms (PLCs/RTUs), real-time historians, and SCADA packages.

  • Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity best practices (IEC 62443 / IEC 62351).

Key Competencies:

  • Strong analytical capability to dissect technical tender documents into structured requirements.

  • Confident presentation skills in customer-facing technical exchanges and contract negotiations.

Language Skills:

  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is required.

  • German language or any other third EU or Chinese proficiency are strongly preferred.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Territory Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large Enterprise companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near a major German city with convenient transport links, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

title: Unit Lead (m/w/d) Digitale Produkte & Services
descriptionHtml:
Digital. Made Human.

SHAPE ist eine Digitalagentur mit Hauptsitz in Hamburg. Design, Technologie und Security kommen hier aus einer Hand: von der Produkt- und Serviceentwicklung über sichere Architekturen für regulierte Branchen bis zu Creative Technology. Seit 2012 hat SHAPE in der DACH-Region mehr als 750 digitale Projekte entlang der gesamten Customer Experience umgesetzt. Rund 140 Spezialist:innen arbeiten an sechs Standorten in Deutschland, der Schweiz und Kroatien. SHAPE ist nach ISO 27001 und ISO 9001 zertifiziert und Teil der internationalen MYTY Group.

Als Unit Lead verantwortest du die Projekte deiner Unit – von Scope und Budget bis zu Zeitplan und Qualität. Deine Unit kann dabei für einen oder mehrere Kundinnen arbeiten. Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für eure Kund*innen, planst die Kapazitäten im Team und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte wirtschaftlich und in hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Fach Leads zusammen. Sie verantworten fachliche Standards und die Entwicklung der Kolleg*innen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Team und Projekte im Alltag rund laufen.

Wo du arbeitest

Optimal wäre es, wenn du in Berlin, Hamburg, Braunschweig, Husum oder Umgebung lebst. So können wir uns bei Workshops, Kundenterminen oder im Büro auch persönlich begegnen. Dein Wohnort ist dafür aber keine Voraussetzung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst deine Unit im Projektalltag und bist für die Menschen darin erste Ansprechperson in Planungsfragen, vom Projekteinsatz bis zum Urlaub.

  • Du planst die Kapazitäten deiner Unit und besetzt Projekte gemeinsam mit den Fach Leads so, dass Fachlichkeit und Team-Stabilität zusammenpassen.

  • Du verantwortest Scope, Budget und Zeit deiner Projekte und die Qualität des Ergebnisses.

  • Du steuerst Anforderungen, Risiken und Scope, übernimmst dabei Product-Owner-Verantwortung und triffst Produktentscheidungen gemeinsam mit Team und Kund*innen.

  • Du erkennst Hindernisse früh und räumst sie aus dem Weg, damit dein Team konzentriert arbeiten kann.

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für die Kund*innen deiner Unit, pflegst langfristige Beziehungen und präsentierst Ergebnisse auch vor Entscheider*innen.

  • Du gibst deinem Team regelmäßig operatives Feedback und bringst deine Sicht in die Entwicklungsgespräche ein.

  • Gemeinsam mit unserem COO verantwortest du die Wirtschaftlichkeit deiner Unit, von Angebot und Budgetplanung bis zu Controlling und Abrechnung.

  • Du sprichst Konflikte früh an und verhandelst Scope, Budget und Termine so, dass die Lösung für beide Seiten passt..

  • Du machst Projekterfolge sichtbar, zum Beispiel in Case Studies, Business-Präsentationen oder in internen Formaten.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools, um Abläufe in deiner Unit effizienter zu machen, und gestaltest gemeinsam mit den anderen Unit Leads mit, wie SHAPE arbeitet.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement digitaler Produkte oder Softwareprojekte, idealerweise 5 Jahre und mehr, gern in einer Digitalagentur.

  • Erfahrung darin, cross-funktionale Teams im Projektalltag zu führen, etwa als Senior PM, Delivery Lead oder Teamlead.

  • Ein Talent für Organisation: Du planst sauber, behältst viele Themen gleichzeitig im Blick und merkst früh, wann ein Plan angepasst werden muss.

  • Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer Rolle, in der du Anforderungen priorisiert und Produktentscheidungen getroffen hast.

  • Klare Kommunikation, mit deinem Team genauso wie mit Entscheider*innen auf Kundenseite.

  • Betriebswirtschaftliches Denken und Erfahrung mit Projektkalkulation, Budgets und Controlling.

  • Ein Gespür für Kund*innen und ihre Ziele, auch wenn diese noch nicht ganz klar formuliert sind.

  • Sicherheit in Verhandlungen und die Ruhe, schwierige Gespräche konstruktiv zu führen.

  • Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise. Du bleibst gelassen, wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig Aufmerksamkeit brauchen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kund*innen, dazu gutes Englisch.

Was nicht perfekt sein muss

Du musst kein Scrum-Coach sein und keinen Code schreiben. Für Methoden, Standards und Architektur gibt es bei uns Fach Leads. Technisches Verständnis wächst im Alltag, mit erfahrenen Entwickler*innen und Designer*innen an deiner Seite. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Teams führen und Projekte zusammenhalten kannst.

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit klarer Verantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Fach Leads an deiner Seite.

  • Regelmäßiger Austausch mit den anderen Unit Leads, zum Beispiel bei gemeinsamen Offsites.

  • Remote Work und flexible Arbeitszeiten, dazu Ausstattung fürs Homeoffice.

  • Projekte für namhafte Kund*innen, die du über längere Zeit begleitest und mitgestaltest.

  • Weiterbildung und Mentoring, auch für deine Entwicklung als Führungskraft.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sportmitgliedschaft sowie Gutscheine und Rabatte.

  • Ein Team, das offen diskutiert, Konventionen hinterfragt und Entscheidungen gemeinsam in Workshops und Sprints trifft.

  • Haustiere sind im Büro willkommen.


Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Erzähl uns lieber in ein paar Sätzen, wie du führst und warum du Lust auf SHAPE hast.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung.

title: UX/UI Designer M/W/X
descriptionHtml:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.

Veepee is looking for a UX/UI Designer for its Growth Marketing team. Attached to the Lead of UX/UI, the person in this position will be responsible for executing the UX vision for the Veepee front experience. You will ensure the optimization of the customer journey across all Veepee sites by analyzing the performance of each step in the user path.

🎯 TASKS

UX/UI Vision and Strategy

  • Deliver the UX/UI front vision for all Veepee sites and apps in collaboration with marketing, business, and Tech teams.

  • Ensure a flawless and coherent user experience across all devices.

  • Contribute to the performance improvement of Veepee platforms by monitoring defined KPIs and business value.

  • Propose best practices and innovative solutions to address e-commerce challenges, specifically the flash sales model.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of the group Design System.

Collaboration Business - Tech

  • Work closely with Business and Product Tech teams to design UX/UI solutions that balance business expectations with technical complexity.

  • Maintain the quality of business requests and technical deliveries to ensure high-performing evolutions.

  • Support the definition of Tech Roadmaps and the prioritization of projects through design validation and delivery.

Team Contribution

  • Participate actively in team rituals and collaborative planning to ensure a performing organization.

  • Maintain high-quality deliveries and stay updated with the latest UX/UI trends and innovations.

👉 MUST HAVE skills

  • At least 3 years of experience as a UX/UI Designer, with a main focus on e-commerce environments.

  • Proactive, organized, and autonomous in moving projects forward.

  • Strong understanding of the e-commerce universe, particularly platforms with high daily traffic volumes.

  • Results-oriented with a capacity to identify and improve process weaknesses.

  • Comfortable working with a wide range of departments, including IT, Data Science, Legal, and Finance.

  • Fluent level of English is a must.

  • International experience is a plus.

❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ?

  • The Marketing Growth team is dedicated to acquiring new customers, retaining existing customers and improving the user experience on all channels

We are convinced that it is up to you to define the way you work, to develop yourself and to progress. At Veepee we guarantee that you can just be yourself! The Veepee Group processes your data collected as part of the management of your recruitment in order to manage your application file for the position for which you have applied. To find out more about our , we invite you to consult it on our career site. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: VP Data Centres
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have:
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: VP of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

About Us

ClearBank is a technology‑enabled, fully regulated bank providing cloud‑based banking and payments infrastructure to financial institutions. We operate at scale in a highly regulated environment, where trust, resilience and security are critical.

Our engineering organisation is focused on enabling frequent, reliable change while maintaining strong controls. We believe quality is not a gate at the end of delivery, but something designed in from the very start.

Role Purpose

This is a senior leadership role accountable for the strategy, design, build, operation and ongoing resilience of ClearBank’s payments and cards platforms.

The VP of Payments & Cards will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for real-time, scheme-connected payments and cards systems across the UK, Europe, and future international markets. This requires deep experience working close to the infrastructure that moves money. Ideally, this will include direct integration with major payment schemes or rails, such as FPS, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK, SEPA payment schemes in Europe, or ACH and Fedwire in the US. We will also consider experience gained through payment infrastructure providers or connectivity platforms provided it includes sufficient technical depth in payment processing, scheme connectivity and the operation of highly available, regulated payments infrastructure. The role will define platform strategy, engineering standards, tooling and ways of working, while embedding a shift-left quality mindset across delivery. Success means delivering highly resilient, highly available, secure, scalable and compliant platforms that enable frequent, reliable change in a regulated banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, design, build and run of real-time payments and cards platforms across the UK, Europe, the US and future international markets, including direct scheme connectivity and integrations with third-party payment infrastructure providers.

  • Lead the delivery and operation of digital wallet capabilities, including Apple Pay and Google Pay implementations.

  • Set the technical direction for payments and cards platforms, ensuring architectural choices support resilience, availability, scalability, performance, security and cost efficiency.

  • Own the budget for the Payments and Cards engineering teams, ensuring effective investment in people, tooling and platforms.

  • Build, lead and develop high-performing engineering teams, creating clear accountability, strong delivery discipline and a culture of engineering excellence.

  • Ensure platforms are designed and operated to meet the following outcomes:

  • Highly resilient — supporting local and cross-region disaster recovery requirements.

  • Highly available — targeting 99.999% aggregate internal availability where appropriate.

  • Highly scalable — supporting aggressive growth targets and future business volumes.

  • Performant — meeting scheme performance requirements and exceeding client expectations on latency.

  • Cost optimised — balancing client value, operational efficiency and ClearBank’s cost base.

  • Establish scalable engineering quality standards, practices and governance across the payments and cards domain.

  • Embed quality, observability, operational readiness and control requirements into delivery practices and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive engineering productivity through AI-assisted and increasingly agentic software engineering, including the effective use of AI coding tools and multi-agent approaches across development, testing and engineering workflows, with appropriate risk, security and regulatory guardrails.

  • Partner closely with the CTO, engineering leaders, product, risk, compliance and operations teams to ensure delivery decisions balance pace, quality and control.

  • Ensure software development and platform operations meet regulatory, audit, resilience and compliance expectations.

Skills & Experience

  • Senior engineering leadership experience in payments, cards or highly regulated financial technology environments.

  • Proven experience establishing, scaling and operating engineering teams, standards and practices.

  • Direct experience integrating with, building against or operating connectivity to payment schemes or rails. Relevant examples include Faster Payments, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK; SEPA payment schemes and associated euro payment infrastructure in Europe; ACH or Fedwire in the US; or card networks and associated issuing or acquiring infrastructure. Alternatively, substantial experience delivering payment connectivity through a provider such as Form3 or an equivalent platform, with demonstrable technical depth in how payments are processed, routed and operated.

  • Experience delivering or operating digital wallet capabilities, such as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

  • Strong understanding of real-time, high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Strong background working in regulated environments, with practical experience of audit, compliance, operational resilience and control frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of shift-left quality, test automation, modern quality engineering and secure software development practices.

  • Experience using modern AI-enabled engineering tooling and a strong understanding of how agentic or multi-agent approaches can improve software development, testing and engineering delivery in a controlled and responsible way.

  • Strong security mindset, with an appreciation of evolving threats, mitigations and secure platform design.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence across multiple teams and senior stakeholders, including where direct line management is not present.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, risk, compliance and executive stakeholders.

  • Sound judgement in balancing delivery pace, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations, operational risk and engineering quality.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable.

title: Warehouse Associate (Part time)
descriptionHtml:
Warehouse Associate

Location: Canning Town (E16)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Canning Town team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

  • Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

  • Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

  • Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

  • A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

  • Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

Our Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

Uns ist nicht entscheidend, ob du bereits jahrelange Berufserfahrung hast. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du vor der Kamera authentisch wirkst, kreativ bist und Social Media wirklich verstehst.

title: Working Student B2G: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
01 · Why this role exists

This is not your typical student job.

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you help win it. You'll work directly with our B2G Manager and the founders on funding that flows straight into RIZM's cash flow, and you'll see from the inside how the public sector decides and buys. Something most students never get to see.

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one.

02 · What you'll do

  • Public funding as a growth channel: Help build the pipeline for Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: scout new calls, prepare applications and keep track of our running programmes.

  • Connect research: Support our research collaboration with Stanford and help turn it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first: Set up trackers, automations and AI workflows so our funding pipeline runs with as little manual work as possible. Your ideas count here.

  • Support ReNET-EV: Help with our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region): documentation, reporting and the rollout to more municipalities.

  • Get to know municipalities: Research how cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies decide and buy, as groundwork for our first public-sector customers.

  • Build the data foundation: Collect public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

03 · What you bring

  • Studies: You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme, e.g. public administration, political science, economics, business, energy, engineering or something similar.

  • Curiosity: The energy transition, municipal heat planning or how public funding works interest you. No prior experience needed.

  • Writing: You write clearly and in a structured way.

  • AI-native: You're curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility.

  • Languages: Fluent German and good English.

04 · Why you should apply now

B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start.

  • Small team: You'll work actively and day to day with our full-time B2G Manager, not on the sidelines.

  • Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch.

  • Founders: You work directly with them.

  • Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making.

  • Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Flexible hours: They fit around your studies.

05 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest sentences on these two questions.

  1. A mayor gives you 2 minutes. Which energy problem in their city would you tell them RIZM can help with?

  2. Research funding sounds dusty to most students, but we think it's not :) How would you convince your friends it's actually cool, in the language you'd really use with them?

After that:

As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join our team at the intersection of international trade, export control, and day-to-day operations at STARK. You will work closely with colleagues from various departments, including Sales, Purchasing, and Logistics. From day one, you will work on real cases and gain practical experience in a fast-paced international environment.

YOUR MISSION

As a Working Student in Export Control, you will support us in reliably integrating national and international export control regulations into our daily business processes. You will work closely with various departments, including Sales, Purchasing, and Logistics, and assist with specific questions regarding export licenses, sanctions, goods classifications, and country-specific restrictions. You will gain direct insight into real cases involving international trade and export control law and have the opportunity to apply your theoretical knowledge directly in practice.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • You will answer daily questions from departments such as Sales, Purchasing, and Logistics regarding export control processes and verification steps.
  • You will actively support the preparation and drafting of export license applications to the Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control (BAFA).
  • Before planned exports, you will conduct research on export licenses, sanctions, goods classifications, and country-specific restrictions.
  • You will analyze and document historical export and customs data for risk analysis and preparation for internal and external audits.
  • You will independently prepare, review, and manage end-use declarations for customers, suppliers, and authorities.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • You are currently enrolled as a student (all genders) in Business Law, Law, Business Administration, Logistics, International Business, or a comparable field.
  • You have a basic understanding of or strong interest in German and European export control law, particularly AWG/AWV and the EU Dual-Use Regulation.
  • You enjoy explaining complex regulations in an understandable way and supporting your colleagues with solution-oriented approaches.
  • You work very carefully, in a structured manner, and independently.
  • You have fluent German language skills and very good English language skills.

NICE TO HAVE

Initial practical experience in export control, customs, compliance, or foreign trade, for example through internships or working student positions.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

title: Working Student Marketing & Content (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Neue Kunden zu gewinnen ist für viele kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen zeitaufwendig und teuer. selqo wurde gegründet, um genau diesen Unternehmen die Möglichkeit zu geben, planbar und kosteneffizient zu wachsen. Deine Aufgabe

Wie selqo im Markt wahrgenommen wird, entscheidet sich jetzt. Dafür suchen wir eine Werkstudentin oder einen Werkstudenten, die oder der Seite an Seite mit unserem Gründerteam die Marke selqo von Grund auf mitgestaltet: unsere Geschichte erzählt, Kundenerfolge sichtbar macht und unseren Auftritt auf LinkedIn und in Kampagnen prägt.

  • Du gestaltest Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos für LinkedIn und unsere Werbekampagnen.

  • Du bereitest unsere Inhalte für Blog und Newsletter auf und baust beides Schritt für Schritt aus.

  • Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und hilfst so, unsere Kommunikation weiterzuentwickeln.

Was diese Stelle besonders macht

  • Etwas Neues mitprägen: Mit selqo geben wir jedem KMU die Möglichkeit planbar und effizient zu wachsen. Du definierst wie wir darüber sprechen, und prägst damit nicht nur unsere Marke, sondern einen ganzen Markt.

  • Direkt mit dem Gründerteam: Du arbeitest täglich mit uns drei Gründern zusammen, ohne Hierarchie dazwischen. Du sitzt mit am Tisch, wenn wir über Positionierung, Zielgruppen und Kampagnen entscheiden.

  • Spannende Geschichten: Du sprichst mit Unternehmern aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und erzählst, wie sie mit selqo neue Kunden gewinnen.

Dein Profil

Erfahrung

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft oder Medien.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau: klar, verständlich und ohne Floskeln.

  • Du hast schon eigene Projekte umgesetzt, zum Beispiel einen Social-Media-Kanal, einen Blog oder ein kleines Business.

Mindset

  • Du packst Dinge an, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich und bist neugierig auf neue Formate.

  • Du interessierst dich für B2B, Vertrieb und den Mittelstand.

  • Du hast Lust, mit einem jungen Start-up zu wachsen und die Marke von Anfang an mitzuprägen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam und Einblick in alle Bereiche, von Produkt über Vertrieb bis Finanzierung

  • Attraktive Vergütung von 20 € pro Stunde bei 16–20 Stunden pro Woche

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

  • Die Aussicht, nach dem Studium mit uns weiterzuwachsen und das Marketing mit aufzubauen

Schick uns einfach einen kurzen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Sätze zu deinen bisherigen Projekten mit Marketingbezug.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen jeden Hintergrunds, Geschlechts, Alters und jeder Herkunft.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.
